Systems Engineer

Location – Muscat, Oman

We are looking for a Systems Engineer to work closely with a sales representative in Oman. The Systems Engineer's main mission will be to support the sales organization in all technical matters regarding pre-sales, sales calls, and post-sales.

With us you will

• Lead all technical aspects of a sales cycle with the Enterprise customers, from the initial RFIs, through to RFPs & RFQs when required. This includes the project management and active participation in POCs in partnership with the relevant teams both internally and within the customer and/or commercial partner.

• Have the ability to listen and to understand the technical requirements of the customer, reading between the lines to build a solution which outperforms the competitor offering.

• Be the primary technical point of contact for the customer(s) and partners in close collaboration with your sales partner.

• Continuously strive to improve knowledge around the Fortinet products and solutions, along with maintaining a deep understanding of the competitive landscape and Fortinet’s ability to provide long lasting protection against the ever-evolving threats.

• Have a strong ability to position Fortinet solutions to the customer, whether this be remotely or in person. This requires strong communication skills and the ability to confidently present through whiteboarding, technical white papers, technical plans or customer discussions.

• Manage your time effectively when working on multiple deals simultaneously, ensuring a positive customer experience is maintained.

• Maintain accurate activity, contact, and account technical information of all customers and prospects in our CRM (Salesforce).

Apply if you

• Have a high aptitude for security technology, specifically encryption, authentication, with further knowledge of network security, intrusion detection, anti-virus, routing, switching, LAN and WAN being desirable. The CISSP accreditation would also be beneficial.

• Are currently or have previously worked in a pre-sales engineer role, managing end to end technical aspects of deals, through to technical closure.

• Can demonstrate your problem solving skills and how this has impacted key wins within your current organisation.

• Understand and can demonstrate your ability to build and maintain customer relationships, including your ability to effectively communicate technically to a range of both external and internal stakeholders.

• Have a strong understanding of RADIUS, PKI, IKE, Certificates, L2TP, IPSEC, FIREWALL, 802.1Q, MD5, SSH, SSL, SHA1, DES, 3DES

What you can expect from us

• Excellent training and development opportunities, providing you with all the tools you need to be successful.

• An open working environment, sharing knowledge and information collaboratively and transparently, with respect to everyone’s thoughts and opinions.

• The opportunity to be part of an innovative, collaborative and winning team.

• A competitive salary and incentive compensation package, including stock awards, health and welfare benefits.

From the start, the Fortinet vision has been to deliver broad, truly integrated, high-performance security across the IT infrastructure. Today, we secure the largest enterprises, service providers and government organizations around the world.

Fortinet empowers its customers with intelligent, seamless protection across the expanding attack surface and the power to take on ever-increasing performance requirements of the borderless network – today and into the future. We have proven to be a truly innovative technology driven network security company with over 619 registered Global Patents. This is over 3 times more than our closest most innovative competitor!

jobs.title: Senior Devops Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT EDGE


At EDGE bold ideas are engineered into technologies that protect, improve and save lives.

Headquartered in the United Arab Emirates, EDGE is a leading advanced technology group working at the forefront of defence and emerging technologies. Spanning more than 35 specialised companies and multiple centres of excellence, we are purpose-built to move fast. Free from heavy legacy processes, we give our people the autonomy, accountability, and agility to bring breakthrough technologies from concept to reality.

Based in Abu Dhabi, a globally connected hub at the crossroads of Europe, Asia, Africa, and the Middle East, EDGE is home to a truly multicultural community where bold ideas thrive, and the future is shaped.

Together, we are shaping the future.

ABOUT THE ROLE


FADA is seeking a highly skilled, forward-thinking DevOps Engineer (Cloud, AI Infrastructure, Telemetry & Geospatial Systems) to architect, automate, and optimize mission-critical infrastructure powering advanced geospatial intelligence (GEOINT), Intelligence, Surveillance, and Reconnaissance (ISR), and Earth Observation (EO) platforms.

This role plays a pivotal part in delivering secure, scalable, and resilient multi-cloud and hybrid environments across Azure and AWS for high-throughput imagery ingestion, raster/SAR/optical processing, AI/ML pipelines, and mission analytics. In alignment with industry standards, the role integrates AI-assisted operations and autonomous DevOps/SRE agents, InfluxDB time-series telemetry, and end-to-end observability to accelerate mission capability delivery while maintaining strict security, reliability, and governance.

RESPONSIBILITIES


• Multi-Cloud & Hybrid Architecture (Azure & AWS): Architect, deploy, and govern cloud-native and hybrid infrastructure across Azure and AWS for mission-critical GEOINT and imagery workflows—covering compute, object/block storage, networking, IAM/Entra ID, landing zones, and secure on-premise or air-gapped connectivity.

• AI Infrastructure & DevOps/SRE Agents: Deploy, govern, and integrate AI tooling and autonomous/semi-autonomous DevOps and SRE agents (such as incident investigation, IaC/PR review, drift/compliance checking, and deployment risk workflows) with strict human-in-the-loop approvals, least-privilege guardrails, and full auditability.

• Infrastructure as Code (IaC) & DevOps: Implement and maintain modular IaC (Terraform, Bicep, Ansible) and GitOps workflows (ArgoCD or Flux) to automate provisioning of geospatial data pipelines, GPU compute clusters, AI inference/training environments, and distributed mission services.

• Time-Series & Telemetry Engineering (InfluxDB & OTel): Design, scale, and maintain high-throughput telemetry and time-series pipelines using InfluxDB (and collectors such as Telegraf and OpenTelemetry) to capture infrastructure metrics, pipeline throughput, sensor/ground/platform telemetry, and real-time operational events.

• End-to-End Observability & AIOps: Build and optimize observability stacks (OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, InfluxDB, ELK/Loki, Azure Monitor, AWS CloudWatch) combining metrics, logs, traces, and anomaly detection to ensure proactive reliability across GEOINT workloads and mission platforms.

• CI/CD & Python Automation: Architect resilient CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI) and build Python-based automation tools, CLI utilities, and API integrations for data ingestion, STAC/metadata workflows, telemetry automation, and automated verification.

• Container & GPU Orchestration: Deploy and manage containerized workloads on Docker and Kubernetes (AKS and EKS), including GPU-accelerated node pools for computer vision/AI models, raster processing, and geospatial web services.

• Performance & Scalability for EO/SAR Workloads: Tune storage, networking, caching, and distributed compute to handle bursty EO/SAR ingestion, large raster/COG datasets, and real-time analytics under strict SLAs.

• Zero Trust Security & Mission Governance: Enforce Zero Trust architecture, network segmentation (VNet/VPC, firewalls, VPN/ExpressRoute/Direct Connect, service mesh), encryption at rest and in transit, secrets management, and compliance controls suited to sensitive defense and space/geospatial environments.

• Incident Response, FinOps & Documentation: Lead root-cause analysis and incident response across dev, test, and operational environments; drive cloud/GPU FinOps optimization; and maintain architecture decision records (ADRs), playbooks, and operational runbooks.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with GEOINT engineers, AI/ML scientists, data engineers, and security teams to align infrastructure performance, telemetry, and automation with mission needs.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS


• Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Cloud/Systems Engineering, GIS/Geospatial Technology, or a related technical field.

• Experience: 8–10+ years of hands-on experience in DevOps, Platform Engineering, SRE, or Cloud Infrastructure roles.

• Cloud Expertise (Azure & AWS): Deep practical experience with both Azure and AWS, including multi-account/multi-subscription landing zones, IAM/RBAC, networking, storage, and managed Kubernetes (AKS and EKS).

• AI & DevOps Agents: Practical experience integrating AI/LLM-powered developer and operations agents, agentic tool/MCP workflows, or AIOps into CI/CD, IaC validation, or incident triage—including security, sandboxing, and governance controls.

• Telemetry & InfluxDB: Hands-on experience with InfluxDB (time-series schema design, retention/downsampling policies, ingestion pipelines) alongside OpenTelemetry and industry-standard metrics, logs, and tracing stacks.

• IaC & Automation: Strong proficiency in Python for operational tooling and APIs, paired with proven experience in Terraform (preferred), Bicep, or Ansible and Git-based workflows.

• Containers & Orchestration: Solid mastery of Kubernetes architecture, workload autoscaling, ingress/egress, and GPU scheduling.

• Geospatial Foundations: Hands-on experience supporting geospatial or imagery workflows (e.g., PostGIS, GeoTIFF/COG, WMTS/vector tiles, STAC catalogs, or raster processing pipelines).

• Networking & Security: Strong command of DNS, routing, VPNs, load balancers, firewalls, Zero Trust principles, and enterprise security/compliance frameworks.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS


• Experience building InfluxDB pipelines for high-frequency telemetry, hardware/satellite/ground-station metrics, or real-time operational analytics.

• Experience deploying and governing AI agents (e.g., automated PR/IaC reviewers, SRE investigation agents, policy/compliance agents) with deterministic guardrails and audit trails.

• Hands-on experience with Azure ML / AWS SageMaker, GPU clusters, and air-gapped, sovereign, or hybrid/on-premise deployments.

• Experience integrating DevOps pipelines with EO/SAR processing engines, orthorectification/tiling/mosaicking workflows, or cloud EO platforms (e.g., SentinelHub, Google Earth Engine, OpenEO).

• Experience with GitOps (ArgoCD or Flux), service mesh (e.g., Istio/Linkerd), and OpenTelemetry instrumentation across microservices and batch jobs.

• Advanced Python for parallel geospatial/raster processing, metadata extraction, and automated infrastructure testing.

• Background in defense, aerospace/space systems, ISR ecosystems, or high-assurance operational enclaves.

WHY CHOOSE EDGE


Launched in November 2019, the UAE's EDGE is one of the world's leading advanced technology groups, established to develop agile, bold and disruptive solutions for defence and beyond, and to be a catalyst for change and transformation. It is dedicated to bringing breakthrough innovations, products, and services to market with greater speed and efficiency, to position the UAE as a leading global hub for future industries, and to creating clear paths within the sector for the next generation of highly skilled talent to thrive.

At EDGE, the real investment goes beyond compensation. Through our dedicated learning academy and digital learning platforms, employees have access to extensive opportunities to develop new skills, deepen their expertise, and advance their careers. Combined with the freedom to innovate, strong career support, and the opportunity to collaborate with world-class talent from across the globe, EDGE is a place where you can continue to grow, keep learning, and turn ambitious ideas into meaningful outcomes.

Working at EDGE also comes with a package that genuinely reflects how much we value our people. Salaries are highly competitive and tax-free and, depending on your role and seniority, benefits can include family visas, annual flight tickets, medical insurance for you and your dependents, and education allowances for your children.

CANDIDATE PRIVACY & EQUAL OPPORTUNITY STATEMENT


If you feel your skills, experience and potential are a strong match for a role, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement. We are genuinely interested in what you can bring to EDGE.

Any information you share as part of your EDGE candidate profile or job application will be handled in accordance with applicable data protection and privacy regulations.

EDGE is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and high-performing workforce. We believe every individual deserves to be treated with fairness, respect and dignity, and our employment decisions reflect that. We do not discriminate based on race, colour, nationality, ethnicity, religion, gender, marital status, age, disability, pregnancy or parental status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

As a global organisation, effective collaboration across international teams is central to how we work, so English proficiency is required for all roles unless otherwise stated in the job posting.

Please note that EDGE does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruitment agencies. Any resumes in the absence of a formally executed agreement in place will be deemed the property of EDGE, and no placement fees or compensation will be payable in respect of such submissions.

jobs.description:

At EDGE bold ideas are engineered into technologies that protect, improve and save lives.

Headquartered in the United Arab Emirates, EDGE is a leading advanced technology group working at the forefront of defence and emerging technologies. Spanning more than 35 specialised companies and multiple centres of excellence, we are purpose-built to move fast. Free from heavy legacy processes, we give our people the autonomy, accountability, and agility to bring breakthrough technologies from concept to reality.

Based in Abu Dhabi, a globally connected hub at the crossroads of Europe, Asia, Africa, and the Middle East, EDGE is home to a truly multicultural community where bold ideas thrive, and the future is shaped.

Together, we are shaping the future.

ABOUT THE ROLE


The System Engineer I is responsible for the administration, maintenance, monitoring, and technical support of the organization’s IT infrastructure, including Windows Server systems, networking, virtualization, storage solutions, and hybrid environments. The role focuses on ensuring system availability, reliability, performance, and security through regular maintenance, troubleshooting, and system upgrades. Additionally, the engineer supports backup and disaster recovery operations, infrastructure projects, and compliance with IT policies and best practices.

RESPONSIBILITIES


• Install, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot Microsoft Windows Server systems.

• Administer Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, user accounts, and access permissions.

• Support Microsoft Exchange Server, Microsoft 365, and related email services.

• Manage and monitor virtualization environments, including VMware and Hyper-V.

• Support networking services and protocols, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPN, and VLAN.

• Maintain storage systems, including SAN/NAS, file servers, and backup solutions.

• Monitor system performance, perform backups, and support disaster recovery procedures.

• Perform system upgrades, security patching, and software deployment using SCCM, WSUS, or equivalent tools.

• Support on-premises and hybrid environments, including Microsoft Azure and Entra ID.

• Assist in data center operations, including server hardware, racks, and network infrastructure.

• Troubleshoot technical issues and coordinate with vendors when required.

• Maintain technical documentation and ensure compliance with IT security policies and procedures.

• Support other employees of the IT section in fulfilling their roles and provide technical assistance.

• Ensure compliance with all safety, housekeeping, and environmental directives.

• Perform other duties as directed by the Manager, IT and Digitalization.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS


• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.

• Minimum of 3–5 years of experience in Windows Server administration, IT infrastructure, networking, virtualization, and system support.

• Strong knowledge of Windows Server administration, Active Directory, and Group Policy.

• Good understanding of networking protocols: TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPN, and VLAN.

• Experience with Microsoft Exchange Server and Microsoft 365.

• Working knowledge of virtualization technologies (VMware, Hyper-V).

• Familiarity with storage systems (SAN, NAS) and backup solutions.

• Knowledge of SCCM, WSUS, system monitoring, and troubleshooting tools.

• Basic understanding of data center operations and server hardware.

• Familiarity with disaster recovery and hybrid infrastructure environments.

• Basic knowledge of Microsoft Azure, Entra ID, and PowerShell.

• MCSE (Microsoft Certified Systems Engineer).

• Additional certifications such as VMware, Azure, or CCNA are a plus.

• Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.

• Ability to work effectively in a team and manage priorities.

• Good communication and technical documentation skills.

• Commitment to safety, housekeeping, and environmental directives.

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager, Digital Strategy
jobs.summary: We are looking for a Senior Program Manager, Digital Strategy to act as the enterprise orchestrator, converting digital strategy into impactful outcomes across multiple entities. Lead the design and delivery of complex, cross-entity digital programmes, synthesising executive vision into actionable roadmaps. Ideal for experienced professionals with a strong background in digital strategy and programme management.
jobs.description:
JOB PURPOSE:

Acts as ADNOC’s enterprise orchestrator and value guardian, entrusted to convert the Group’s digital strategy into measurable, high-impact outcomes across multiple entities. Mandated to architect, govern, and accelerate the delivery of complex, cross-entity digital programs, this role synthesizes executive vision into actionable program roadmaps, robust governance frameworks, and sustained value realization. As the principal execution advisor to the Manager/VP, Group Digital Strategy & Transformation, the Senior Program Manager steers investment choices, adjudicates trade-offs, and de-risks execution commanding enterprise influence through program boards, investment councils, and design authorities.

Institutionalizes program excellence by embedding standardized stage gates, OKRs, benefits ledgers, lean portfolio management, secure-by-design, and policy/control-as-code guardrails compressing time-to-value, elevating predictability, and safeguarding license-to-operate. Accountable for P&L-relevant benefits realization, schedule and cost predictability, risk posture, and adoption outcomes, the Senior Program Manager directly strengthens ADNOC’s competitiveness, resilience, and digital leadership by ensuring every digital program is traceably linked to strategic value and enterprise transformation.

KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES:

Job Specific:

Business Strategy:

· Translate, architect, and operationalize ADNOC’s enterprise digital strategy into robust, actionable program roadmaps defining and validating clear value hypotheses, establishing rigorous and measurable KPIs/OKRs, and mapping complex cross-entity dependencies to guarantee seamless alignment with the Group’s enterprise blueprint, regulatory imperatives, and transformation priorities.

· Advise, influence, and secure pivotal decisions at program boards and steering committees on program scope, funding allocation, sequencing, and risk appetite delivering decision-grade options underpinned by quantified benefits, cost-benefit analyses, and risk profiles to empower informed, value-driven executive choices and strategic trade-offs.

· Integrate, synchronize, and optimize multi-domain portfolios including Data, Cybersecurity, Cloud & Advanced Computing, Connectivity & Industrial Communications, and Applications eliminating duplication, rationalizing investments, and maximizing enterprise-wide reuse, interoperability, and synergies to accelerate value realization, drive operational excellence, and amplify ADNOC’s strategic impact.

· Develop and operationalize comprehensive digital strategy and transformation roadmaps that support the Group’s long-term vision, corporate priorities, business goals, and sustainability objectives.

· Analyze market dynamics, emerging technology trends, and internal digital capabilities to shape strategic direction, prioritize opportunities, and inform investment decisions.

· Lead the design and implementation of enterprise-scale digital programs, integrating cross-functional portfolios and coordinating dependencies across Group entities and business functions.

· Advise and influence executive stakeholders by presenting decision-grade business cases, risk assessments, investment options, and value-realization plans.

· Institutionalize best practices in strategy execution, including OKR management, benefits tracking, lean portfolio management, stage-gate governance, and continuous value assurance.

· Oversee performance measurement, executive reporting, benefits realization, and continuous improvement across the portfolio of digital initiatives.

· Evaluate emerging technologies, including artificial intelligence, automation, cloud, advanced analytics, and the Internet of Things, and lead relevant assessments, experiments, and proof-of-concepts.

· Define target operating models, priority digital capabilities, governance arrangements, and organizational changes required to enable effective strategy execution and sustainable adoption.

· Mentor and guide cross-functional teams in digital strategy, value management, portfolio governance, and program delivery, strengthening enterprise capability and execution discipline.

· Monitor the external technology landscape and assess its strategic relevance to ensure that digital investments remain aligned with the organization’s objectives, risk appetite, and enterprise architecture.

Generic:

Supervision

· Plan, supervise and coordinate all activities in the assigned area to meet functional objectives.

· Train and develop the assigned staff on relevant skills to enable them to become proficient on the job and deliver the respective section objectives.

Budgets

· Provide input for preparation of the Function/Division/Department/Section budgets, assist in the implementation of the approved Budget, and work plans to deliver objectives.

· Investigate and highlight any significant variances to support effective performance and cost control.

Policies, Systems, Processes & Procedures

· Implement approved Function/Division/Department/Section policies, processes, systems, standards and procedures in order to support execution of the work programs in line with Company and International standards.

Performance Management

· Contribute to the achievement of the approved Performance Objectives for the Function/Division/Department/ Section in line with the Company Performance framework.

Innovation and Continuous Improvement

· Design and implement new tools and techniques to improve the quality and efficiency of operational processes.

· Identify improvements in internal processes against best practices in pursuit of greater efficiency in line with best industry standards in order to define intelligent solutions for issues confronting the function.

Health, Safety, Environment (HSE) and Sustainability

· Comply with relevant HSE policies, procedures, controls, applicable legislation, and sustainability guidelines in line with international standards, best practices and ADNOC Code of Practices.

Reports

· Provide inputs to prepare Function/Division/Department/Section MIS and progress reports for Company Management.

COMMUNICATION & WORKING RELATIONSHIP:

Internal:

•
VP, Group Digital Strategy & Transformation; Group Digital Executive leadership.

•
Enterprise & Domain Architecture, Cybersecurity (CISO/Assurance), Data Office, Cloud & Advanced Computing, Connectivity & Industrial Comms, Applications Delivery.

•
PMO/Portfolio Office, Finance, Procurement, Legal & Compliance, HSE/Operations, Risk & Internal Audit.

•
Group Company CIOs/Business Directors and product/platform owners

External:

•
Strategic advisors/consultancies; hyperscalers and OEMs; systems integrators and delivery partners.

•
External auditors/assessors; standards bodies and regulator interfaces (as required).

QUALIFICATIONS, EXPERIENCE, KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS:

Minimum Qualification

•
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.

•
Master’s degree or MBA preferred.

Minimum Experience & Knowledge & Skills

•
Minimum 15 years of total professional experience, including at least 8 years focused on digital strategy, transformation, or program management within large, complex organizations.

•
Proven track record in designing and delivering enterprise-scale digital initiatives with measurable business outcomes; strong expertise in digital governance, OKRs, portfolio management, business-case development, benefits realization, and stakeholder engagement.

•
Strong analytical, executive communication, and decision-framing skills, supported by knowledge of emerging digital technologies, enterprise architecture, cyber and privacy guardrails, and enterprise-level IT/OT technology landscapes. Experience in the energy, oil and gas, or another asset-intensive industry is preferred.

Professional Certifications

•
Relevant certifications such as PgMP, MoP, PMP, PRINCE2, SAFe LPM/RTE, ITIL 4, Prosci Change Management, or TOGAF are advantageous.

jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer
jobs.description: The opportunity We are partnering with an ambitious, privately backed and highly profitable financial technology business building a next-generation corporate banking and financial infrastructure platform. The business is transforming how companies move and manage money internationally, leveraging stablecoin-based payment rails alongside traditional banking infrastructure to deliver faster, more efficient and cost-effective cross-border financial services. Its customers operate across multiple international markets and require sophisticated financial capabilities spanning multi-currency accounts, international payments, FX, settlement and treasury. The longer-term ambition is to develop a fully integrated corporate and wholesale banking proposition, bringing together the ability to move, hold, grow and borrow money through one platform. With the business entering an ambitious international growth phase, we are looking for a Chief Technology Officer to take ownership of its entire technology function and lead the next stage of its development. About the business The company is a regulated, institutional financial infrastructure business headquartered in the GCC. It provides cross-border settlement, stablecoin-to-fiat conversion, multi-currency accounts and treasury services to corporates, banks, payment companies, exchange houses, commodity traders and other financial institutions. It is a B2B business with no retail customers. At a glance: Scale: Billions of US dollars in annual transaction volume, with volumes growing roughly 4x year on year. Clients: Hundreds of institutional and corporate counterparties across the GCC and international markets. Regulation: Licensed in two GCC jurisdictions, with settlement through local banking partners. Partnerships: Integrated with a leading global digital-asset infrastructure network, a major Gulf payments super-app and a regional bank. Backing: Privately owned and highly profitable, backed by a long-established Gulf business group. Engineering: A lean team of around 15 engineers across India, the UK and Turkey, organised in product squads with a small shared platform and DevOps function. Reporting line: Chief Executive Officer, working alongside the Head of Product and the wider leadership team. The role This is a significant technology leadership appointment with responsibility for the architecture, infrastructure, engineering organisation and long-term technology strategy. The business has already established a number of core products and technology capabilities. The next challenge is to bring these together into a scalable, institutional-grade platform capable of supporting substantially greater volumes, additional financial products and multiple regulated jurisdictions. You will operate at both strategic and technical levels, working closely with the CEO, Head of Product and wider leadership team. You will have the opportunity to shape the technology organisation, make critical architectural decisions and build the infrastructure that underpins the company's future growth. Key responsibilities Technology strategy and architecture Own the overall technology vision, architecture and engineering strategy. Consolidate existing financial products and services into a cohesive, scalable platform. Lead the evolution of core banking infrastructure, ledger architecture and transaction processing. Build a modular, API-first platform capable of supporting multiple entities and jurisdictions. Establish the technical foundations for future financial products and services. Financial infrastructure, blockchain and payments Lead the development of financial infrastructure connecting traditional banking systems with blockchain and stablecoin payment rails. Oversee wallet infrastructure, financial ledgers, settlement and reconciliation capabilities. Develop scalable payment orchestration across banking networks, payment providers and blockchain infrastructure. Support multi-currency accounts, FX, international money movement and financial transaction processing. Ensure the platform can operate reliably across multiple regulated financial entities. Infrastructure and scalability Build and scale the underlying cloud infrastructure, DevOps and platform engineering capabilities. Establish the architecture and infrastructure required to support 10-100x growth. Improve platform reliability, security, performance and resilience. Develop automated deployment, monitoring and engineering processes. Ensure infrastructure can be replicated across new markets without significant redevelopment. Engineering leadership Lead and develop the existing international engineering organisation. Establish clear technical ownership and accountability across engineering teams. jobs.title: 3rd Party Developer Hub Manager

Shape the future of our distribution hub with your expertise in project governance and stakeholder management.
jobs.description:
JOB PURPOSE:

Lead third-party development within ADNOC Distribution’s Mobility Hub strategy by originating, structuring, and coordinating investor/developer projects from concept to handover. Act as the single point of contact for external developers and investors, managing the commercial, technical, contractual, and governance requirements needed to integrate sites seamlessly into the Hub ecosystem. Ensure timely approvals, risk-controlled delivery, and operational readiness that strengthen customer experience and portfolio returns.

KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES:

Job Specific Accountabilities

Partnership Origination & Commercial Structuring

• Identify and qualify 3P development opportunities aligned to hub typologies, network priorities, and investment criteria.
• Prepare and refine commercial models, heads of terms, and term-sheet options to balance value creation, risk allocation, and compliance.
• Coordinate internal inputs (Finance, Legal, BD) to validate business cases, sensitivity scenarios, and approval requirements.
• Support investor due diligence (technical, commercial, regulatory), addressing queries and aligning key assumptions.
• Draft and socialize decision packs for governance forums, ensuring clear options, risks, and recommendations.

Contract Lifecycle & Risk Management

• Lead the end-to-end contract process—from RFI/RFP support and bid clarifications to negotiation of definitive agreements.
• Ensure clarity on roles, deliverables, milestones, warranties, performance securities, and exit/step-in provisions.
• Track contractual obligations and conditions precedent (CPs), coordinating timely closure with internal and external parties.
• Maintain a live risk register covering commercial, schedule, technical, HSE, and authority risks, with mitigation plans.
• Manage variations and change control, preserving scope, economics, and governance integrity.

Cross-Functional Coordination & Technical Alignment

• Align site layout, access, utilities, and design standards with Engineering Projects, Operations, HSE, and Property Services.
• Coordinate authority requirements (utility providers, municipality, civil defense, etc.) to de-risk approvals on the critical path.
• Ensure 3P specifications support hub customer experience (wayfinding, parking circulation, tenant adjacencies, brand touchpoints).
• Validate readiness criteria for construction start (permits, insurances, method statements, interfaces).
• Facilitate technical reviews and close-out of comments to keep design and procurement on schedule.

Delivery Governance & Operational Readiness

• Run a stage-based governance cadence (business case, design freeze, pre-award, start-up, pre-opening) with documented gate criteria.
• Track execution milestones, critical path, and dependencies; escalate slippage early and propose recovery actions.
• Coordinate with Operations and HSE on commissioning, OR checklists, training/handovers, and defects management.
• Validate as-built documentation, warranties, and O&M manuals prior to handover into steady-state operations.
• Capture lessons learned and feed improvements into playbooks and templates.

Stakeholder Communication & Reporting

• Serve as the single point of contact for developers/investors, providing clear updates, action logs, and decisions required.
• Prepare concise progress reports, dashboards, and risk summaries for EMT/ELT and relevant committees.
• Coordinate with Marketing/Brand on key milestones and external communications where applicable.
• Ensure records are audit-ready (approvals, contracts, CP closures, change logs, correspondence).
• Maintain confidentiality and adherence to governance, delegation of authority (DoA), and information security standards.

Portfolio Performance & Optimization

• Monitor post-launch performance (throughput, uptime, commercial KPIs) and identify improvement opportunities with partners.
• Recommend re-scoping or enhancement measures (amenity mix, access improvements, utilities optimization) to maximize returns.
• Track contractual performance measures (SLAs, liquidated damages where applicable) and manage under-performance remedies.
• Support periodic portfolio reviews and rebalancing of pipeline priorities based on performance and market dynamics.
• Contribute to strategy refreshes, investment theses, and international roll-out playbooks as required.

Continuous Improvement & Tools

• Maintain and enhance standard templates (term sheets, risk registers, gate checklists, CP trackers, and reporting packs).
• Promote use of digital tools for document control, schedule tracking, and stakeholder collaboration.
• Benchmark external practices to refine commercial structures and execution standards.
• Propose process simplifications that reduce cycle time without compromising assurance.
• Support training and knowledge-sharing sessions across the Franchise & Property Services Division.

QUALIFICATIONS, EXPERIENCE, KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS:

Minimum Qualification

• Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Business Management, Real Estate, or a related field.

Minimum Experience & Knowledge & Skills

• 8 years of relevant experience in commercial real‑estate development, PPP/3P projects, or mobility/retail infrastructure.
• Hands‑on experience in commercial modelling, contract negotiation, and approvals (CPs, permits, utilities).
• Strong exposure to design coordination and delivery governance (stage‑gates, risk, change control).
• Proven ability to work cross‑functionally and manage multiple stakeholders and counterparties to deadlines.
• Commercial acumen (term sheets, risk allocation, value drivers)
• Contracting & negotiation; change/claims awareness
• Technical literacy (layouts, utilities, basic MEP/HSE considerations)
• Project governance, planning, and risk management
• Executive‑level communication, presentation, and stakeholder influence
• Strong documentation, decision‑pack preparation, and audit‑readiness
• Proficiency with MS Office and project/collaboration tools (e.g., MS Project, SharePoint/Teams, Asana/Jira)

jobs.description:
Business Introduction


Majid Al Futtaim Holding is the leading shopping mall, retail, communities, entertainment developer and operator in the Middle East, North Africa, and Central Asia regions. With over 43,000 people, revenues of over US$ 11 Billion, and operations in 18 countries. Some of the iconic brands we carry include Mall of the Emirates, Carrefour, All Saints, Lego, City Center, Abercrombie & Fitch, & Vox Cinemas. We believe in making Great Moments for Everyone, Every day.



JOB TITLE

AI Engineer | MAF LifeStyle | Data & AI Engineering



ROLE SUMMARY

The AI Engineer will be responsible for designing, building, deploying, and operating generative AI and machine learning applications that translate foundation-model capabilities into measurable business value. The role owns the end-to-end application lifecycle, including problem framing, prompt and retrieval design, architecture, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, safety, scalability, and cost efficiency.



ROLE PROFILE

• Design and develop production-ready generative AI and machine learning applications, including LLM, retrieval-augmented generation, and agentic solutions.
• Select suitable foundation models and providers by evaluating output quality, latency, cost, portability, and business requirements.
• Design prompts, structured outputs, function-calling workflows, fine-tuning runs, and troubleshooting approaches for assigned use cases.
• Build end-to-end retrieval pipelines using appropriate chunking, embeddings, hybrid search, reranking, and measured retrieval-quality criteria.
• Design scalable AI application architectures, APIs, authentication, caching, queues, streaming, and graceful-degradation mechanisms.
• Integrate AI applications with enterprise systems and data platforms, producing well-tested, maintainable, and observable Python code.
• Deploy and operate containerized applications using Docker, CI/CD, MLOps practices, monitoring, rollback, and cost-optimization controls.
• Implement evaluation frameworks, guardrails, validation, bias and hallucination testing, responsible-AI controls, and business-impact measurement.



REQUIREMENTS

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, or a related field; a master's degree is preferred.
• 5+ years of experience in AI engineering, software engineering, or applied machine learning within a complex or large-scale organization.
• Proven delivery of end-to-end LLM, retrieval, or agentic applications from solution design through production deployment
• Strong proficiency in Python and SQL, with expertise in foundation-model APIs.
• Hands-on experience with tools such as LangChain, Pinecone or Weaviate, Docker, CI/CD, MLflow, and production monitoring.
• Experience with Azure ML, AWS SageMaker, or GCP Vertex AI, combined with strong business acumen, communication skills, and responsible-AI judgment.



WHAT WE OFFER

• At Majid Al Futtaim, we’re on a mission to create great moments, to spread happiness, to build, experiences that stay in our memories for a lifetime. We’re proud to say that over the past 27 years, we have built a reputation as a regional market leader in what we do. Join us!

The Identity and Access Management Manager is responsible for developing and maintaining the organization's Identity Access Management (IAM) and Privilege Access Management (PAM) strategy, roadmap, and implementation plan, aligning it with business objectives and security best practices. This includes defining the future state of identity and access management and planning for its evolution.

• Identity Lifecycle Management: Manage end-to-end user and privileged identity lifecycle, including onboarding, provisioning, access changes, certifications, and offboarding.
• Access Governance & Authentication: Implement and manage RBAC/ABAC, MFA, SSO, federation, access reviews, and strong authentication/authorization mechanisms.
• Privileged Access Management: Oversee credential vaulting and rotation, privileged session monitoring/recording, JIT access, and break-glass/emergency access procedures.

• Leadership & Continuous Improvement: Lead IAM initiatives, vendors/MSPs, training, and stakeholder collaboration while continuously improving IAM capabilities, security, automation, and SLA performance.

REQUIREMENTS

jobs.description:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is looking for a Senior Solutions Architect to join our Commercial Sector Enterprise team in the UAE. You will work directly with some of the region's largest enterprises across Financial Services, Retail & Consumer Goods, Travel & Hospitality, Media & Entertainment, and other industries. These are established AWS customers with clear technology strategies, and you will help them execute and evolve those strategies at scale — accelerating modernization, expanding into new workloads, and unlocking new value with data, analytics, and generative AI.

This is a builder role. You will go into customer environments, understand their hardest problems, and design solutions that work, from whiteboard architecture through proof of concept to production. You will bring deep expertise across cloud infrastructure, modern application development, data and analytics, and increasingly, generative AI and machine learning. You will earn trust by shipping things that matter, not by presenting slides.

You will be part of a collaborative, supportive team that values curiosity, ownership, and impact. We learn from each other, develop each other, and build an environment where every voice is heard.

Key job responsibilities

As a Senior Solutions Architect, you will own the technical relationship with customers end-to-end. This means:

- Partnering with enterprise customers across multiple industries to understand their business objectives, assess their current technology landscape, and architect cloud solutions that deliver real outcomes in cost optimization, operational efficiency, security, reliability, and innovation.

- Translating industry-specific challenges into AWS architectures. Examples include modernizing core banking and payments platforms while meeting regulatory and data residency requirements; building omnichannel commerce, personalization, and supply chain solutions for retailers.

- Building hands-on: prototypes, proofs of concept, reference architectures, and production-ready designs. You lead by doing, not just advising.

- Helping customers adopt and build with generative AI and machine learning: identifying high-value use cases, designing architectures for foundation models and intelligent applications, and guiding teams from experimentation to production.

- Partnering closely with Account Managers to build technical account plans and turn technical wins into lasting customer adoption.

- Acting as the customer's technical advocate inside AWS, translating field insights into clear, prioritized feedback that shapes the roadmap for AWS services and features.

- Creating and sharing technical content that scales your impact: workshops, immersion days, blog posts, code samples, reference architectures, and public talks at meetups, user groups, and conferences.

A day in the life

No two days look the same. You might spend the morning whiteboarding a multi-account landing zone architecture with a bank's platform team, working through security, compliance, and data residency requirements. Then you might pivot to a hands-on working session helping a retail customer's developers integrate a foundation model into their recommendation engine. In the afternoon you might design a data platform for a hospitality group that wants a single view of its guests, review a colleague's architecture proposal, draft a blog post on a pattern you discovered in the field, or hop on a call with an AWS service team to advocate for a feature your customer needs. You balance depth with breadth, strategic thinking with hands-on execution, and customer urgency with long-term technical direction.

About the team

AWS Solutions Architects in MENAT are a tight-knit team of builders and technologists who are passionate about helping customers in one of the world's fastest-growing cloud markets. We work across diverse industries and cultures, which demands adaptability, curiosity, and genuine respect for our customers' contexts. We support each other through knowledge sharing, peer reviews, and a culture of continuous learning. We believe the best ideas come from diverse perspectives, and we actively foster an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.

Basic qualifications
- 10+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience

- 10+ years of technology domain areas (e.g., software development, cloud computing, AI/ML, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience

- Cloud Technology Certification (such as Solutions Architecture, Cloud Security Professional or Cloud DevOps Engineering)

- Knowledge of AWS services, market segments, customer base and industry verticals

Preferred qualifications
- 4+ years of technology/software sales experience

- Experience working with end user or developer communities

- Experience architecting infrastructure solutions using both Linux/Unix and Windows with specific recommendations on server, load balancing, HA/DR, & storage architectures

- Experience communicating across technical and non-technical audiences, including executive level stakeholders or clients

- Experience migrating or transforming legacy customer solutions to the cloud

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. jobs.title: Mechanical Integration Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT EDGE


At EDGE bold ideas are engineered into technologies that protect, improve and save lives.

Headquartered in the United Arab Emirates, EDGE is a leading advanced technology group working at the forefront of defence and emerging technologies. Spanning more than 35 specialised companies and multiple centres of excellence, we are purpose-built to move fast. Free from heavy legacy processes, we give our people the autonomy, accountability, and agility to bring breakthrough technologies from concept to reality.

Based in Abu Dhabi, a globally connected hub at the crossroads of Europe, Asia, Africa, and the Middle East, EDGE is home to a truly multicultural community where bold ideas thrive, and the future is shaped.

Together, we are shaping the future.

ABOUT THE ROLE


Pulse Nova, one of the joint ventures at EDGE, is hiring a Mechanical Integration Engineer to design, develop, and validate mechanical components, assemblies, and mounting structures to integrate radar, EW, C2, and sensor systems onto naval, ground, and airborne platforms. The role involves performing mechanical interface and structural analyses, preparing 3D CAD models and manufacturing drawings, and ensuring compliance with military environmental standards. The engineer will lead hardware installation activities, coordinate with technicians, and support mechanical testing, troubleshooting, and system qualification.

RESPONSIBILITIES


● Design and validate 3D mechanical parts, assemblies, and structures to integrate radar, EW, C2, and sensors onto naval, ground-vehicle, and airborne/UAS platforms.

● Design equipment mounts, support structures, and protective enclosures in line with MIL-STD-810G (or equivalent) requirements.

● Perform mechanical interface analysis: weight and footprint budgets, power consumption, cooling, and vibration/shock loading per platform.

● Prepare 3D CAD models, detailed manufacturing drawings, and mechanical installation drawings.

● Lead and support the physical installation of hardware on each platform, coordinating directly with the installation technicians.

● Support mechanical checks and tests and troubleshooting of electromechanical issues during integration and trials.

● Support environmental and qualification testing (vibration, shock, ingress protection, thermal).

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS


● Degree in Mechanical Engineering.

● Minimum 5+ years of experience in 3D mechanical design and integration of electronic equipment onto vehicles, vessels, or aircraft.

● Hands-on experience developing and validating mechanical prototypes, including 3D printing and fit checks.

● Familiarity with MIL-STD-810G or equivalent environmental qualification standards.

● Proficiency in 3D CAD tools such as Siemens NX or SolidWorks. Experience with Ansys or equivalent tools for structural analysis.

● Hands-on experience with installation tooling, torque specifications, and workmanship standards.

● Willingness to travel to integration and test sites, including desert/field campaigns and naval facilities.

WHY CHOOSE EDGE


Launched in November 2019, the UAE's EDGE is one of the world's leading advanced technology groups, established to develop agile, bold and disruptive solutions for defence and beyond, and to be a catalyst for change and transformation. It is dedicated to bringing breakthrough innovations, products, and services to market with greater speed and efficiency, to position the UAE as a leading global hub for future industries, and to creating clear paths within the sector for the next generation of highly skilled talent to thrive.

At EDGE, the real investment goes beyond compensation. Through our dedicated learning academy and digital learning platforms, employees have access to extensive opportunities to develop new skills, deepen their expertise, and advance their careers. Combined with the freedom to innovate, strong career support, and the opportunity to collaborate with world-class talent from across the globe, EDGE is a place where you can continue to grow, keep learning, and turn ambitious ideas into meaningful outcomes.

Working at EDGE also comes with a package that genuinely reflects how much we value our people. Salaries are highly competitive and tax-free and, depending on your role and seniority, benefits can include family visas, annual flight tickets, medical insurance for you and your dependents, and education allowances for your children.

CANDIDATE PRIVACY & EQUAL OPPORTUNITY STATEMENT


If you feel your skills, experience and potential are a strong match for a role, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement. We are genuinely interested in what you can bring to EDGE.

Any information you share as part of your EDGE candidate profile or job application will be handled in accordance with applicable data protection and privacy regulations.

EDGE is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and high-performing workforce. We believe every individual deserves to be treated with fairness, respect and dignity, and our employment decisions reflect that. We do not discriminate based on race, colour, nationality, ethnicity, religion, gender, marital status, age, disability, pregnancy or parental status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

As a global organisation, effective collaboration across international teams is central to how we work, so English proficiency is required for all roles unless otherwise stated in the job posting.

Please note that EDGE does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruitment agencies. Any resumes in the absence of a formally executed agreement in place will be deemed the property of EDGE, and no placement fees or compensation will be payable in respect of such submissions.

jobs.title: Senior Cyber Security Engineer - Emirati Talent
jobs.description:
ABOUT EDGE


At EDGE bold ideas are engineered into technologies that protect, improve and save lives.

Headquartered in the United Arab Emirates, EDGE is a leading advanced technology group working at the forefront of defence and emerging technologies. Spanning more than 35 specialised companies and multiple centres of excellence, we are purpose-built to move fast. Free from heavy legacy processes, we give our people the autonomy, accountability, and agility to bring breakthrough technologies from concept to reality.

Based in Abu Dhabi, a globally connected hub at the crossroads of Europe, Asia, Africa, and the Middle East, EDGE is home to a truly multicultural community where bold ideas thrive, and the future is shaped.

Together, we are shaping the future.

ABOUT THE ROLE


The Senior Cybersecurity Engineer is vital to proactively enhancing our client’s cybersecurity resilience by identifying and addressing potential threats through advanced adversarial testing. This role exists to simulate real-world attacks, challenging security defenses and exposing vulnerabilities to strengthen the organization’s ability to withstand cyber threats. By leading high-impact red team engagements and providing expert guidance on product innovation, this position ensures that our security capabilities remain at the forefront of evolving threats and technology.

RESPONSIBILITIES


• Conduct advanced penetration testing and vulnerability assessments across web applications, networks, and cloud environments, identifying and prioritising security risks.

• Lead end-to-end red team operations, simulating real-world adversarial tactics, techniques and procedures (TTPs) to assess organisational security and defensive capabilities.

• Develop and utilise custom tools, scripts, automation and Command & Control (C2) frameworks to enhance attack simulations, operational efficiency and stealth.

• Act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for red team frameworks and product development, collaborating with technical teams to integrate offensive security capabilities and operational requirements.

• Produce comprehensive technical reports, communicate findings to stakeholders and clients, and provide actionable recommendations to strengthen security posture.

• Mentor and support junior team members, promote knowledge sharing, and maintain awareness of emerging offensive security techniques, tools and industry developments.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS


• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or related field.

• Minimum 4 years of experience in penetration testing, red team engagements.

• At least one relevant certification (OSCP, CRTO, OSEP, OSWE, OSED).

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS


• Master’s degree in Cybersecurity, Information Security, or a relevant technical field.

• Advanced certifications such as OSCE3, demonstrating specialized red team skills.

WHY CHOOSE EDGE


Launched in November 2019, the UAE's EDGE is one of the world's leading advanced technology groups, established to develop agile, bold and disruptive solutions for defence and beyond, and to be a catalyst for change and transformation. It is dedicated to bringing breakthrough innovations, products, and services to market with greater speed and efficiency, to position the UAE as a leading global hub for future industries, and to creating clear paths within the sector for the next generation of highly skilled talent to thrive.

At EDGE, the real investment goes beyond compensation. Through our dedicated learning academy and digital learning platforms, employees have access to extensive opportunities to develop new skills, deepen their expertise, and advance their careers. Combined with the freedom to innovate, strong career support, and the opportunity to collaborate with world-class talent from across the globe, EDGE is a place where you can continue to grow, keep learning, and turn ambitious ideas into meaningful outcomes.

Working at EDGE also comes with a package that genuinely reflects how much we value our people. Salaries are highly competitive and tax-free and, depending on your role and seniority, benefits can include family visas, annual flight tickets, medical insurance for you and your dependents, and education allowances for your children.

CANDIDATE PRIVACY & EQUAL OPPORTUNITY STATEMENT


If you feel your skills, experience and potential are a strong match for a role, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement. We are genuinely interested in what you can bring to EDGE.

Any information you share as part of your EDGE candidate profile or job application will be handled in accordance with applicable data protection and privacy regulations.

EDGE is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and high-performing workforce. We believe every individual deserves to be treated with fairness, respect and dignity, and our employment decisions reflect that. We do not discriminate based on race, colour, nationality, ethnicity, religion, gender, marital status, age, disability, pregnancy or parental status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

As a global organisation, effective collaboration across international teams is central to how we work, so English proficiency is required for all roles unless otherwise stated in the job posting.

Please note that EDGE does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruitment agencies. Any resumes in the absence of a formally executed agreement in place will be deemed the property of EDGE, and no placement fees or compensation will be payable in respect of such submissions.

JOB DESCRIPTION

Technical Lead - Data Engineering (Technical Product Owner – Data & Analytics)

The Big Picture 

Sysco LABS is the Global In-House Center of Sysco Corporation (NYSE: SYY), the world’s largest foodservice company. Sysco ranks 55th in the Fortune 500 list and is the global leader in the trillion-dollar foodservice industry.

Sysco operates 333 distribution centers across 10 countries, with 75,000 colleagues serving approximately 670,000 customer locations, including restaurants, healthcare and educational facilities, lodging establishments, entertainment venues and more. For fiscal year 2026, which ended June 27, 2026, the company generated sales of more than $84 billion.

Sysco LABS Sri Lanka delivers the technology that powers Sysco’s end-to-end operations.

Sysco LABS’ enterprise technology is present in the end-to-end foodservice journey, enabling the sourcing of food products, merchandising, storage and warehouse operations, order placement and pricing algorithms, the delivery of food and supplies to Sysco’s global network and the in-restaurant dining experience of the end-customer.

The Opportunity

We are looking for Technical Lead - Data Engineering (Technical Product Owner – Data & Analytics) to join our team.

Responsibilities:

• Act as the primary point of contact between Business stakeholders and the Data Organization, understanding business objectives and translating them into data, reporting and analytics requirements.

• Hold ownership of data and reporting requirements, driving prioritization, requirement clarity and end-to-end delivery in alignment with business objectives and agreed priorities.

• Gather, analyze and document business requirements, translating them into clear functional specifications, user stories and acceptance criteria.

• Own and prioritize the product backlog, managing competing business demands based on business value, urgency and technical feasibility.

• Work closely with Data Engineers, BI Developers, Data Scientists, Business Analysts and Quality Engineers to drive end-to-end delivery of data and reporting solutions.

• Collaborate with technical teams to understand data architecture, data pipelines, data models and BI solutions, ensuring business requirements are effectively translated into technical deliverables.

• Oversee delivery progress, proactively address dependencies and blockers, and ensure solutions meet agreed requirements and quality expectations.

• Coordinate business reviews, solution demonstrations, User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and stakeholder signoffs.

• Identify opportunities to improve existing reports, automate processes, standardize business metrics and enhance data-driven decision-making.

• Communicate delivery progress, priorities, risks and outcomes effectively to business stakeholders and management.

Requirements:

• Bachelor's degree in IT, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Management or a related discipline.

• 6+ years of experience in Product Ownership, Business Analysis, BI Development, Data Analytics or a related technology role.

• Strong experience in gathering business requirements, stakeholder management, requirement prioritization and product backlog ownership.

• Previous exposure to Data Engineering, BI Development or Data Analytics, preferably with hands-on experience in a technical data-related role.

• Good working knowledge of SQL, Data Warehousing, data modelling, ETL/ELT processes and data pipelines.

• Practical exposure to BI and reporting tools such as Tableau, Power BI or similar platforms.

• Understanding of data architecture, reporting solutions, data quality and data governance principles.

• Experience working with cross-functional Agile teams and managing end-to-end delivery of technology or data initiatives.

• Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication and stakeholder management skills.

• Ability to bridge the gap between business and technical teams, effectively translating business needs into actionable technical requirements.

• Strong ownership, leadership and organizational skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and drive delivery independently.

• Professional certifications such as CSPO, PSPO, CBAP or PMP, and exposure to cloud data platforms such as BigQuery, Snowflake or Redshift, will be an added advantage.

Benefits:

• Performance-based annual bonus

• Performance rewards and recognition

• Agile Benefits - special allowances for Health, Wellness & Academic purposes

• Entertainment allowance

• Team engagement allowance

• Comprehensive Health & Life Insurance Cover - extendable to parents and in-laws

•

jobs.title: Lead/Senior Lead AI Engineer - AI Services Operations
jobs.description:
Job Description
We are looking for an experienced and hands-on Lead or Senior Lead AI Engineer - AI Services Operations to join our Product & Technology AI Engineering team. You will play a key role in ensuring the reliability, supportability and continuous improvement of our production AI services, working across AI Engineering, Support, Platform, Infrastructure and other Product & Technology teams.

This role brings together software engineering, cloud and DevOps, service operations and technical stakeholder coordination. You will work across application and platform layers to understand how our AI services are deployed, configured, monitored and operated, and use that knowledge to troubleshoot complex production issues and drive them through to resolution.

Beyond resolving individual incidents, you will help evolve how we operate and support AI services. You will use engineering, automation and emerging AI and agentic technologies to improve observability, incident triage, troubleshooting and overall service reliability.

Tasks included but not limited to:

• Own the technical investigation and coordination of complex production incidents, working across AI Engineering, Support, Platform and Infrastructure & Reliability teams to drive issues through to resolution.
• Troubleshoot issues across application, configuration, deployment, networking and infrastructure layers using logs, metrics, traces and other diagnostic information.
• Develop a strong understanding of the underlying platform architecture and how infrastructure, provisioning, configuration and AI services come together to serve our customers.
• Work hands-on with cloud-native technologies, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, source repositories and configuration management to diagnose issues and implement improvements.
• Improve monitoring, logging, tracing, alerting and operational dashboards to increase visibility into service health and accelerate troubleshooting.
• Lead root-cause analysis and translate operational learnings into engineering improvements that prevent recurring issues and strengthen service reliability.
• Develop scripts, tooling and automation to streamline operational workflows, diagnostics and incident management.
• Explore and implement AI-assisted and agentic solutions for incident triage, diagnostics, log analysis, knowledge retrieval, root-cause analysis and operational insights.
• Develop and continuously improve runbooks, operational documentation and engineering practices that enable teams to operate and support services effectively.
• Collaborate with technical and non-technical stakeholders, providing clear communication and technical leadership during incidents and operational initiatives.
• Mentor engineers and help strengthen an engineering culture of build it, run it and continuously improve it.

Qualifications
• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
• Significant hands-on experience in Software Engineering, DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), Platform Engineering, MLOps, Quality Engineering or a similar technical discipline.
• Strong understanding of cloud-native architectures and technologies, including containers, Kubernetes, networking and distributed services.
• Experience with CI/CD, source control, deployment and configuration management, with the ability to make hands-on engineering changes when required.
• Strong operational troubleshooting skills and experience using monitoring, logging, tracing and observability to diagnose complex production issues.
• Proficiency in a modern programming or scripting language such as Python, Go, Bash or PowerShell.
• Good understanding of incident management, root-cause analysis, operational readiness and reliability engineering practices.
• Familiarity with AI/ML systems and AI-assisted development and agentic AI technologies, or the ability to rapidly develop expertise in these areas.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work across application, platform and infrastructure boundaries.
• Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to coordinate complex technical situations across multiple teams.
• A proactive, automation-first mindset and a passion for continuously improving how services are built, operated and supported.

If you are excited by solving complex technical problems, improving the reliability of production AI services and using engineering and AI to transform how service operations work, we would love to hear from you.

Additional Information
We embrace flexibility and hybrid work opportunities to support diverse needs and lifestyles, while also valuing inclusive workplace experiences. By fostering a sense of community, we drive innovation, strengthen connections, and nurture belonging. Our commitment ensures you can work in a way that suits you best, while also engaging with colleagues to share ideas and build meaningful relationships.

jobs.description:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) provides a highly reliable, scalable, low-cost infrastructure platform in the cloud that powers hundreds of thousands of businesses in 190 countries around the world. To meet the growing demand for AWS cloud computing capacity in EMEA (Europe, Middle East and Africa) we are now looking for a Commissioning Engineer to join the team.

Are you experienced in Critical Infrastructure Commissioning?

As a Data Center Commissioning Engineer (CxE), you will be part of highly creative, efficient team tasked with tackling fascinating and challenging problems building and supporting the operations of AWS owned data centres, Hybrid Colo's, Single Tennent Colo and Multi Tennent Colo builds . The AWS Commissioning team (ACx) understands, evaluates, defines and manages the expectations of construction quality in accordance to engineering designs to meet the customer requirements.

Key job responsibilities

You will be responsible for supporting vendors, contractors and other teams involved in the construction and commissioning of various systems such as:

-Medium and low voltage power systems

-Generators

-UPS

-HVAC

-Chilled Water Systems

-Building Management systems (BMS)

-Electrical Power Monitoring Systems (EPMS)

-Testing and balancing

-Pumps and Hydronic systems

The CxE shall provide multi-discipline input into the scheduling, test script development, designing, and planning of projects. In addition, the CxE will be required to review component submittal packages, lead Factory Witness Testing (FWT), perform system level and integrated system testing. During commissioning, the CxE will continuously audit activities to ensure compliance with environmental, quality, and safety requirements. Additionally, the individual will be responsible for comprehensive weekly reporting of status of all ongoing projects and lessons learned to continually improve the quality of our program. This position will include coverage of multiple inflight projects.

A day in the life

The CxE's daily focus is to ensure the commissioning quality and progress meet AWS's high standards by:

Developing commissioning standards.

Reviewing, comment on, and creating commissioning scripts L1-L5.

Organize and attend meetings highlighting AWS requirements and tracking overall build and commissioning progress and blockers.

Performing site walks to identify installation and testing deficiencies and maintain observation logs.

Manage on-site 3rd-party commissioning vendors to ensure coverage of all Cx-activities.

Gather, organize, and review design and commissioning documentation.

Work with AWS partner teams to resolve coordination and delivery issues and report on project health and completion.

About the team

The AWS Data Center Commissioning Team (ACx) is a wholly independent business within the DCCD organization. This team of veteran professional Electrical Engineers, Mechanical Engineers, Controls Engineers, Architectural Engineers, Project Managers, Operators and seasoned Amazonians are uniquely positioned to provide deeply detailed engineering and operational review and testing of equipment designs, operational functionality and construction practices. We are focused on ensuring the rapid delivery of a quality product while maintaining full transparency, recording metrics of manufacturer/contractor/equipment issues pre-PFHO, and identifying opportunities for all our peers and customers.

Basic qualifications
- 4+ years of industrial or commercial engineering in mission critical facilities including but not limited to: data centers, power generation or oil and gas facilities experience

- 4+ years of commissioning experience

- Experience in industrial or commercial engineering in mission critical facilities including but not limited to: data centers, power generation or oil and gas facilities

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field

- Bachelor's degree or above in civil engineering, structural engineering, or architectural engineering from an ABET accredited program

- PE (Professional Engineer) or SE (Structural Engineer) Engineering license

- Knowledge of Microsoft Office including Outlook, Word, and Excel

- Knowledge of building codes, regulations, and standards including IBC (International Building Code) and ASCE (American Society of Civil Engineers)

- Experience researching new designs, technologies, and construction methods of data center equipment and facilities

- Experience in commissioning

Preferred qualifications
- Experience reading, interpreting, and creating construction drawings, specifications, and submittal documents

- Experience in data center design, construction, operations, or facility maintenance

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers.
