jobs.title: Senior Security Engineer / Lead Security Engineer
jobs.description:
Job Description
As a Senior / Lead Security Engineer, you will provide technical leadership for security engineering across the organization. You will set technical direction, own critical security capabilities, drive cross-team security initiatives, and mentor engineers at all levels. You are accountable for the maturity and effectiveness of security engineering, balancing risk, delivery, and engineering realities.

This is a technical leadership role, not a people-management role — though it carries significant influence and mentorship responsibility.

Duties and accountabilities

Technical strategy and ownership

• Define and drive the technical direction for security engineering.

• Own critical security domains and capabilities end to end (AppSec, CloudSec, CI/CD security, vulnerability management).

• Set standards, patterns, and guardrails that scale across teams.

• Make and own high-impact, risk-based security decisions.

Cross-team leadership

• Lead security initiatives spanning multiple engineering teams.

• Act as the senior security point of contact for engineering leadership.

• Influence architecture and design across the organization.

• Align security efforts with business and delivery priorities.

Engineering and automation

• Drive security automation and tooling strategy (SAST, SCA, DAST, IaC, container security), including AI-assisted and AI-augmented tooling for triage, correlation, and remediation guidance.

• Evaluate and apply AI and generative AI tools — for example AI-assisted code review, AI-powered vulnerability triage, and LLM-based threat and log analysis — to improve signal quality, coverage, and developer experience, while validating their output rather than trusting it blindly.

• Ensure security platforms are reliable, scalable, and maintainable.

• Build the team's fluency with AI-assisted engineering tools (e.g., AI coding assistants, AI-enabled security scanners) and set guardrails for their safe, effective use, including awareness of AI/LLM-specific risks such as prompt injection, model and data supply-chain exposure, and sensitive-data leakage.

Risk, incident, and compliance

• Lead response and root-cause analysis for significant security incidents.

• Identify systemic risks and drive long-term remediation.

• Own security engineering input into compliance efforts (ISO 27001, SOC 2, FedRAMP).

• Coordinate external engagements (e.g., penetration testing vendors).

Mentorship and capability building

• Mentor engineers and emerging leads (including Associate Security Leads).

• Raise the overall security capability of engineering teams, including fluent, responsible use of AI-assisted tools.

• Champion a strong, pragmatic security culture.

What success looks like

• Security engineering direction is clear, pragmatic, and adopted.

• Critical risks are proactively identified and addressed.

• Engineering teams trust and act on security guidance.

• Security maturity improves measurably across the organization, including effective adoption of AI-assisted security tooling.

• Engineers grow under your mentorship.

Qualifications
• Typically 4+ years in security engineering, software engineering, or platform engineering.

• Proven track record owning security capabilities or programs at scale.

• Deep expertise across multiple domains (AppSec, CloudSec, CI/CD security, architecture).

• Strong hands-on engineering and automation background.

• Demonstrated technical leadership and cross-team influence.

• Practical fluency with AI tools in an engineering context — for example AI coding assistants, AI-assisted security scanning and triage, or LLM-based analysis — and the judgment to validate their output rather than trust it blindly.

• Demonstrated experience in security engineering with hands-on involvement in automated security solutions.

• Working knowledge of DevSecOps principles and practices.

• Practical experience with CI/CD tools (e.g., Bitbucket, Jenkins, GitLab, GitHub Actions, or equivalent).

• Proficiency in security platforms, vulnerability management tools, and at least one scripting language (e.g., Python, Bash).

• Comfort working with AI-assisted development and security tools (e.g., AI coding assistants, AI-driven SAST/DAST/SCA triage) as part of the day-to-day toolkit, with the judgment to review and validate AI-generated output.

• Solid understanding of common vulnerabilities (e.g., OWASP Top 10) and remediation approaches.

• Strong communication and collaboration skills with the ability to engage cross-functional teams.

• Familiarity with containerization tools (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes).

• Knowledge of security standards (e.g., NIST, ISO 27001, CIS).

Additional Information
We embrace flexibility and hybrid work opportunities to support diverse needs and lifestyles, while also valuing inclusive workplace experiences. By fostering a sense of community, we drive innovation, strengthen connections, and nurture belonging. Our commitment ensures you can work in a way that suits you best, while also engaging with colleagues to share ideas and build meaningful relationships.

jobs.title: AI Architect
jobs.description:
Job Description
Position Summary

The AI Architect is responsible for maintaining architectural coherence across GCS AI and Frictionless Time to Value (FTTV) initiatives. The role works at the front end of the process, participating in use-case and initiative shaping, backlog review, and initial solution definition before significant engineering effort is committed.

The architect reviews proposed AI applications and FTTV solutions to determine whether they align with GCS strategy, fit the existing application, process, and tooling landscape, and make appropriate use of existing knowledge, integrations, services, and reusable components. Working closely with AI Engineering and FTTV stakeholders, the architect helps define standards, reusable patterns, solution boundaries, and cross-initiative connection points.

This is a Senior Lead-level individual contributor role. It does not manage an engineering squad or replace AI Engineering accountability for detailed design, implementation, code quality, production readiness, or delivery assurance. The architect is not expected to be the sole expert in every technical domain, but is responsible for ensuring that the appropriate specialists review the solution.

Key Responsibilities

GCS AI and FTTV Solution Shaping

• Participate in the review and maintenance of the complete GCS AI backlog and the shaping of FTTV initiatives, with particular focus on work entering solution definition.

• Assess whether proposed applications and FTTV solutions support GCS strategy, process direction, and the intended tooling landscape.

• Identify duplicate, overlapping, unnecessarily isolated, or technically unclear proposals across the GCS AI backlog and FTTV initiatives before significant engineering effort is committed.

• Work with business stakeholders and AI Engineering to refine use cases, clarify solution boundaries, and identify dependencies, integration points, and ownership.

• Provide architecture input into GCS AI backlog and FTTV initiative decisions without assuming ownership of business prioritization.

Reuse, Integration, and Knowledge

• Identify where GCS AI applications and FTTV solutions should reuse existing services, integrations, knowledge assets, evaluation approaches, or common components.

• Work with AI Engineering to determine when a capability should be shared and when an application-specific implementation is more maintainable.

• Identify required connection points between solutions and ensure their purpose, ownership, and expected behavior are understood before implementation.

• Review how structured knowledge is created, organized, accessed, and reused across AI applications and related FTTV solutions.

• Promote consistent approaches to knowledge ownership, source traceability, permissions, versioning, update responsibility, and retirement.

• Challenge solution-specific knowledge stores when an appropriate governed source exists or is planned, while avoiding reuse that creates hidden coupling or unclear ownership.

Architecture Standards and Exceptions

• Work collaboratively with AI Engineering leads and developers to define practical architecture standards, reference patterns, and reusable approaches.

• Distinguish between mandatory constraints, preferred patterns, implementation guidance, and examples.

• Review how agreed standards are applied during solution shaping and propose changes when standards are unclear, outdated, or produce unintended results.

• Identify and document justified exceptions, including their scope, consequences, dependencies, and support implications.

• Present proposed exceptions for approval to Customer AI Experience leadership.

• Treat recurring exceptions as evidence that a standard may need to change rather than repeatedly bypassing it.

Specialist Review and Technical Alignment

• Determine which specialist perspectives are required for each proposed solution and involve them early enough to affect the design.

• Ensure appropriate review of material decisions involving security, privacy, responsible AI, enterprise architecture, data, integrations, infrastructure, business processes, and product platforms.

• Bring conflicting recommendations to the appropriate decision-makers with the options and trade-offs clearly stated.

• Confirm that specialist recommendations are reflected in the proposed architecture or are addressed through a documented and approved exception.

• Avoid making decisions on behalf of specialist functions where authority or expertise sits elsewhere.

Collaboration with AI Engineering and FTTV Stakeholders

• Act as an architectural counterpart to AI Engineering leads and FTTV stakeholders during initiative shaping and initial solution definition.

• Provide architectural direction without assuming responsibility for squad management or engineering delivery.

• Work directly with developers when technical detail is required to evaluate a design, dependency, reuse opportunity, or proposed standard.

• Use engineering and stakeholder feedback to test whether proposed standards and reusable approaches are practical.

• Support consistency across initiatives and engineering squads without introducing an additional approval layer for routine implementation decisions.

Technical Validation and Decision Traceability

• Remain technically current enough to challenge assumptions and evaluate proposed designs credibly.

• Prototype selected concepts, inspect implementations, or develop reference examples when needed to validate an architecture decision.

• Use technical validation selectively; the role is not intended to provide routine development capacity.

• Maintain a current view of the GCS AI and FTTV solution landscape, including major boundaries, shared capabilities, dependencies, integrations, and knowledge relationships.

• Document material architecture decisions, rationale, ownership, and approved exceptions at a level proportionate to the decision.

Strategic Alignment with Processes and Tooling

• Assess whether proposed AI applications and FTTV solutions support the intended direction of GCS business processes and operational tooling.

• Work with process, tooling, and functional owners to understand planned changes that may affect solution design.

• Identify proposals that automate temporary workarounds, reproduce process defects, or create competing sources of process logic.

• Make unresolved process or tooling dependencies visible before engineering commits to an approach.

• Support a coherent GCS AI and FTTV solution portfolio that can evolve as GCS processes and tooling change without requiring each application or initiative to be independently redesigned.

Qualifications
Required Experience

• Significant experience in software, solution, application, integration, data, or AI architecture across multiple applications or engineering teams.

• Experience shaping technical solutions before implementation and assessing application boundaries, dependencies, integration points, and reuse opportunities.

• Practical experience with AI-enabled applications, including large language models, retrieval-based solutions, agentic systems, and structured and unstructured knowledge.

• Strong understanding of modern software architecture, APIs, distributed systems, cloud services, identity, security, and integration approaches.

• Experience defining architecture standards and reusable patterns collaboratively with engineers.

• Ability to identify duplication, hidden coupling, weak ownership models, and design choices that create long-term maintenance problems.

• Ability to evaluate and explain technical trade-offs to engineering, business, and leadership audiences.

• Ability to work through influence without relying on line authority and to distinguish portfolio-level concerns from engineering implementation decisions.

• Sufficient hands-on technical capability to prototype concepts, inspect implementations, and validate architectural assumptions when necessary.

• Sound judgment about when to decide, when to involve a specialist, and when to escalate an unresolved trade-off.

Preferred Experience

• Experience designing or reviewing enterprise AI applications in production.

• Experience with retrieval-augmented generation, agent architectures, shared knowledge services, evaluation frameworks, and AI observability.

• Experience with Azure AI services, Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, or comparable enterprise AI platforms.

• Experience with API-first, event-driven, microservice, and cloud-native solution patterns.

• Experience defining reusable components or platform capabilities across multiple teams.

• Experience with enterprise business applications, ERP, customer delivery, or service-delivery processes.

• Familiarity with GCS, FTTV, delivery tooling, and AI adoption priorities.

• Experience operating at Senior Lead, Principal, or equivalent individual-contributor level.

Additional Information
We embrace flexibility and hybrid work opportunities to support diverse needs and lifestyles, while also valuing inclusive workplace experiences. By fostering a sense of community, we drive innovation, strengthen connections, and nurture belonging. Our commitment ensures you can work in a way that suits you best, while also engaging with colleagues to share ideas and build meaningful relationships.

jobs.title: Help Desk Analyst (IGT1)
locations: Port City, Western Province, Sri Lanka
jobs.description:
Job Description
About Sitecore:

Sitecore delivers a composable digital experience platform that empowers the world’s smartest and largest brands to build lifelong relationships with their customers. A highly decorated industry leader, Sitecore is the leading company bringing together content, commerce, and data into one connected platform that delivers millions of digital experiences every day. Thousands of blue-chip companies including American Express, Porsche, Starbucks, L’Oréal, and Volvo Cars rely on Sitecore to provide more engaging, personalized experiences for their customers.

About the position:

The Help Desk Analyst is responsible for providing Level 1 and Level 2 technical support to end users across APAC, EMEA, and North America within a 24x5 roster based support environment.

The role acts as a first point of contact for users experiencing IT issues or requiring technical assistance. The successful candidate will be expected to demonstrate strong troubleshooting, ticket ownership, communication, and customer service skills while supporting a broad range of technologies, including Microsoft 365, Windows, macOS, mobile platforms, end user hardware, networking, identity and access, and cloud services.

The Help Desk Analyst will work collaboratively with L3 engineering teams, infrastructure teams, application support teams, and third-party vendors to ensure issues are resolved efficiently and users receive high quality support experience.

This Help Desk team plays a key role in delivering excellent end user experience across Sitecore. With a strong focus on end user services, responsiveness, and ownership. The team supports Sitecore end users globally while maintaining consistently high standards of technical support and service quality. The right candidate will need to fulfill this standard.

Key Responsibilities:

• Provide L1 and L2 technical support to end users located globally across APAC, EMEA and North America on a 24x5 rotating roster.
• Perform effective ticket triage, including gathering relevant information, assessing impact and urgency, categorizing issues correctly, and determining the appropriate resolution or escalation path.
• Diagnose, troubleshoot and resolve hardware, software, network, connectivity, and cloud service issues.
• Support Microsoft 365 services, including Exchange, MS Teams, SharePoint, Outlook, OneDrive and other Microsoft 365 applications.
• Assist with Exchange Administration, including mailbox related requests, distribution lists, security groups, and other supporting configurations.
• Assist with the administration and support of SharePoint Online sites, document libraries, access, and permissions.
• Support Microsoft Teams requests, including team and channel creation, Teams Phone number assignments, external collaboration, and B2B related configurations where applicable.
• User ServiceNow to manage Universal Requests, incidents, problems, service requests and knowledge management activities.
• Take ownership of assigned tickets from initial engagement through resolution or escalation, ensuring tickets are reviewed, updated, and followed up daily.
• Troubleshoot end-user issues across Windows, macOS, iOS, and Android operating systems.
• Handle password resets, account unlocks, authentication issues, and access-related requests across supported systems, following established security and identity verification procedures.
• Deliver a high standard of customer service through ServiceNow, Microsoft Teams, and other approved support channels.
• Communicate technical information clearly to users with varying levels of technical knowledge.
• Identify recurring issues and knowledge gaps and proactively contribute new or improved support content.
• Create, review, and maintain Knowledge Base Articles, technical documentation, troubleshooting guides, procedures, and operational reports.
• Escalate complex, high-impact, or unresolved technical issues to L3 engineering teams, specialist support teams, or third-party vendors, providing complete troubleshooting details and relevant diagnostic information.
• Collaborate with internal IT teams to identify recurring incidents, contribute to problem management, and improve the overall end-user support experience.
• Follow established IT service management, security, access control, and operational procedures.

Qualifications
Required Skills & Experience:

• Minimum 3+ years of experience in an IT Help Desk, Service Desk, Desktop Support, or End User Support role, with experience providing remote technical support to users on a global scale.
• Proven experience providing L1 and L2 technical support within an enterprise environment, including effective troubleshooting, ticket triage, resolution, and escalation.
• Strong knowledge and hands-on experience with ServiceNow, including Incident Management, Request Management, Problem Management, and Knowledge Management.
• Strong knowledge of the ITIL framework, the IT support lifecycle, associated service management methodologies, and their practical application within a Service Desk environment.
• Ability to take end-to-end ownership of support tickets, including initial triage, troubleshooting, user communication, follow-up, resolution, documentation, and appropriate escalation.
• Strong understanding of working within SLAs, operational targets, escalation procedures, and service quality standards.
• Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to prioritize multiple requests based on impact, urgency, and business requirements.
• Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain technical issues and solutions in clear, non-technical language to end users with varying levels of technical knowledge.
• Strong customer service and end user experience mindset, demonstrating empathy, professionalism, ownership, responsiveness, and a commitment to delivering consistently high-quality support.
• Ability to work effectively with L3 Engineering teams, infrastructure teams, application support teams, and third-party vendors when escalating or coordinating complex technical issues.
• Sound knowledge and/or hands-on administrative experience with Microsoft 365 technologies, including Exchange, SharePoint, Microsoft Teams, AzureAD and Microsoft Intune would be an added advantage.
• Experience supporting Microsoft Exchange administration, including mailboxes, distribution lists, security groups, permissions, and other messaging-related requests.
• Experience supporting Microsoft Teams administration, including teams and channels, external/B2B collaboration, permissions, and Teams Phone-related requests.
• Experience supporting SharePoint administration, including sites, document libraries, permissions, and user access-related requests.

jobs.title: Assistant Director, Academic Resource Analytics and Reporting
jobs.description:
Position Summary
Applications are welcome from all qualified candidates. In line with UAE regulations, Emirati candidates are encouraged to apply.

New York University Abu Dhabi (NYUAD) seeks to appoint an Assistant Director, academic Resource Analytics and Reporting, reporting to the Director of academic Resource Management and Fiscal affairs.

The Assistant Director, Academic Resource Analytics and Reporting leads the data analytics, management reporting and business solutions capability of the Office of Academic Resource Management and Fiscal Affairs (OARMFA). Reporting to the Director, the position delivers financial analysis and actionable insight across the University’s academic and research portfolios to support executive decision-making. Responsibilities include executive management reporting, financial forecasting and modelling, defining business requirements for reporting and workflow solutions, access and Delegation of Authority governance review, and continuous process improvement.

The position consolidates data across all OARMFA pillars — Academic Budget and Resource Planning, Research Financial Administration, and Fiscal Affairs/Academic Operations — to deliver timely, consistent reporting across all fund types, and collaborates closely with Finance, Institutional Research and Analytics, University technology functions and Shared Services to align core systems, source data and technical solutions. The position does not hold portfolio accountability for the areas it serves; it provides the models, methodologies, systems capability and reporting that allow those teams to operate.

Key Responsibilities:

Academic Resource Analytics and Management Reporting

• Lead the preparation and delivery of executive management reporting and analytical insight across OARMFA academic and research areas.
• Produce regular reporting for executive leadership covering budgets, actuals, commitments, multi-year forecasts, resource utilization, staffing and key performance indicators.
• Coordinate and consolidate data streams for monthly management reporting, quarterly reviews, and institutional or regulatory deliverables.
• Analyze financial and operational data to identify trends, evaluate variances, surface emerging risks and recommend corrective action.
• Design dashboards, executive reporting packages and briefing summaries that translate complex financial datasets into clear strategic insight.
• Oversee reporting across all fund structures, including academic and administrative staffing, sponsored projects and designated Fund 77 operations.
• Manage the office reporting calendar and ensure alignment and delivery across all OARMFA pillars.

Research Financial Administration integration

• Partner with the Associate Director and the Research Financial Administration (RFA) team to ensure research portfolio metrics are accurately integrated into executive reports.
• Provide standardized reporting methodologies, dataset structures and analytical toolkits to support research financial oversight.

Fiscal Affairs / Academic Operations integration

• Collaborate with Fiscal Affairs/Academic Operations to consolidate divisional financial projections and operational inputs from academic units.
• Convert unit-level operational inputs into unified, executive-ready analytical reports for leadership review.
• Ensure all reporting reflects current commitments, actual operational activity and emerging administrative data.

Business Systems and Solutions

• Identify reporting, system and workflow needs across OARMFA and translate them into functional business requirements for technology solutions.
• Lead OARMFA's participation in implementing and enhancing reporting software, automated workflows and business systems supporting research and academic finance.
• Work with institutional system owners, technology teams and delivery partners to ensure OARMFA's business requirements are reflected in delivered solutions.
• Coordinate user acceptance testing (UAT), solution rollouts, change management and user training across the office.
• Manage the ongoing business administration of designated tools and workflows, including business requirements, user needs and coordination of issues with the relevant system owners.
• Serve as OARMFA's designated reviewer for access to designated systems, chartfields and Delegation of Authority (DoA), ensuring access is appropriate to each individual's role, responsibilities and approved authority.
• Audit and maintain chartfield permissions, DoA controls and system roles to ensure proper segregation of duties and security compliance, updating them promptly as roles change and identifying and removing legacy, inactive or inappropriate access.
• Coordinate approved access changes with the relevant institutional system owners, maintaining documentation and an audit trail, while technical provisioning and system administration remain with those functions.
• Monitor implemented solutions and coordinate enhancements where changing academic, research or administrative requirements create new business needs.
• Maintain standard operating procedures, process documentation and technical guidebooks for critical office applications and tools, supporting continuity and consistent use.
• Promote knowledge sharing and documentation to safeguard business continuity across OARMFA systems.

Academic Budget and Resource Planning systems

• Support the implementation and continuous improvement of planning applications used for position control, hiring plans and academic budgeting.
• Translate Pillar 1 functional needs into technical enhancements and automated reporting solutions.

Research Financial Administration systems

• Oversee system set-up and business administration for key research administration software tools and workflows.
• Provide functional leadership and guidance to the Research Financial Administrator on data management, software tools and operational workflows.
• Collaborate with RFA leadership to identify software feature requests and reporting requirements for research grant management.

Fiscal Affairs / Academic Operations systems

• Maintain applications and automated workflows supporting divisional reporting, expenditure tracking and routine operational approvals.
• Work with Fiscal Affairs to ensure academic unit operational requirements are integrated into system solutions and office workflows.
• Shared Services and Business Process Coordination
• Serve as OARMFA's primary operational liaison to Shared Services and centralised administrative service providers across the University.
• Streamline cross-functional processes and resolve transactional issues involving platforms such as AdminLink, Upwork, Concur and iBuy.
• Track open transactions and systemic processing delays to prevent adverse impact on financial commitments, accruals and faculty service delivery.
• Act as a central escalation and triage point for complex, cross-functional operational issues, ensuring proper routing to functional owners.
• Facilitate clear communication between Shared Services and OARMFA team members where processing activity affects financial forecasts or reporting deadlines.
• Drive implementation and adoption of new Shared Services platforms and procedures within OARMFA.
• Identify recurring operational bottlenecks and partner with University administrative teams to implement process improvements.

Cross-pillar application

• Ensure operational issues originating in Shared Services are transparent to portfolio leads in Pillars 1, 2 and 3 and reflected in financial risk modelling.
• Maintain open channels with administrative partners so that transactional processing aligns with financial forecasts.
• Establish matrixed functional support relationships across teams to reduce administrative silos and streamline operations.

Process Improvement, Standards and Advisory Support

• Lead continuous business process improvement across OARMFA, strengthening data accuracy, workflow efficiency, internal controls and service quality.
• Eliminate redundant manual processes by maximising the capability of enterprise systems and centralised data repositories.
• Collaborate across OARMFA pillars to establish unified standards for modelling, reporting formats and operational procedures.
• Evaluate policy modifications and regulatory changes to determine their operational, reporting and systems impact on the office.
• Provide subject matter expertise for strategic initiatives, ad hoc institutional projects and executive decision support.
• Mentor OARMFA staff on financial modelling techniques, reporting software, data analysis and workflow standard operating procedures.
• Advise the Director on long-term strategies to strengthen the team's analytical capability and operational performance.

Requirements

Technical Skills

• Solid grounding in OOP/SOLID principles, design patterns, and data structures & algorithms.

• Working knowledge of foundational secure programming and data privacy concepts.

• Comfortable with version control, branching strategies, and CI/CD basics.

• Familiarity with at least one cloud platform (AWS/GCP/Azure) and willingness to contribute to cloud/DevOps tasks with guidance.

• Experience using AI coding assistants for development tasks, with the judgment to validate AI-generated output before use.

Leadership & Soft Skills

• Strong verbal and written communication; comfortable participating actively in agile ceremonies.

• Reliable task estimation and self-management within a defined project methodology.

• A proactive, independent learning mindset with willingness to research and self-improve.

Experience & Education

jobs.title: Security Delivery Senior Analyst (SOC L2)
jobs.description:
As a Security Delivery Senior Analyst, you will play a key role within Security Operations, taking ownership of security events escalated from L1 analysts and performing deeper triage, investigation and analysis. You will help ensure incidents are handled consistently according to established processes and runbooks, while contributing to stronger playbooks, incident response procedures and SIEM detection use cases.

What You’ll Do

Incident Triage & Investigation

• Take ownership of security incidents and events escalated from L1 analysts and handle them according to defined SOC processes and procedures.
• Perform detailed triage, validation and investigation of detected and escalated security events.
• Analyze and categorize events of interest according to agreed severity levels, escalation criteria and runbooks.
• Correlate available security information to determine the nature, scope and potential impact of suspicious activity.
• Escalate complex or high-risk incidents through the appropriate response channels where required.
• Maintain accurate investigation findings, evidence and incident documentation.

SIEM & Detection Support

• Work closely with SIEM administrators and security engineering teams to support the creation and enhancement of security-monitoring use cases.
• Provide investigation insights that can help identify opportunities to improve existing detection logic.
• Support testing and refinement of SIEM use cases based on operational security requirements.
• Identify potential detection gaps observed during incident investigations and raise them with the appropriate security teams.

SOC Procedures & Continuous Improvement

• Develop, maintain and continuously improve Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), investigation playbooks and Incident Response plans.
• Help standardize investigation and triage practices to promote consistent incident handling across the SOC.
• Capture lessons learned from investigations and contribute to improvements in operational processes.
• Collaborate with L1 analysts and other security teams to support effective incident handling and knowledge sharing.

What You’ll Need

• Experience working within a Security Operations Center (SOC) or cybersecurity monitoring environment.
• Hands-on experience with security event triage, investigation and incident escalation.
• Good understanding of Incident Response processes, SOC procedures and security runbooks.
• Experience using Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) technologies.
• Ability to investigate and correlate security events and identify potentially malicious activity.
• Understanding of security alerts, event severity classification and escalation processes.
• Experience creating or maintaining SOPs, playbooks and Incident Response documentation.
• Understanding of SIEM detection use cases and correlation rules.
• Strong analytical, troubleshooting and problem-solving capabilities.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills with attention to detail.

Bonus Points If You Have

• Experience supporting SIEM use-case development or detection tuning.
• Exposure to EDR, SOAR, endpoint security or other security-monitoring technologies.
• Familiarity with MITRE ATT&CK and common attack techniques.
• Experience with threat hunting or deeper incident investigation.
• Relevant cybersecurity or SOC certifications.

About Accenture
Accenture is a leading global professional services company that helps the world’s leading businesses, governments and other organizations build their digital core, optimize their operations, accelerate revenue growth and enhance citizen services—creating tangible value at speed and scale. We are a talent- and innovation-led company with approximately 791,000 people serving clients in more than 120 countries. Technology is at the core of change today, and we are one of the world’s leaders in helping drive that change, with strong ecosystem relationships. jobs.description:
DESCRIPTION:

Amazon Operations sits at the heart of the Amazon customer experience. We look after everything from the moment a customer clicks buy, to the moment their item is delivered – from desktop to doorstep.



Across Europe we have more than 50 Fulfillment Centers, hundreds of Delivery Stations, thousands of machines, and tens of thousands of employees, all working together in harmony to make sure the right item gets delivered to the right person, in the right place, at the right time.



Working in Amazon Operations is for people who like to be active and give their all. We work in a busy, dynamic environment and are part of a bigger team delivering on the expectations of millions of customers every single day.

We are open, inclusive and welcome individuality and diversity. The culture in our Operation is built on the way teams bond and the work ethic that enables our business run like clockwork. Our teams take pride in a job well done, looking out for one another, ensuring the highest safety standards and playing their part in delivering the quality service Amazon is known for around the world.



Join us in the Amazon Reliability Maintenance Engineering team. We maintain and optimize technologies in the Global Amazon Warehouse & Delivery Network.



PURPOSE OF THE JOB:

We are looking for motivated, customer-focused people who want to join our team as an Automation Engineer (AE).

The focus of the AE role is to fault find, troubleshoot and improve controls solutions for automated material handling equipment such as conveyors, sortation systems, scanners, cameras, print and apply systems, scales, Human-Machine Interface (HMI) systems, and control cabinets. The AE will also provide training to the Engineering Technicians on device troubleshooting and preventive maintenance.



RESPONSIBILITIES:

- Be the site level Subject Matter Expert (SME) for all controls systems and sensors within the building. Work in a hands-on manner to actively monitor, fault find and repair systems in order to provide a high level of equipment availability to internal customers.

- Train technicians in the basics of control systems fault finding in order to raise the level of knowledge within the site.

- Work within the EU Controls network to enhance the capability to monitor Material Handling Equipment (MHE) metrics and provide visualization and data to internal customers by means of troubleshooting and prioritizing.

- Actively participate in or own continuous improvement projects coordinated by the EU Controls network.

- Work with IT, EU Controls Engineering and Operations Engineering to ensure all systems are correctly documented and that accurate backup libraries are maintained.

- Work alongside global teams to support the installation and commission of new equipment.

- Support other sites in the EU network as required.

- Interpreting both mechanical and electrical drawings plus understanding and developing improvement strategies for code conforming to IEC 61131-3.





Key job responsibilities

The AE keeps the controls and automation systems on site running safely and reliably. The AE works with the RME team, Operations, and vendors. Main duties are:

Review controls issues every day using SCADA, OEE, WCS, and the Monitor Portal.

Make sure policies are followed, including MCM and software backups.

Support new projects and equipment removals. This means checking controls deliverables, backups, and documentation.

Track overdue controls PMs and escalate anything that stays open.

Inspect configurable spare parts, such as VFDs and bus gateways, before they are received.

Train the site RME team and buddy sites on controls basics, and keep the skills matrix up to date.

Audit SCADA and OEE measuring points every month so the data stays accurate.

Lead Peak and Prime readiness checks, post-mortem reviews, and the yearly site contingency plan.

A day in the life

The AE starts the day with the 15 minute Daily Area Stand-up. The team reviews the night's handover, the plan for the day, vendors on site, and PMs. After that, the AE checks the dashboards for controls problems and looks for repeat faults.

During the shift, the AE supports the field team on PLCs, scanners, VFDs, and conveyor controls. The AE checks that backups and change management rules are followed. The AE also reviews spare parts waiting for inspection and follows up on overdue PMs with the planner and technicians.

When a serious event happens, the AE calls the vendor hotline first. Then the AE sends the written update with the error details, the area affected, and the first findings. If the issue needs deeper help, the AE raises a SIM ticket with the Central AE Tech Pillars team.

Each week, the AE joins the RME leadership and team meetings and supports the WBR with KPI data. The AE also meets with senior Operations on flow and improvement ideas.

Basic qualifications
- BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

-Relevant experience with PLC controlled automation and issue diagnosis in a continuous process or production environment.

- Experience supporting a wide range of different conveyors and sortation systems.

- Experience in dealing with material handling, flow and capacity visualization and monitoring.

- Experience with Microsoft Office, SolidWorks, Ignition, Visio and AutoCAD.

- Ability to communicate (written & verbal) in English

Preferred qualifications
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

· Electrical or mechanical training degree in computer science, mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, or related fields.

· Understanding of ISO 13849 & 62061

· Familiarity with CE Machinery Directive.

· Experience in a multi-site environment.

· Project management experience.

· Knowledge of Six Sigma, data analysis and process improvement techniques.

jobs.summary: Join our team as a Lead Analyst - SOC Monitoring (CPX), where you will manage SOC operations, lead incident response, and provide technical guidance to teams. This role suits an experienced professional with strong technical expertise and leadership skills, ideally with a background in information security and large-scale ICT environments.
jobs.description:
Overview:


The Lead SOC Analyst is responsible for managing the day-to-day activities of the SOC Monitoring, Incident Detection, and Response Operations. The role involves collaborating with internal and client teams to identify and respond to threats and vulnerabilities and providing technical expertise and guidance to support incident response efforts. This position requires strong technical expertise, leadership skills, and the ability to mentor and develop team members.

Responsibilities:


SOC Operations Management:

• Lead and manage daily SOC activities and ensure efficient monitoring of security systems.
• Oversee the triage, investigation, and resolution of security incidents.
• Ensure incident handling aligns with defined SLAs and escalation procedures.

Incident Response & Threat Management:

• Coordinate and lead incident response efforts.
• Analyze and respond to complex threats using threat intelligence and advanced detection techniques.
• Oversee triage, investigation, and remediation of security events an incident.
• Lead major incident investigations and coordinate with other teams such as Incident Response, Threat Hunting, and CTI functions.

Team Leadership & Development:

• Mentor and guide SOC analysts.
• Conduct training sessions and promote continuous learning.

Security Tools & SIEM Management:

• Manage and optimize SIEM tools and other security technologies.
• Ensure effective integration of tools for comprehensive monitoring.
• Correlate security events from SIEM, EDR, Firewall, IDS/IPS etc.

• Validate and fine tune detection rules, correlation searches, and threat models.
• Identify automation opportunities to reduce mean time to detect (MTTD) and mean time to respond (MTTR).

Threat Hunting & Vulnerability Management:

• Proactively identify threats lurking in the environment by conducting threat hunting exercises.
• Oversee vulnerability scanning and patch management.
• Work closely with CTI and Threat Hunters to integrate IOCs, TTPs, and MITRE ATT&CK coverage to enhance detection posture overall.

Reporting & Compliance:

• Generate detailed reports on incidents, trends, and SOC performance.
• Ensure compliance with industry standards and regulatory requirements.
• Provide regular operational metrices and incident reports to senior management.

Collaboration & Strategy:

• Work closely with IT, Cloud, Application, Risk, and Security teams for cross-functional incident handling.
• Contribute to the development of security policies and procedures.
• Highly result oriented and able to work independently.
• Good analytical, technical, written, and verbal communication skills.
• Ability to multi-task in a fast-paced and demanding work environment.
• Comfortable with a high-tech work environment and constantly learning new tools and innovations.
• Self-motivated, curious, and knowledgeable ab information security news and current events.

Qualifications:


Bachelor’s degree in engineering, computer science, information systems, or quantitative fields.

• ISC² Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP)
• CISM Certified Information Security Manager
• GIAC Certifications
• Minimum of 10+ years’ relevant experience or working in a large-scale ICT environment focused on Information/Cyber Security.
• High-level understanding of TCP/IP protocol and OSI Seven Layer Mode.
• Knowledge of security best practices and concepts.
• Knowledge of Windows and/or Unix-based systems/architectures and related security.
• Sound level of knowledge of LAN/WAN technologies.
• Must have a solid understanding of information technology and information security.
• Expertise in incident response and handling methodologies.
• Knowledge of Cyber kill chain, blockchain, and other IR frameworks.
• Knowledge of Defense-in-depth techniques.
• Knowledge of security event correlation and analytics tools.
• Skill in recognizing and categorizing types of vulnerabilities and associated attacks.
• Knowledge of system and application security threats and vulnerabilities (e.g., buffer overflow, mobile code, cross-site scripting, Procedural Language/Structured Query Language [PL/SQL] and injections, covert channel, replay attacks, malicious code).
• Knowledge of which system files (e.g., log files, registry files, and configuration files) contain relevant information and where to find those system files.
• Experience with SIEM tool – preferably proficient with developing correlation rules, dashboards, and custom searches.
• Experience with automated incident response tools (PSTools, Sysmon, Carbon Black, etc.).
• Experience with packet capture and analysis (tcpdump/windump, Wireshark, etc.).
• Experience with host and network forensics.
• Strong understanding of security architectures and devices.
• Strong understanding of threat intelligence consumption and management.
• Strong understanding of root causes of malware infections and proactive mitigation.
• Strong understanding of lateral movement, footholds, and data exfiltration techniques.
• Experience with host and network practices of processing digital forensic data.
• Knowledge of forensic processes for seizing and preserving digital evidence (e.g., the chain of custody).
•

Knowledge of server, network devices, security devices and diagnostic tools, and fault identification techniques

jobs.title: Principal Systems Engineer - Mission Systems
jobs.description:
ABOUT EDGE


At EDGE bold ideas are engineered into technologies that protect, improve and save lives.

Headquartered in the United Arab Emirates, EDGE is a leading advanced technology group working at the forefront of defence and emerging technologies. Spanning more than 35 specialised companies and multiple centres of excellence, we are purpose-built to move fast. Free from heavy legacy processes, we give our people the autonomy, accountability, and agility to bring breakthrough technologies from concept to reality.

Based in Abu Dhabi, a globally connected hub at the crossroads of Europe, Asia, Africa, and the Middle East, EDGE is home to a truly multicultural community where bold ideas thrive, and the future is shaped.

Together, we are shaping the future.

ABOUT THE ROLE


ADASI, a leading UAE-based developer of autonomous systems and advanced unmanned solutions, is at the forefront of innovation in the aerospace and defence industry. As part of its commitment to developing advanced UAV capabilities, ADASI is seeking an experienced Principal Engineer - Mission Systems to lead the design, development, integration and verification of advanced avionics and mission systems for unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs).

The role will provide technical leadership across mission systems architecture, avionics integration, mission payloads, communication systems and system safety. The successful candidate will work closely with multidisciplinary engineering teams, suppliers and operational stakeholders to ensure system performance, reliability, safety and mission readiness throughout the development lifecycle.

RESPONSIBILITIES


• Define and manage system-level requirements, avionics architecture and Interface Control Documents (ICDs) for UAV mission systems.

• Lead the integration of avionics, mission computers, navigation systems, communication systems and mission payloads, including EO/IR, SIGINT, radar and other ISR equipment.

• Manage hardware and software interfaces, technical trade studies and system-level design activities.

• Develop and review system safety assessments, including FHA, FMEA and PSSA/SSA.

• Ensure compliance with applicable aerospace and defence standards, including SAE ARP 4754, SAE ARP 4761, DO-178C, DO-254 and MIL-STD requirements.

• Lead system verification and validation activities, including simulation, Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL), ground testing and flight testing.

• Analyse test results and telemetry data to verify system performance against requirements.

• Manage technical interfaces and monitor supplier design, integration and verification activities.Prepare and review technical documentation, system specifications, verification plans, test reports and design review deliverables.

• Provide technical leadership during system design reviews, integration campaigns and flight test activities.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS


• Bachelor's degree in Avionics Engineering, Electrical/Electronic Engineering, Aerospace Engineering or a closely related discipline.

• Minimum 15+ years of relevant experience in UAV, aerospace or defence avionics/mission systems engineering.

• Demonstrated experience in avionics system design, architecture and integration on UAV or aerospace platforms.

• Proven experience integrating mission payloads such as EO/IR, SIGINT, radar, LiDAR, navigation or communication systems.

• Strong understanding of avionics communication protocols, including MIL-STD-1553, ARINC 429, CAN, Ethernet or RS-422.

• Experience in system requirements management, interface definition, verification and validation.

• Knowledge of system safety, certification, qualification and aerospace/defence compliance processes.

• Professional proficiency in written and spoken English.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS


• Master's degree in Electrical/Electronic Engineering, Avionics Systems, Mission Systems or Systems Engineering.

• Experience with UAV command and control systems, RF communication, datalinks and real-time mission data processing.

• Familiarity with embedded operating systems such as VxWorks, QNX or Embedded Linux.

• Proficiency in systems engineering tools such as IBM DOORS, Polarion, SysML or UML.

• Experience with simulation environments, HIL testing, telemetry analysis and flight test campaigns.

• Knowledge of SAE ARP 4754, SAE ARP 4761, MIL-STD-882, DO-178C, DO-254, MIL-STD-461 and MIL-STD-810.

• INCOSE ASEP/CSEP certification is strongly preferred.

• Training or certification in DO-178C, DO-254, cybersecurity/DO-326 or CISSP is advantageous.

• Familiarity with AS9100 and ISO 9001 quality management systems.

• Experience in supplier technical management and multidisciplinary engineering leadership.

• Must be eligible for applicable UAE defence/security clearance.

• Willingness to relocate to the UAE and undertake domestic and international travel for supplier visits, integration and test campaigns.

• Arabic language proficiency is an added advantage.

WHY CHOOSE EDGE


Launched in November 2019, the UAE's EDGE is one of the world's leading advanced technology groups, established to develop agile, bold and disruptive solutions for defence and beyond, and to be a catalyst for change and transformation. It is dedicated to bringing breakthrough innovations, products, and services to market with greater speed and efficiency, to position the UAE as a leading global hub for future industries, and to creating clear paths within the sector for the next generation of highly skilled talent to thrive.

At EDGE, the real investment goes beyond compensation. Through our dedicated learning academy and digital learning platforms, employees have access to extensive opportunities to develop new skills, deepen their expertise, and advance their careers. Combined with the freedom to innovate, strong career support, and the opportunity to collaborate with world-class talent from across the globe, EDGE is a place where you can continue to grow, keep learning, and turn ambitious ideas into meaningful outcomes.

Working at EDGE also comes with a package that genuinely reflects how much we value our people. Salaries are highly competitive and tax-free and, depending on your role and seniority, benefits can include family visas, annual flight tickets, medical insurance for you and your dependents, and education allowances for your children.

CANDIDATE PRIVACY & EQUAL OPPORTUNITY STATEMENT


If you feel your skills, experience and potential are a strong match for a role, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement. We are genuinely interested in what you can bring to EDGE.

Any information you share as part of your EDGE candidate profile or job application will be handled in accordance with applicable data protection and privacy regulations.

EDGE is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and high-performing workforce. We believe every individual deserves to be treated with fairness, respect and dignity, and our employment decisions reflect that. We do not discriminate based on race, colour, nationality, ethnicity, religion, gender, marital status, age, disability, pregnancy or parental status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

As a global organisation, effective collaboration across international teams is central to how we work, so English proficiency is required for all roles unless otherwise stated in the job posting.

Please note that EDGE does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruitment agencies. Any resumes in the absence of a formally executed agreement in place will be deemed the property of EDGE, and no placement fees or compensation will be payable in respect of such submissions.

jobs.title: Specialist, AI Agent
jobs.description:
Department: AI Hub Innovation

JOB SUMMARY / INTRODUCTION:

The AI Agent Specialist serves as the dedicated enablement partner for senior executives, helping them maximize value from AI-powered personal assistants and agentic technologies. Acting as a trusted advisor and first point of contact, the role focuses on executive onboarding, AI agent configuration, prompt engineering, troubleshooting, adoption support, and continuous optimization of platforms such as Microsoft Copilot and Agentic AI solutions. The role combines business acumen, executive stakeholder management, and hands-on Generative AI expertise to help leaders integrate AI effectively into daily decision-making and productivity workflows.

Key Accountabilities:

• Operate in accordance with FAB policies, governance requirements, risk controls, regulatory obligations, and information security standards.
• Maintain confidentiality and exercise sound judgment when supporting senior executives and handling sensitive business information.
• Collaborate effectively with business, technology, security, infrastructure, platform, and governance stakeholders.
• Promote responsible AI use, continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and high standards of service delivery.

Executive AI Enablement & Support:

• Provide high-touch, concierge-style support to executives using AI-powered personal assistants and agents.
• Serve as the primary point of contact for AI-related queries, issues, enhancement requests, and adoption support.
• Translate executive priorities and working styles into tailored AI agent configurations and workflows.
• Monitor adoption, usage patterns, and effectiveness, proactively identifying opportunities to increase value realization.

AI Agent Configuration & Optimization:

• Configure, customize, and maintain executive AI agents across platforms such as Microsoft Copilot, AgenticAD, and future enterprise AI solutions.
• Design and optimize prompts, workflows, and automation capabilities to improve output quality and business relevance.
• Continuously enhance AI agent performance based on executive feedback and evolving requirements.
• Maintain agent templates, prompt libraries, and best practices for reuse across leadership teams.

Executive Onboarding & Training:

• Lead onboarding sessions for executives, ensuring successful setup and adoption of AI assistants.
• Deliver personalized coaching and walkthroughs tailored to each executive's role and objectives.
• Develop quick-reference guides, playbooks, and training materials to support ongoing usage.
• Act as an advocate for AI adoption, helping leaders embed AI into their day-to-day workflows.

Troubleshooting & Service Management:

• Diagnose and resolve issues related to AI platforms, Microsoft 365 integrations, permissions, data access, and agent behaviour.
• Coordinate with engineering, platform, security, and infrastructure teams to resolve technical issues.
• Track and manage incidents through resolution while maintaining high service standards for executive stakeholders.
• Document recurring issues and implement preventive measures.

Governance & Risk Management:

• Ensure AI agent usage aligns with FAB policies, AI governance standards, data privacy requirements, and regulatory obligations.
• Promote secure and responsible AI practices among executive users.
• Support governance reviews and adoption reporting activities as required.

Success Measures:

• Executive satisfaction and adoption rates.
• Growth in active usage of executive AI agents.
• Time to resolution of support issues.
• AI onboarding completion and engagement metrics.
• Improvements in executive productivity and AI utilization.
• Compliance with AI governance and data privacy standards.

Frameworks, Boundaries, & Decision Making Authority:

• Works within FAB AI governance, data privacy, information security, access management, regulatory, and technology service-management frameworks.
• Configures and optimizes approved AI agents, prompts, and workflows within authorized platforms and access rights.
• Escalates material security, privacy, regulatory, data-access, platform, or reputational concerns to the accountable control or technology owner.
• Recommends enhancements and adoption interventions; final decisions on platform changes, production deployment, access, and governance exceptions remain with designated accountable owners.

REQUIREMENTS / QUALIFICATIONS

Education:

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related discipline.xperience
• 2-4 years of experience in AI enablement, digital workplace support, technology adoption, executive support, consulting, or similar roles.
• Experience supporting senior stakeholders or executives in a fast-paced corporate environment.
• Exposure to Generative AI solutions, Microsoft Copilot, digital workplace technologies, or automation tools.

Technical Skills:

• Strong understanding of Microsoft 365, Microsoft Copilot, and Generative AI applications.
• Practical experience in prompt engineering and AI workflow optimization.
• Familiarity with agentic AI platforms, automation tools, and conversational AI technologies.
• Understanding of AI governance, responsible AI principles, and data privacy requirements.
• Competency in troubleshooting and supporting enterprise technology platforms.

Professional Skills:

• Excellent communication and presentation skills.
• Strong executive presence and stakeholder management capabilities.
• Ability to explain technical concepts in simple business language.
• Highly organized, with strong attention to detail and customer service orientation.
• Problem-solving mindset with a focus on delivering practical outcomes.

Technical Competencies:

• Microsoft 365 and Microsoft Copilot
• Generative AI and agentic AI platforms
• Prompt engineering and AI workflow optimization
• Executive AI agent configuration and support
• Enterprise technology troubleshooting and service management
• AI governance, responsible AI, data privacy, and access controls
• Adoption analytics, reporting, and continuous optimization
• Training material and playbook development

Behavioural Competencies:

• Executive presence and stakeholder partnership
• Customer focus and service excellence
• Clear communication and influencing
• Problem solving and sound judgment
• Confidentiality, accountability, and attention to detail
• Learning agility and adaptability
• Collaboration and continuous improvement
• Responsible AI mindset

Preferred / Beneficial:

• Microsoft Copilot certification.Classified: Internal\ FAB Internal
• Microsoft Certified: Power Platform Fundamentals or Azure AI Fundamentals.
• Experience with agentic AI platforms, AI assistants, or enterprise chatbot solutions.
• Experience within banking, financial services, or regulated industries.
• Exposure to change management, user adoption, or digital transformation programs.

jobs.title: Product Director - Private Investments AI
locations: Abu Dhabi, Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates
jobs.summary: Become part of our team as Product Director - Private Investments AI, leading the strategy and delivery of AI-powered investment and credit solutions. Drive adoption, mentor product managers, and collaborate with cross-functional teams. Ideal for experienced product leaders with deep FinTech expertise and a strong background in financial technology.
jobs.description:
Inception42, a G42 company, is the region’s leading innovator of AI-powered domain-specific as well as industry-agnostic products, built on a rich heritage of research and development. Within the G42 ecosystem, Inception functions as the core intelligence layer – transforming data and compute infrastructure into real-world, applied AI solutions. Beyond its commercial endeavors, Inception is committed to creating positive societal impact. For more information, please visit www.inception42.ai

Overview:


We are looking for a hands-on Product Director with deep FinTech expertise to lead Alpha, Inception42's investment and credit AI product. You will own strategy, roadmap, and outcomes for institutional investors, lenders, and financial analysts.

Translate emerging AI capabilities into investment research, due diligence, underwriting support, and portfolio monitoring workflows. Turn fragmented information into reviewable analysis, with clear evidence and user control. Success means accurate work, sustained adoption, and measurable customer value.

You will lead cross-functional teams spanning Design, Engineering, Science, domain experts, and Growth. You will make difficult trade-offs, stay close to customers and product details, and mentor product managers.

Responsibilities:


Product strategy and discovery

• Define Alpha’s vision, target markets, differentiation and roadmap, aligning customer needs with emerging AI capabilities.

• Engage investment analysts, portfolio managers, credit teams and senior decision-makers to understand workflows, buying criteria and adoption barriers.

• Assess competitors and alternatives; validate demand through research, AI-assisted prototypes and pilots. Prioritise by customer value, commercial potential, feasibility and risk, coordinating shared capabilities with Catalyst.

Investment and credit workflows

• Own requirements for opportunity screening, company and sector research, due diligence, valuation support and investment committee materials.

• Develop workflows for financial statement analysis, cash-flow and debt-service assessment, downside scenarios, credit memos, covenant review and portfolio monitoring.

• Define AI behaviour and acceptance criteria, enabling analyst review, collaboration, versioning and approval, with Excel, Word and PowerPoint outputs.

• Prioritise integrations with filings, transcripts, market and credit data, internal research and deal rooms; guide licensing, access rights and build-versus-partner decisions.

AI development, quality and governance

• Partner with Science and Engineering on models, retrieval-augmented generation, prompts, context, memory, tools and agent orchestration.

• Ensure accurate extraction and reconciliation across documents and tables, accounting for entities, periods, currencies, units, metric definitions, freshness and conflicting evidence.

• Make outputs traceable to sources, separating reported facts, calculations, assumptions and AI interpretations, with reliable calculation tools and reviewable inputs.

• Own evaluation frameworks, test sets, analyst reviews and release thresholds for numerical accuracy, citations, completeness, financial reasoning and task success; monitor regressions and feedback.

• Define safeguards for fabricated outputs, missing evidence, tool failures and long-running actions, with intervention, recovery and approval paths.

• Embed AI disclosure, permissions, audit trails and sovereign data residency. Partner with Security, Legal, Risk and Compliance on confidentiality, material non-public information and information barriers.

• Agree approved uses and validation evidence with customer governance teams; assess English and Arabic content for language quality, numerical fidelity and localisation.

Delivery and commercial outcomes

• Lead discovery, launch and iteration across Design, Engineering, Science, domain experts and Growth, balancing scope, readiness, quality, reliability, latency and cost.

• Own the business case and product performance; support pricing, packaging, positioning and enterprise sales, accounting for data, inference, review and support costs.

• Convert pilots into sustained adoption through repeatable onboarding, workflow templates and training.

• Track task success, time to validated analysis, errors, corrections and abandonment alongside adoption, conversion, retention, expansion and unit economics.

Leadership

• Align technical, financial and commercial stakeholders on priorities and trade-offs; communicate effectively with customers and leadership.

• Mentor product managers, support hiring and strengthen discovery, evaluation and product reviews while remaining hands-on with experiments, feedback and production performance.

Qualifications:


What We’re Looking For

• 10+ years in product management or closely related roles, with substantial ownership of complex products at senior or principal level and a record of launching and scaling financial technology.

• Knowledge of institutional investment or credit workflows, with working fluency across both.

• Experience building products for analysts, investment teams, lenders, or risk professionals.

• Strong understanding of financial statements, valuation, leverage, and credit risk.

• Ability to interrogate financial models and challenge analytical assumptions.

• Experience delivering enterprise software with measurable adoption and commercial impact, including direct customer discovery and engagement with senior financial stakeholders.

• Experience taking AI-powered products, such as agents, copilots, or intelligent workflows, from concept to production and measurable adoption.

• Practical fluency in large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, context, memory, tool use, and evaluations. Ability to reason with technical teams about quality, latency, reliability, and cost.

• Hands-on use of AI tools to prototype workflows, test model behaviour, and accelerate research, analysis, or delivery.

• Strong analytical and commercial skills, including hands-on use of Excel, SQL, or comparable tools to investigate data, test hypotheses, and measure outcomes.

• Clear written and verbal communication, leadership across functions, and sound judgement in ambiguous environments where accuracy and customer trust are critical.

• A bachelor's degree in finance, economics, computer science, engineering, business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

• Sound product judgement and financial rigour: test assumptions against customer evidence, check the numbers, and change direction when warranted.

• Hands-on ownership and collaborative leadership: experiment to resolve uncertainty, welcome challenge, and stay accountable for outcomes beyond launch.

Nice to Have

• Prior investment banking, asset management, private equity, private credit, corporate lending, or credit research experience alongside product leadership.

• Experience with financial data providers, document intelligence, financial modelling tools, or enterprise integrations and data-access controls.

• Experience with financial institutions, sovereign deployment, and regulated enterprise procurement. Arabic language ability and bilingual product experience are advantages.

• CFA, FRM, or another relevant finance qualification; or similar practical depth in investment or credit analysis.

What We Look For

If you are a performance-driven, inquisitive mind with the agility to adapt to ambiguity, you will fit right in. You should be eager to explore opportunities to build meaningful collaborations with stakeholders and aspire to create unique customer-centric solutions. Bias for action and a passion to conquer new frontiers in the AI space is at the heart of the Inception42 community.

What Working At Inception42 Offers

Culture: An open, diverse and inclusive environment with a global vision that encourages personal growth and focuses on ground-breaking, industry-first innovations.

Career: Outstanding learning, development & growth opportunities via structured training programs and innovative, high-tech projects.

Rewards: A competitive remuneration package with a host of perks including healthcare, education support, leave benefits and more.

If you can confidently demonstrate that you meet the criteria above, please contact us as soon as possible.

jobs.title: Principal Product Designer
locations: Abu Dhabi, Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates
jobs.summary: We are currently hiring a Principal Product Designer to lead the design of AI-native products, shaping intuitive interfaces and autonomous systems. Drive end-to-end product strategy and manage a design team, leveraging your expertise in user research and interaction design. Ideal for experienced professionals with a strong background in AI product design.
jobs.description:
Inception42, a G42 company, is the region’s leading innovator of AI-powered domain-specific as well as industry-agnostic products, built on a rich heritage of research and development. Within the G42 ecosystem, Inception functions as the core intelligence layer – transforming data and compute infrastructure into real-world, applied AI solutions. Beyond its commercial endeavors, Inception is committed to creating positive societal impact. For more information, please visit www.inception42.ai

Overview:


We are looking for a hands-on Principal Product Designer to lead design work and manage a design pod across our AI-native portfolio: personal AI agents, executive intelligence, agentic workflows, governance platforms, and domain-specific solutions.

This is a role for an inventor. Your central job is to translate abstract vision — an executive ambition, a policy goal, a model capability that appeared six months ago — into concrete, innovative products that people trust and use every day. Your work will define how people should delegate real work to autonomous systems, and stay in control of the outcomes achieved by AI that are inherently non-deterministic.

You will own design from discovery through delivery, set the craft bar and the design systems across multiple products, and redefine the product design best practices at Inception42. You will work at the boundary of design, product, and applied AI — shaping not only the interface, but how the AI behaves with it.

Responsibilities:


Vision and strategy

• Define the design vision, experience principles and quality standards across Inception42’s AI product portfolio.

• Translate business ambitions, government requirements and emerging AI capabilities into practical product concepts and shipped experiences.

• Partner with Product, Engineering and Science to shape near- and long-term roadmaps, strengthen design thinking and improve delivery processes.

End-to-end AI product design

• Lead discovery, user research, journey mapping, interaction design, prototyping, usability testing and production, owning design from strategy through launch.

• Manage multiple projects in a fast-moving environment, balancing ambiguity, stakeholder input, functional requirements and timelines.

• Design intuitive agents, copilots, multi-agent systems, dashboards, conversational interfaces and workflows, including memory, citations and long-running actions.

• Design for uncertainty and failure, including incorrect or fabricated outputs, incomplete information, refusals, streaming, latency, tool errors and unpredictable behaviour.

• Make AI capabilities and limitations clear, helping users judge reliability, delegate work confidently and retain control over outcomes.

• Collaborate on prompts, system behaviour, tone of voice, output structure, content standards and guardrails so AI behaviour supports the intended experience.

• Define good output from the user’s perspective and contribute to evaluation rubrics, test sets and human review loops.

• Ground decisions in user and market research, behavioural data, telemetry and stakeholder feedback.

• Define and measure adoption, task success, time-to-value, correction and abandonment rates, and users’ ability to judge when to trust AI.

Design systems and quality

• Establish and govern reusable design systems across web, mobile, conversational, voice and workflow experiences.

• Use Figma, prototyping tools and AI tools to explore ideas quickly; use working prototypes to test concepts and align stakeholders.

• Maintain clear design specifications and uphold consistent standards for interaction, visual design, content and usability through delivery.

• Support English and Arabic experiences, including right-to-left layouts, bilingual typography and cultural context.

• Embed responsible and sovereign AI requirements, including AI disclosure, privacy, data residency, auditability and human oversight.

Leadership and influence

• Lead a design pod while remaining hands-on with the most complex design challenges.

• Recruit, mentor and develop permanent and contract designers, strengthening craft, critique and product thinking.

• Present design concepts and decisions clearly to Product, Engineering, Science, leadership, government stakeholders, enterprise customers and partners.

• Translate high-level feedback into actionable improvements and explain complex ideas effectively to executives, engineers and domain experts.

Qualifications:


• 10+ years of product design experience, with experience managing teams for major design initiatives.
• An online portfolio demonstrating end-to-end product ownership, interaction design, visual craft, and measurable outcomes. Case studies should show your process and your decisions, not only final screens.
• Experience with best practices for user interface design, information architecture, and interaction design.
• Experience with life-cycle design projects, from design strategy through to execution.
• Experience designing complex enterprise, SaaS, workflow, operational, or data-rich products.
• Strong expertise in user research, information architecture, prototyping, usability testing, and design systems.
• Expert proficiency in Figma and other design and prototyping tools.
• Experience designing AI-powered products such as agents, copilots, conversational UIs, intelligent workflows.
• Practical understanding of human–AI interaction, explainability, trust, confidence, user control, and HITL.
• Familiarity with AI concepts such as prompts, context, RAG, citations, memory, evaluations
• Experience using AI-assisted design, coding, research, or prototyping tools in your day-to-day work.
• Strong leadership, stakeholder management, communication, and presentation skills,
• Ability to work with ambiguity and to find clarity in a fast-pacing and changing environment
• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Product Design, Interaction Design, Human–Computer Interaction, or related fields

Preferred qualifications

• Experience with AI governance, workflow builders, decision-intelligence products, or enterprise AI platforms.
• Experience designing bilingual Arabic and English products; Arabic language ability is a plus but not required
• Familiarity with frontend technologies or design-to-code workflows, and the ability to prototype in code.

• Experience working directly with senior executives, government stakeholders, and enterprise customers.
• Experience in regulated domains such as healthcare, energy, financial services, or the public sector.
• Experience building or scaling a design function from a small base.

What We Look For

You should be eager to explore opportunities to build meaningful collaborations with stakeholders and aspire to create unique customer-centric solutions. Culture: An open, diverse and inclusive environment with a global vision that encourages personal growth and focuses on ground-breaking, industry-first innovations.

Career: Outstanding learning, development & growth opportunities via structured training programs and innovative, high-tech projects.
