jobs.title: Senior Engineer - OT Cybersecurity
locations: MBZ City, Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates
jobs.summary: Join us as a Senior Engineer - OT Cybersecurity to design and implement cybersecurity solutions for utility and control centre environments. Lead hands-on deployment and integration of OT cyber infrastructure, ensuring compliance with industry standards. Ideal for experienced professionals with a strong background in OT, instrumentation, and utility environments.
jobs.description:
Overview:


We are seeking highly skilled Engineers / / Senior Engineer / Lead Engineer to support the implementation of OT Cybersecurity solutions across utility environment and master control centers. The role involves hands-on deployment, configuration, and integration of cybersecurity technologies, infrastructure design, commissioning, and documentation. Candidates must have a strong background in operational technology (OT), instrumentation, and experience working in high and low voltage substations.

Responsibilities:


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Design and develop High-Level Design (HLD) and Low-Level Design (LLD) documents for OT cybersecurity infrastructure.
• Perform OT Cybersecurity Gap assessment , risk assessments as per IEC 62443 , NIST and international standards .
• Perform cable routing and physical installation of network and security devices in substations and control centers.

Engineering Design (HLD/LLD) & Drawing Development

• Review and validate Single Line Diagrams (SLDs), existing as-built drawings, and brownfield constraints; raise RFIs and propose constructible solutions.
• Validate panel drawings (GA, internal layout, wiring, interconnection, termination schedules, BOM) and ensure “as-built” updates post commissioning.
• OT Cybersecurity Infrastructure Deployment & Integration
• Implement and integrate OT cyber infrastructure components (e.g., industrial firewalls, switches, IDS sensors, secure remote access, logging collectors) according to approved LLD and standards.
• Support network cutovers, IP schemes, VLAN/VRF mapping, routing design inputs, and secure connectivity between substations and central platforms.
• Ensure installations meet required security baselines and customer utility practices (documentation, labeling, ports, hardening inputs).

Testing, FAT/SAT, Commissioning & Acceptance

• Support/lead FAT preparation and execution: test procedures, inspection checklists, configuration verification, and evidence packs.
• Execute SAT / site commissioning, including pre-checks, power-up, connectivity validation, link testing, redundancy checks, punch lists/snags, and final handover.
• Coordinate with OEMs and customer operations for outage windows, access approvals, and acceptance criteria signoffs.

.

Qualifications:


(Technical & Non-Technical)

Technical Skills / Core Competencies

• Demonstrated on-site execution in brownfield substations / utility environments (HV/LV interfaces awareness, safe work in operational sites).
• Strong capability in panel/cabinet build supervision, cabling, termination practices, labeling, testing, and as-built documentation.
• Proven ability to prepare HLD/LLD, implementable drawings, and engineering documentation packs.
• Understanding of OT network architecture principles (segmentation, zones/conducts), and integration constraints in utilities.
• Experience supporting FAT/SAT and commissioning activities with structured evidence and acceptance documentation.
• HSE / Compliance (Mandatory or Highly Preferred)
• Strong working knowledge of PTW systems, method statements and risk assessments for live utility sites
• Familiarity with UAE utility HSE expectations including OSHAD-aligned requirements and client safety governance.
•

Minimum Work Experience

• 7–12 years in cyber infrastructure / OT infrastructure / electrical-telecom execution in utilities, substations, rail, or industrial environments.
• Proven track record delivering brownfield site implementation including cabling/panels and commissioning support.
• Experience in data center infrastructure (rack/cabling/network build) supporting cyber platforms is a strong advantage.

Education

• Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering / Electronics / Instrumentation / Telecom / Computer Engineering (or equivalent relevant discipline)..
• Relevant OT cybersecurity certifications (at least one):

• ISA 62443 , GICSP ,CISSP

jobs.title: Senior SOC Engineer- SIEM (UAEN)
locations: MBZ City, Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates
jobs.summary: Join us as a Senior SOC Engineer, managing SIEM services within the Security Operations Centre, with a focus on Splunk SIEM and UEBA. Oversee onboarding new log sources, optimise telemetry, and support architecture improvements. Ideal for candidates with significant SOC experience and expertise in Splunk SIEM management.
jobs.description:
Overview:


The Senior SOC Engineer is responsible for managing SIEM services within the Security Operations Center, with a primary focus on Splunk SIEM and Splunk UEBA. This role involves onboarding new log sources, optimizing telemetry, ensuring system updates, troubleshooting issues, and maintaining SIEM performance. Additionally, the engineer will support SIEM architecture improvements and deployments aligned with business requirements.

Responsibilities:


Key Responsibilities:

• Manage Splunk SIEM services within the SOC environment.
• Implement scalable Splunk-based SIEM solutions following best practices.
• Define data ingestion strategies, parsing logic, and correlation rules.
• Onboard new log sources and ensure proper integration with Splunk SIEM.
• Monitor and maintain critical log sources; troubleshoot and resolve issues promptly.
• Optimize telemetry for improved data collection, correlation, and reporting.
• Collaborate with SOC and threat intelligence teams to develop detection use cases.
• Create dashboards, alerts, and reports for proactive threat monitoring.
• Perform system updates, version upgrades, and feature rollouts.
• Ensure CIM compliance, field extractions, and data normalization.
• Maintain SIEM performance and troubleshoot Splunk-related issues.
• Evaluate and deploy Splunk apps and add-ons as needed.
• Document SIEM workflows, configurations, and operational procedures.
• Support continuous process improvements to enhance SOC efficiency. Work cross-functionally with IT, DevOps, and security teams.

Characteristics:

• Profound knowledge and hands-on experience with Splunk SIEM, UEBA and other related technologies like CRIBL.
• Understanding of SOC workflows, MITRE ATT&CK framework, and threat detection methodologies.
• Ability to correlate data across multiple sources to identify patterns and anomalies.
• Strong understanding of cloud and network technologies, essential for efficient log source onboarding.
• Proven technical capabilities in a complex, fast-paced SOC environment.
• Ability to diagnose and troubleshoot log source issues related to cloud and network infrastructures.
• Strong understanding of SOC operations, cybersecurity principles, and best practices.
• Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to make decisions under pressure.
• Ability to collaborate effectively with a variety of team members, including interfacing with customers to resolve issues.
• High proficiency in written and verbal communication

Qualifications:


Skills/Certifications (Technical & Non-Technical)

• Splunk Certified Administrator.
• Mastery of SPL (Search Processing Language) for complex queries, dashboards, and reports.
• Scripting skills (Python, Bash, PowerShell)
• Cloud-related certifications like AWS Certified Solutions Architect, Google Professional Cloud Architect, or Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert.
• Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), GIAC is preferred.
• Excellent communication and documentation skills
• Ability to lead technical initiatives and work independently

Minimum Work Experience

• A minimum of 3-5 years of experience in SOC operations, with significant experience in Splunk SIEM management.
• Prior experience in a technical role within a SOC or similar cybersecurity environment.

Education

• Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Software Engineer

About Sysco LABS

Sysco LABS is the Global In-House Center of Sysco Corporation (NYSE: SYY), the world’s largest foodservice company. Sysco ranks 55th in the Fortune 500 list and is the global leader in the trillion-dollar foodservice industry.

Sysco operates 333 distribution centers across 10 countries, with 75,000 colleagues serving approximately 670,000 customer locations, including restaurants, healthcare and educational facilities, lodging establishments, entertainment venues and more. For fiscal year 2026, which ended June 27, 2026, the company generated sales of more than $84 billion.

Sysco LABS Sri Lanka delivers the technology that powers Sysco’s end-to-end operations.

Sysco LABS’ enterprise technology is present in the end-to-end foodservice journey, enabling the sourcing of food products, merchandising, storage and warehouse operations, order placement and pricing algorithms, the delivery of food and supplies to Sysco’s global network and the in-restaurant dining experience of the end-customer.

Role Overview

The Software Engineer independently delivers well-engineered code using established best practices, with the ability and willingness to pick up new languages, frameworks, and tools as the team's needs evolve. This is a foundational hands-on engineering role — building features, writing tests, managing version control, contributing to cloud/DevOps tasks with guidance, and using AI-assisted tools responsibly to support day-to-day development work.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Work

• Apply OOP/SOLID principles, design patterns, and common data structures & algorithms with minimal supervision.

• Apply basic concurrency/parallel programming concepts under supervision, and foundational secure programming concepts.

• Learn new languages, libraries, and frameworks as needed; build a good understanding of the SaaS/PaaS solutions the team relies on.

• Use foundational design patterns and reference architectures, seeking senior support as needed; interpret functional and non-functional requirements to complete tasks with minimal rework.

• Use Sysco-approved AI coding assistants for code generation, debugging, and refactoring, always validating AI-generated output before committing; understand foundational AI integration patterns and contribute to related implementations.

Delivery, Quality & Operations

• Manage code branches and versioned components comfortably; operate independently within the team's chosen project management methodology.

• Implement code quality best practices and adjust existing code to meet standards without breaking functionality; write effective unit tests and understand the goals of integration and end-to-end testing.

• Conduct root cause analysis and resolve straightforward production issues independently; navigate approved monitoring tools (e.g., DataDog, AWS CloudWatch) to monitor applications, including AI-integrated components.

• Contribute to foundational DevOps tasks (CI/CD, configuration/secret management, infrastructure) and cloud implementations/PoCs (AWS/GCP/Azure) with guidance; stay aware of approved vulnerability detection tooling and cloud AI service usage guidelines.

• Use AI tools to assist in writing tests and flagging code quality issues, validating AI-generated output for correctness and coverage.

People & Stakeholder Management

• Communicate clearly and constructively, verbally and in writing; actively participate in project meetings and sprint ceremonies.

• Estimate assigned tasks accurately and participate in team-level estimation/planning; stay aware of what teammates are working on and step up to support when advised by seniors.

• Actively contribute to brainstorming sessions and research answers to technical questions independently; stay current on industry and AI trends through discussions and forums.

• Use AI assistance responsibly for written communication and documentation; proactively explore how AI tools can improve personal productivity and share learnings with the team.

Requirements

Technical Skills

• Solid grounding in OOP/SOLID principles, design patterns, and data structures & algorithms.

• Working knowledge of foundational secure programming and data privacy concepts.

• Comfortable with version control, branching strategies, and CI/CD basics.

• Familiarity with at least one cloud platform (AWS/GCP/Azure) and willingness to contribute to cloud/DevOps tasks with guidance.

• Experience using AI coding assistants for development tasks, with the judgment to validate AI-generated output before use.

Leadership & Soft Skills

• Strong verbal and written communication; comfortable participating actively in agile ceremonies.

• Reliable task estimation and self-management within a defined project methodology.

• A proactive, independent learning mindset with willingness to research and self-improve.

Experience & Education

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.

• More than one year of professional software engineering experience.

Benefits:  

 

• Performance-based annual bonus  

• Performance rewards and recognition  

• Agile Benefits - special allowances for Health, Wellness & Academic purposes  

• Paid birthday leave  

• Team engagement allowance  

• Comprehensive Health & Life Insurance Cover - extendable to parents and in-laws  

• Hybrid work arrangement  

 

Sysco LABS is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

This organization integrates nature, culture, inquiry, and innovation to create transformative learning environments. Its dedicated research arm focuses on designing, prototyping, and eval...
jobs.description:
​Charterhouse is working on behalf of a pioneering research and innovation hub that is redefining education. This organization integrates nature, culture, inquiry, and innovation to create transformative learning environments. Its dedicated research arm focuses on designing, prototyping, and evaluating new educational approaches, using data-driven insights to shape the future of learning. Our client is looking to hire a Data Analyst, which will play a critical role in generating real-time insights into learner growth, pilot projects, and system impact.

About the Role

The Data Analyst designs and manages data systems, analyze research outcomes, and produce evidence-based reports that inform strategic decisions. Working as a Data Analyst, the role involves developing and maintaining data frameworks, tools, and dashboards for research and pilot projects while ensuring accurate, timely, and ethical collection and management of quantitative and qualitative data. Responsibilities includes conducting statistical analysis, identifying patterns, and translating findings into actionable insights. The role will also prepare clear visualizations and reports for leadership, internal teams, and stakeholders. Collaboration with educators, researchers, and external partners will be essential to integrate data into innovation processes. The role will further support evaluation of pilot projects, including baseline measures and impact assessments, while staying current with best practices in educational data analytics and learning sciences.

About You

The ideal Data Analyst will hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Education, Psychology, or a related field. The candidate should have two to four years of experience in data analysis, preferably within education, social sciences, or innovation sectors. Strong proficiency in data analysis tools such as Excel, R, Python, or SPSS is required, along with experience using dashboard and visualization tools like Tableau or Power BI. Demonstrating the ability to communicate complex data insights to non-technical audiences and possess knowledge of ethical data collection and safeguarding practices are essential for the role.

Our client requires an analytical and creative thinker with strong critical reasoning skills. Excellent communication and collaboration abilities are essential, as is adaptability to evolving questions and iterative projects. Integrity and commitment to ethical data practices are fundamental to this role. This position is ideal for someone who sees data not just as numbers, but as a powerful storytelling tool to drive innovation.

What You’ll Own

In the Sr. Applied Scientist role you will play a crucial part in pioneering research and development across various facets of AI, including but not limited to computer vision, natural language processing, and audio signal processing. o Provide pre-sales and post-sales technical support to the business development team.

Qualifications:


What We’re Looking For

• M.Sc. or Ph.D. degree in computer science, engineering, or AI-related field. Specialization in Computer Vision, Natural Language Processing or Speech and Audio are highly desirable.
• Minimum 8 years of experience in developing AI algorithms for various modalities

A highly curious and inquisitive approach to problem-solving

In-depth knowledge of the latest developments in AI and machine learning

Why Inception42

Inception42 is building AI systems designed for practical deployment at scale — across industries, infrastructure, and national-level initiatives.

If you want to work close to both advanced AI capability and real-world execution, we’d like to hear from you.

The Senior Embedded Software Verification Engineer for Halcon will lead and execute verification and DT&E activities for embedded software, managing requirements, test procedures, traceability, test execution, and reporting. RESPONSIBILITIES

jobs.title: Manager - AI & Automation
locations: MBZ City, Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates
jobs.summary: Take on the role of Manager - AI & Automation to lead the design, development, and deployment of AI and automation solutions within a Managed Security Service Provider. Oversee multidisciplinary teams, drive security-focused AI initiatives, and ensure robust, secure, and scalable AI-enabled security operations. Ideal for experienced leaders in AI, automation, and security operations.
jobs.description:
Overview:


The Manager - AI & Automation is responsible for leading the design, development, deployment, governance, and continuous improvement of AI and automation capabilities within a multi-customer Managed Security Service Provider, or MSSP, Security Operations Center.

The role combines technical leadership, security operations, AI engineering, service management, customer engagement, and people management. The manager will lead a multidisciplinary team responsible for developing and operating AI agents, agentic workflows, security automation, SOAR playbooks, detection engineering solutions, and AI-assisted incident response capabilities.

The role has two primary areas of focus:

• AI for Security: Applying AI, agents, automation, orchestration, and machine learning to improve alert triage, investigation, threat hunting, detection engineering, incident response, reporting, and SOC efficiency.
• Security for AI: Protecting AI applications, agents, models, retrieval systems, APIs, tools, data, and supporting infrastructure against misuse, unauthorized access, data leakage, prompt injection, excessive agency, model manipulation, and supply-chain risks.

The manager is accountable for ensuring that AI-enabled SOC capabilities are secure, reliable, explainable, auditable, cost-effective, tenant-aware, and governed through appropriate Human-in-the-Loop and Human-on-the-Loop controls.

Responsibilities:


AI and Automation Service Leadership

• • Translate the AI and automation strategy into roadmaps, engineering backlogs, delivery plans, and measurable outcomes.
• Manage the delivery and continuous improvement of AI agents, agentic workflows, integrations, SOAR playbooks, and security automation.
• Prioritize initiatives based on security value, customer impact, operational risk, analyst effort, scalability, complexity, and cost.

Vendor-Agnostic Agent Engineering

• Lead the architecture and hands-on development of enterprise-grade AI agents and agentic workflows for security operations.
• Build agents from scratch using a vendor-agnostic approach, avoiding unnecessary dependency on a single model provider, cloud platform, orchestration product, or security vendor.
• Design solutions that allow models, tools, data sources, prompts, and orchestration components to be replaced or upgraded with limited impact.
• Apply abstraction layers, standard interfaces, structured outputs, reusable tools, model gateways, and portable integration patterns.
• Evaluate and select agent development frameworks based on the use case, security requirements, maintainability, performance, licensing, and operational cost.
• Develop agents using common frameworks such as Agno, LangChain, LangGraph, Google Agent Development Kit, OpenAI Agents SDK, and Mastra.
• Guide the design of single-agent and multi-agent architectures for triage, enrichment, investigation, threat hunting, detection engineering, case management, reporting, and response recommendations.
• Ensure agents preserve customer context, tenant boundaries, evidence traceability, and decision history.
• Integrate agents with SIEM, SOAR, EDR/XDR, NDR, cloud security, identity, email security, threat intelligence, vulnerability management, ITSM, and collaboration platforms.

Secure Development and Production Operations

• Establish secure development practices covering version control, peer review, automated testing, secrets management, CI/CD, staged deployment, change control, and rollback.
• Define evaluation criteria for accuracy, groundedness, consistency, evidence quality, tool selection, action success, latency, resilience, security, and cost.
• Ensure agents are tested against incomplete, ambiguous, conflicting, malicious, and customer-specific inputs.
• Implement production safeguards such as execution boundaries, approval gates, rate limits, timeouts, circuit breakers, kill switches.

jobs.description:
Job Description
About the role:

We're looking for a UX Designer who thrives on understanding people. You're at your best when talking to users, uncovering their needs, and translating those insights into better products. Research isn't just part of your process, it's what drives your decisions.

In this role, you'll lead the research side of our design practice, from planning studies and running usability tests to uncovering insights that directly influence our product direction. You'll also help shape how AI can enhance research by making it faster, more scalable, and more effective, while ensuring that human judgment remains at the center of every decision.

Key Responsibilities:

What you'll do

• Lead user research activities, including interviews, contextual inquiries, field studies, and usability testing (moderated and unmoderated).
• Design and execute research plans that answer real product questions, from participant recruitment and study design to scripts, tasks, and analysis.
• Turn qualitative and quantitative findings into clear insights, customer journeys, opportunities, and actionable recommendations.
• Validate concepts, designs, and prototypes early and frequently, then measure success through post-release research.
• Leverage AI throughout the research process, including transcription, tagging, clustering, synthesis, interview preparation, and test design, while critically evaluating outputs and safeguarding participant privacy.
• Build and maintain a scalable research practice through templates, research repositories, standards, and shared ways of working.
• Collaborate closely with product owners, developers, and designers in an agile environment, ensuring the voice of the user is represented in product decisions, refinements, and roadmap discussions.
• Advocate for evidence-based decision making and help foster a culture of continuous learning and user-centered design.

Qualifications
• 3+ years of experience in UX Research, or UX Design with a strong research focus.
• A bachelor’s in Human-Computer Interaction (HCI), User Experience Design, Interaction Design, Design Research, or a related field. Equivalent practical experience will also be considered.
• Strong expertise across a variety of research methods and the ability to choose the right approach for the problem at hand.
• Proven ability to transform complex and sometimes ambiguous user feedback into compelling insights and clear recommendations.
• Practical experience using AI tools to support research workflows, combined with a healthy skepticism and understanding of their limitations.
• Solid understanding of research ethics, informed consent, accessibility, and data privacy regulations such as GDPR.
• Strong prototyping and design skills, with experience using tools such as Figma to explore, test, and validate ideas.
• Excellent communication and storytelling skills, enabling you to influence stakeholders across disciplines.
• Fluency in English, both written and spoken.

Additional Information
We champion flexibility and hybrid work options to support varying lifestyles and personal needs. At the same time, we value the power of in-person collaboration to build community, spark innovation, and strengthen connections. Our approach ensures you can work in ways that suit you best while still engaging with colleagues to share ideas and grow together. #LI-Hybrid #LI-DNP

Translate emerging AI security risks, standards, and regulatory requirements into practical architecture, policies, and engineering controls.

Support the secure adoption of AI technologies across enterprise environments.

We are looking for a credit expert to serve as the Product SME for Alpha, our investment and credit AI product. You will translate how banks assess corporate and commercial borrowers into useful, repeatable product capabilities, shaping what Alpha needs to understand, how its workflows should behave and what good outputs look like.

You will partner with Product Managers, Designs, Engineering and Applied Science teams to turn banking knowledge into requirements, reference examples and quality standards. You will work directly with bank users to validate these choices. Your success will be measured by the usefulness, reliability and adoption of the product capabilities you help shape.

What You'll Own


• Map how relationship managers, credit analysts, independent risk teams and approvers assess borrowers. Identify the information, handoffs and decisions involved in new lending, renewals and ongoing reviews.
• Translate credit assessment practices into product requirements covering business and financial risk, repayment capacity, facility purpose and structure, collateral, policy checks and approval rationale.
• Create reference workflows, annotated credit papers, question libraries and worked examples that help product and technical teams understand the reasoning behind bank requirements.
• Advise the Product Manager on valuable use cases, workflow gaps and domain dependencies. Contribute to prioritising capabilities that solve recurring bank needs and can be reused across customers.
• Define which templates, risk-rating inputs, financial definitions, policy thresholds and approval steps must be configurable for different banks, borrower segments and lending products.
• Work with Design, Science and Engineering on prototypes, user stories and acceptance criteria. Resolve domain questions during delivery and validate that features fit the way bank teams actually work.
• Specify the evidence and data to be retrieved, the questions it should surface and the structure of its outputs. Guide requirements for financial spreading, credit memo preparation, covenant review and monitoring alerts.
• Shape review, correction and escalation flows, with clear distinctions between source facts, calculations, assumptions and AI interpretation.
• Build representative test cases, reference answers and evaluation rubrics with Science. Assess credit reasoning, numerical accuracy, evidence completeness and usefulness; include missing information, conflicting sources and policy exceptions.
• Diagnose domain errors, document expected behaviour, agree quality thresholds and verify fixes and regressions before release.
• Translate bank governance needs into product behaviour, including permissions, confidentiality, traceable sources, calculation reproducibility, audit history and human approval, working with security, legal and risk.
• Lead domain discovery with bank users and design partners. Test assumptions about credit processes and distinguish common requirements from institution-specific preferences or policies.
• Design realistic pilot scenarios with the PM and customer teams. Assess workflow fit, analytical quality, time saved, review effort and user adoption; turn findings into actionable product feedback.
• Support demos, proposals and customer workshops with credible banking expertise.
• Maintain reusable domain guidance, workflow examples and product feedback for internal teams. Bring recurring customer questions and market developments into roadmap discussions with the PM.

What We're Looking For


• Typically 6+ years in bank credit, corporate or commercial lending, credit risk, or a closely related advisory or technology role, with substantial practical exposure to bank credit assessment and approval processes.
• Strong understanding of how banks assess creditworthiness: borrower and sector risk, financial statements, cash flow, leverage, liquidity, debt-service capacity, collateral and facility structure.
• Working knowledge of credit policies, risk ratings, credit papers, approval authorities, exceptions, renewals and monitoring. Ability to explain how practices vary across institutions and customer segments.
• Evidence of translating specialist knowledge into requirements, process improvements, or reusable guidance. Ability to explain both the credit rationale and its implications for a product.
• Ability to review financial models and credit analysis critically, identify misleading assumptions or unsupported conclusions, and turn findings into clear examples and quality criteria for technical teams.
• Comfort working iteratively with prototypes and AI-assisted tools, testing their behaviour and learning how retrieval, citations, evaluations and human review affect AI product reliability.
• Strong written communication, customer engagement and cross-functional collaboration. Ability to explain complex credit concepts simply and resolve ambiguity with practical recommendations.
• A bachelor’s degree in finance, economics, accounting, engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

Nice To Have

• Experience as a product SME, domain consultant or business analyst on a lending platform, credit workflow, risk system or banking transformation initiative.
• Experience working with product and engineering teams on discovery, requirements, user testing or launches. Familiarity with AI evaluation or document intelligence is valuable.
• Knowledge of GCC banking practices, Islamic finance or regional credit requirements. Arabic language skills and experience with bilingual financial documents are advantages.
• CFA, FRM or another relevant qualification, or comparable practical depth in banking and credit.

Apply your credit expertise to shape an AI product used by financial institutions, working closely with product builders, applied scientists and bank practitioners.

We are seeking a petroleum production engineer who has improved the performance of real wells and can translate that experience into reliable digital products. You will provide the engineering leadership for electric submersible pump (ESP), gas-lift and naturally flowing well workflows, working with software engineers, AI scientists and controls specialists to progress from diagnosis and recommendations to validated closed-loop operation.

Responsibilities:


What you will do

• Define surveillance and optimisation workflows for ESP wells, including pump selection and operating range, intake conditions, free gas, motor loading and temperature, vibration, variable-speed drive settings and failure diagnosis.
• Develop gas-lift and naturally flowing well workflows covering injection performance, valve behaviour, unloading and instability, choke response and network backpressure. Evaluate well settings within shared gas-supply and facility constraints.
• Build, calibrate and challenge well-performance models using nodal analysis, inflow and outflow relationships, fluid properties and equipment data. Partner with the PTA SME to separate reservoir or skin changes from lift, wellbore and measurement effects.
• Define engineering requirements for virtual flow metering, sensor validation, anomaly detection and equipment-health models. Specify reference measurements, uncertainty, alarm usefulness and the conditions that require engineering review.
• Translate operating practices into decision logic for start-up, shutdown, recovery and optimisation. Work with controls and operational-technology specialists on operating envelopes, permissives, setpoint and ramp limits, fallback behaviour and operator override.
• Lead engineering validation from historical replay and simulation through advisory pilots to supervised closed-loop trials. Define acceptance criteria for degraded sensors, communications loss and unfamiliar operating conditions, alongside normal performance.
• Support field trials, investigate failures and measure production, energy and reliability outcomes against credible baselines. Convert lessons into reusable requirements, benchmark cases and operator guidance, and support customer adoption and technical demonstrations.

Qualifications:


Essential experience

• Degree in Petroleum Engineering, or a related engineering degree with substantial petroleum production engineering experience. Typically 12 or more years of relevant experience, including recent hands-on work with producing wells.
• Deep ESP engineering expertise demonstrated through selection, diagnosis, optimisation and operational troubleshooting. Substantive gas-lift operating or optimisation experience is also required, with the ability to diagnose performance beyond a single equipment vendor.
• Strong well-performance and nodal-analysis capability, including fluid properties, multiphase flow, inflow and outflow relationships and the interaction between reservoir deliverability and artificial lift.
• Delivery of digital well surveillance, remote optimisation or automation workflows into routine field use. Experience defining operational requirements and validating solutions with software, analytics or controls teams.
• Practical understanding of Pressure Transient Analysis (PTA) results and their limitations. Ability to apply changes in reservoir pressure, productivity and skin to lift decisions, with specialist interpretations owned by the PTA SME.
• Hands-on use of PROSPER, PIPESIM, DesignRite or equivalent well and lift engineering tools. Ability to work with historian or SCADA data, well tests, equipment records and operating-event histories.
• Experience defining safe operating envelopes and participating in operational change reviews. Clear understanding of supervisory optimisation, regulatory control and independent safety protection, and when optimisation should stop.
• Evidence of field improvements supported by data, technical leadership and effective collaboration with operators. Professional English communication and the ability to write requirements that engineers and developers can implement.

Preferred experience

• Supervised closed-loop deployments, advanced process control, model predictive control, edge applications or integration between production software and control-room systems.
• Physics-based or hybrid AI models, virtual flow metering, equipment reliability analysis, automated diagnostic workflows, or Python/SQL for engineering analysis.
• Offshore and Middle East operations, intelligent completions or downhole gas-lift valves. Experience with other lift methods is useful as the product expands.

Your contribution to the product team

You own production and lift requirements and domain validation. Controls specialists own control-system design and integration, with customer approval for field changes. You partner with the integrated-production SME on field constraints and target feasibility. Supervisory optimisation must preserve independent protection and the operator’s ability to intervene.

What working at AIQ offers:

Culture: Encouraging initiative, work in an environment that is fast-paced and varied, surrounded by talented peers from around the world, who are similarly attracted to applying their skills to solve transformational challenges.

Career: Join a team in which your contribution is recognized and rewarded, while you are supported to operate at your peak performance.

Rewards: An attractive renumeration package that includes healthcare, education support for dependents, leave benefits, and more.

Together, we are shaping the future.

ABOUT THE ROLE


Embedded Software Engineer

Role Overview:
Develop and maintain embedded software for aerospace and UAV systems, ensuring high performance, reliability, and compliance with safety standards.

RESPONSIBILITIES


• Design, develop, and test embedded software in C/C++.

jobs.title: Scrum master
jobs.description:
Role Summary

We are looking for an experienced Scrum Master with a strong background in consumer technology and communication platforms to drive agile delivery across our cross-functional product and engineering teams. In this role, you will act as a servant leader and agile coach, ensuring teams deliver high-quality software on time, within scope, and with a focus on continuous improvement. The ideal candidate will bring a deep understanding of agile frameworks, experience scaling complex digital products within a fast-paced startup or scale-up consumer platform environment, and familiarity navigating regulatory and compliance processes in financial software delivery. Additionally, you should possess prior exposure to API-driven architectures and technical delivery, alongside hands-on proficiency with tools like Jira, Confluence, Miro, Azure DevOps, or similar.

Responsibilities

•
Lead and facilitate all Scrum ceremonies — daily stand-ups, sprint planning, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.

•
Partner with Product Owners and Engineering Managers to ensure clear prioritization and alignment of sprint goals.

•
Remove blockers, manage dependencies, and drive continuous improvement in delivery processes.

•
Ensure adherence to agile principles and best practices across teams.

•
Foster a culture of transparency, accountability, and collaboration.

•
Track and analyze sprint metrics (velocity, burn-downs, cycle time) to help teams improve efficiency and predictability.

•
Guide teams in adopting agile tools (e.g., Jira, Confluence) and techniques that best fit fintech product cycles.

•
Collaborate closely with compliance, security, and data teams to ensure agile delivery.

•
Support multiple squads working on communications, AI, platform, customer service and experience

•
Coach and mentor team members and stakeholders in agile mindset and practices.
Requirements

•
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or related field (Master’s preferred).

•
Certified Scrum Master (CSM, PSM I/II) or equivalent agile certification.

•
4+ years of experience as a Scrum Master in agile software development environments.

•
Proven experience working in consumer platforms

•
Strong understanding of agile frameworks (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe) and DevOps practices.

•
Exceptional facilitation, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

•
Comfortable working with distributed or cross-functional teams.

•
Data-driven mindset with experience using delivery metrics to drive improvement.

jobs.title: Assistant Director, IT Experience and Service Delivery - IT Operations and Service Management
jobs.description:
Position Summary
Applications are welcome from all qualified candidates. In line with UAE regulations, Emirati candidates are encouraged to apply.

New York University Abu Dhabi (NYUAD) seeks to appoint a Assistant Director, IT Experience and Service Delivery reporting to the Director, IT Operations and Service Management.

The Assistant Director, IT Experience and Service Delivery leads the delivery and continual improvement of NYU Abu Dhabi’s primary end-user facing technology service capability. The role is responsible for ensuring faculty, students, staff, researchers, residents, visitors, guests, and campus partners receive consistent, responsive, professional, and user-centered technology support across academic, research, residential, administrative, instructional, meeting-room, public-computing, and event environments.

The portfolio encompasses Client Services, including the IT Experience Center and on-site support across workspaces, instructional, meeting-room and special spaces; endpoint and end-user technology service delivery; Event Services; Community Services; Residential technology support; and VIP and high-touch support. The role brings these capabilities together within an integrated service-delivery model with clear ownership, standards, escalation paths, performance measures, and accountability for the quality of the end-user technology experience and journey.

The Assistant Director leads a blended IT Experience & Service Delivery organization consisting of NYUAD service leads together with managed services providers and external support providers. The role maintains institutional accountability for service quality regardless of delivery model, ensuring internal and external teams operate as a coordinated organization against common service expectations, processes, performance measures, and values.

Working within the strategy, governance, and operational frameworks established by the Director, IT Operations and Service Management, the Assistant Director translates service objectives into effective operating models, workforce plans, processes, standards, and continual-improvement initiatives. The role works closely with NYUAD IT teams, NYU global partners, vendors, and service providers to provide a cohesive technology experience across NYUAD.

Key Responsibilities:

Lead IT Experience & Service Delivery and the end-user technology experience

•
Lead the full portfolio of end-user facing technology services across NYU Abu Dhabi, establishing an integrated operating model model spanning Client Services, the IT Experience Center, academic technology and learning-space support, endpoint and end-user technology service delivery, Event Services, Community Services, residential technology support, and VIP and high-touch support

•
Translate the strategic direction and service expectations established by the Director, IT Operations and Service Management into operational plans, service standards, staffing models, performance expectations, and continual-improvement priorities

•
Provide leadership, direction, coaching, and performance oversight for NYUAD service leads and staff across the IT Experience & Service Delivery portfolio, while ensuring managed-services personnel operate as an integrated extension of the NYUAD IT Experience & Service Delivery organization. Maintain clear institutional ownership and accountability for service outcomes regardless of whether services are delivered by NYUAD employees, contractors, or managed-services partners

•
Ensure services provide a consistent, responsive, and professional experience across user communities, engagement channels and physical environments while appropriately responding to the distinct needs of faculty, students, researchers, administrative staff, residents, visitors, guests, and institutional leadership. Maintain accountability for the quality of the end-user journey, including communication, follow-up, escalation, and hand-offs where technical resolution depends on other resolver groups

•
Facilitate user onboarding interviews, targeted end-user training and office hours, as required, to promote technology adoption, strengthen user capability, and address emerging community needs

•
Represent IT Experience & Service Delivery in cross-functional IT planning and contribute operational expertise and user insight to departmental discussions regarding service strategy, operational priorities, technology adoption, service improvement and the overall technology experience

Lead Client Services, the IT Experience Center and learning-space support

• Lead Client Services and the IT Experience Center as NYUAD's primary on-campus, end-user facing Tier 1 capability, together with on-site and end-user technology support across workspaces, instructional rooms, meeting rooms, special spaces, and shared campus environments. Ensure effective intake, triage, resolution, escalation, communication, request fulfillment, classroom readiness, and first-line AV support
• Develop and maintain a tiered and integrated support model that emphasizes resolution at the earliest appropriate level, equips frontline teams with the knowledge, tools, and authority required to resolve a broad range of issues, works in close partnership with the Global IT Service Desk and provides clear and accountable escalation to service owners and specialist teams when needed
• Establish and maintain operating procedures, staffing and scheduling models, knowledge-management practices, service standards, quality measures, and performance expectations that support consistent and effective service delivery across walk-up, appointment-based, phone, email, portal, classroom, and other agreed user-facing support channels and campus environments
• Monitor service demand, response and resolution performance, first-contact and first-visit resolution, escalation trends, user satisfaction, walk-in wait times, appointment availability, room readiness, recurring issues, and other relevant service indicators. Use these insights to improve operational effectiveness, service quality, and the overall technology experience
• Advance guided self-service, knowledge-centered support, automation, remote-support capabilities, practical digital-enablement sessions, and other modern service-delivery approaches that improve accessibility, build user capability, increase resolution efficiency, and reduce avoidable support demand

Oversee endpoint and end-user technology service delivery

• Provide functional leadership for the end user facing delivery of endpoint and end-user computing services, including university-managed desktops, laptops, mobile devices, peripherals, software delivery, device provisioning, equipment lending, and associated end-user technologies
• Oversee the operational service lifecycle of end-user devices from provisioning and deployment through configuration, support, refresh coordination, asset management, and secure retirement, ensuring clear ownership and effective hand-offs with the teams responsible for underlying platform and engineering services
• Direct NYUAD staff, service leads, and managed-services personnel responsible for endpoint and user technology services, establishing clear standards, responsibilities, performance expectations, documentation requirements, and escalation practices
• Work closely with Infrastructure Services and Information Security, Technology Governance, and relevant engineering teams to ensure endpoint environments are standardized, securely managed, supportable, current, and appropriately responsive to academic, research, administrative, and specialized requirements
• Promote modern management practices including automated provisioning, endpoint-management platforms, proactive monitoring and remediation, remote support, software automation, and accurate asset and configuration information
• Ensure new or changed end-user technologies transition effectively into service with appropriate documentation, knowledge, support processes, training, tools, and escalation pathways

Drive service performance, continual improvement, and operational maturity

• Work closely with the Service Management function to implement ITSM standards, processes, performance measures, service reporting, and continual-improvement practices across the IT Experience & Service Delivery portfolio
• Establish and review a balanced set of SLAs, KPIs, service-quality measures, end-user experience indicators, and performance expectations across Client Services, the IT Experience Center, learning spaces, Event Services, Community Services, asset and equipment support, NYUAD teams and managed-services providers
• Analyze operational data, user feedback, recurring incidents, escalation patterns, support demand, vendor performance, and service trends to identify opportunities for process improvement, automation, knowledge development, workforce optimization, and service redesign
• Promote participation in IT service surveys across the community and work with service owners to incorporate survey findings into service-improvement priorities and actions
• Participate actively in incident, request, problem, change, knowledge, major incident, service transition, and continual-improvement processes, ensuring the IT Experience & Service Delivery perspective and end-user impact are appropriately represented
• Ensure managed-services providers meet contractual and operational expectations and work with service leads, vendors, and the Director, IT Operations and Service Management to address performance gaps, capacity concerns, or systemic delivery issues
• Ensure IT Experience & Service Delivery teams are operationally ready to support new technologies and services prior to transition into production, including appropriate knowledge, documentation, support procedures, training, tools, workforce capacity, and escalation paths
• Promote a culture of accountability, service excellence, collaboration, continuous learning, and data-informed decision-making across the IT Experience & Service Delivery organization

Lead Event Services and VIP/High-Touch Support

• Lead the delivery of AV and technology support for academic, institutional, leadership, and selected commercial events, including conferences, ceremonies, executive engagements, visiting dignitaries, strategic guests, and other high-visibility activities requiring coordinated technology services
• Establish repeatable event-technology service models based on the scale, complexity, visibility, and risk of individual events, including appropriate requirements capture, planning, staffing, technical rehearsals, readiness checks, onsite support, contingency handling, escalation, and post-event review
• Direct the work of NYUAD staff, technical leads, managed-services personnel, contractors, and external technology providers supporting events, ensuring responsibilities and accountability are clearly established
• Partner with event organizers, Events, Public Affairs, Communications, Facilities, Campus Services, academic and administrative units, Infrastructure Services, AV Infrastructure, and other relevant stakeholders to understand requirements and ensure technology services are appropriately planned and delivered
• Develop standards, procedures, service offerings, and support tiers that reduce dependence on ad hoc or individual-dependent practices while retaining the flexibility required for specialized, high-profile or institutionally critical activities
• Use event feedback and operational experience to continuously improve readiness, service quality, resource utilization, and the overall event technology experience

Lead Community Services and residential technology support

• Lead Community Services across NYUAD, including user-facing IT communications, support guidance, basic digital enablement, tool adoption, community engagement, and feedback capture, while retaining clear and effective technology support for the University's residential community
• Establish defined community-facing and residential technology service models with clear service boundaries, ownership, support channels, escalation pathways, performance expectations, communications service guides, and adoption support
• Provide operational direction and performance oversight for NYUAD and managed-services personnel delivering community-facing and residential technology support, ensuring consistent service standards and effective coordination with other IT teams
• Partner closely with Infrastructure Services, Student Affairs, Residential Education, Campus Services, Facilities, Information Security, academic units, and other relevant stakeholders to resolve cross-functional issues, strengthen service communication and adoption, and improve the community technology experience
• Use service data, recurring issue analysis, self-service usage, user feedback, and engagement with faculty, students, researchers, staff, and residents to identify service gaps, improve support processes and guidance, and inform future technology and service improvements
• Ensure Community Services and residential technology support are integrated into the broader IT Experience & Service Delivery and IT Operations model rather than operating as a separate or ad hoc support functions

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Software Engineer

About Sysco LABS:

Sysco LABS is the Global In-House Center of Sysco Corporation (NYSE: SYY), the world’s largest foodservice company. Sysco ranks 55th in the Fortune 500 list and is the global leader in the trillion-dollar foodservice industry.

Sysco operates 333 distribution centers across 10 countries, with 75,000 colleagues serving approximately 670,000 customer locations, including restaurants, healthcare and educational facilities, lodging establishments, entertainment venues and more. For fiscal year 2026, which ended June 27, 2026, the company generated sales of more than $84 billion.

Sysco LABS Sri Lanka delivers the technology that powers Sysco’s end-to-end operations.

Sysco LABS’ enterprise technology is present in the end-to-end foodservice journey, enabling the sourcing of food products, merchandising, storage and warehouse operations, order placement and pricing algorithms, the delivery of food and supplies to Sysco’s global network and the in-restaurant dining experience of the end-customer.

Responsibilities:

• Designing and developing enterprise solutions for one of the world’s largest corporations

• Implementing distributed and highly available enterprise applications that scale for enterprise demands

• Adhering to Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery of solutions

• Ensuring high code quality by following software engineering best practices

• Working collaboratively in a cross-functional team in an Agile delivery environment

• Adhering to DevOps principles and being involved in projects throughout their full software lifecycle: from development, QA, and deployment to post-production support

Requirements:

• A Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or equivalent, with a minimum of 1year of experience developing production grade enterprise applications

• Extensive experience with the Java/Spring-Boot stack, along with hands-on knowledge on RESTful APIs, microservices, performance optimizations, enterprise integration principles and modern deployment strategies (containerization principles)

• An in-depth understanding of relational databases (MySQL or Postgres), schema design, and SQL optimization; Knowledge on NoSQL databases would be an added advantage

• Familiarity with data streaming concepts and related toolsets (Kafka)

• Familiarity with Linux-based systems and DevOps practices

• Prior experience and hands-on exposure working with AWS will be beneficial

• Excellent communication skills

• Familiarity with working in a Scrum Agile delivery environment

• Familiarity with Quality Engineering processes and practices

Benefits:

• Performance-based annual bonus

• Performance rewards and recognition
• Agile Benefits - special allowances for Health, Wellness & Academic purposes

• Paid birthday leave

• Team engagement allowance

• Comprehensive Health & Life Insurance Cover - extendable to parents and in-laws

• Hybrid work arrangement

Sysco LABS is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Senior Lead, Open API & Open Banking
jobs.description:
JOB SUMMARY / INTRODUCTION:
Define and lead the strategic vision for Open API and Open Banking services across the enterprise, enabling secure, scalable, and innovative digital ecosystems. The role focuses on decomposing legacy systems into modular, reusable APIs, fostering third-party collaboration, and ensuring compliance with Open Banking regulations.
Drives platform modernization, developer enablement, and cross-functional alignment to accelerate digital transformation and customer-centric innovation. Ensure APIs are designed and managed as strategic digital assets that deliver measurable business value.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Align API initiatives with enterprise architecture, data strategy, and reusable adoption goals.
• Establish metrics and KPIs to measure API performance, adoption, and business impact.
• Lead the development and lifecycle management of Open APIs in compliance with Open Banking standards (e.g., PSD2, UAE Central Bank guidelines).
• Collaborate with product, compliance, and architecture teams to define API strategies that support business capabilities and customer journeys.
• Champion API-first design principles and ensure APIs are reusable, secure, and developer-friendly.
• Drive the adoption of Open Banking ecosystems by enabling third-party integrations and fintech partnerships.
• Define and maintain API documentation, sandbox environments, and developer portals.
• Ensure APIs are discoverable, version-controlled, and aligned with enterprise architecture standards.
• Provide technical leadership to API engineering teams, fostering a culture of innovation and continuous improvement.
• Maintain delivery roadmaps, capacity planning, and resource forecasting for Open API initiatives.
• Ensure compliance with IT governance, security, and regulatory frameworks.
• Collaborate with enterprise architecture, security, and infrastructure teams to ensure platform scalability and resilience.
• Track and report KPIs related to API performance, adoption, and risk metrics.
• Promote DevSecOps, CI/CD, and test automation practices across the API lifecycle.

REQUIREMENTS / QUALIFICATIONS:
• Exp Overall: 12+ Years, Banking 8+ Years
• Deep understanding of Open Banking frameworks, API security (OAuth2, OpenID Connect), and regulatory compliance.
• Strong experience in API management platforms (e.g., Apigee, Kong, WSO2).
• Expertise in RESTful API design, JSON, Swagger/OpenAPI specifications.
• Familiarity with domain-driven design and microservices architecture.
• Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams and manage complex stakeholder environments.
• Strong communication, leadership, and mentoring skills.
• Proficiency in API analytics, usage tracking, and performance optimization.
• Experience with tools like API Management, Kong, Cloud Native Services, Kubernetes.

jobs.title: SAP Solutions Consultant
locations: Abu Dhabi, Sowwah Square - Al Sila Tower
jobs.description:
Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced SAP Consultant to lead and support the design, implementation, and optimisation of SAP solutions. The successful candidate will bring deep functional and/or technical expertise across SAP modules relevant to operations, including logistics, asset management, procurement, finance, and human resources. You will work closely with client stakeholders, programme managers, and technical teams to deliver mission-critical SAP solutions.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead end-to-end SAP implementation and support projects
• Gather and translate complex business requirements into SAP functional and technical specifications
• Configure, test, and deploy SAP modules in line with SAP standards and regulatory frameworks
• Provide subject matter expertise across relevant SAP modules (listed below)
• Liaise with stakeholders to manage expectations and drive solution adoption
• Conduct workshops, training sessions, and user acceptance testing (UAT)
• Ensure data integrity, security compliance, and audit readiness across all SAP environments
• Contribute to solution architecture design and continuous improvement initiatives
• Manage and mentor junior consultants and client-side SAP teams

SAP Modules – Required Knowledge

Finance & Controlling

• SAP FI (Financial Accounting) – General ledger, accounts payable/receivable, asset accounting for assets
• SAP CO (Controlling) – Cost centre accounting, internal orders, project cost tracking
• SAP FM (Funds Management) – Budget management, commitment accounting aligned to regulatory spending controls
• SAP GM (Grants Management) – Funding from agencies
• SAP PSM (Public Sector Management) –Budget execution and compliance

Logistics & Supply Chain

• SAP MM (Materials Management) – Procurement, inventory management, catalogue management
• SAP WM / EWM (Warehouse / Extended Warehouse Management) – Depot management, spare parts logistics
• SAP IM (Inventory Management) – Stock control including serialised and batch-managed items
• SAP SD (Sales & Distribution) – Inter-agency sales, cross-charging, equipment loans and returns
• SAP TM (Transportation Management) – Movement of equipment, vehicles, and materiel
• SAP GTS (Global Trade Services) – Export controls, dual-use goods compliance, ITAR/EAR adherence

Plant Maintenance & Asset Management

• SAP PM (Plant Maintenance) – Equipment maintenance scheduling, corrective and preventive maintenance
• SAP EAM (Enterprise Asset Management) – Full lifecycle management of assets
• SAP CS (Customer Service) – Equipment repair and return management

Project & Programme Management

• SAP PS (Project System) – Management of acquisition projects, capital programmes, and R&D
• SAP PPM (Portfolio & Project Management) – Programme, resource planning, and milestone tracking

Human Resources & Workforce

• SAP HCM (Human Capital Management) – personnel records, payroll, absence management
• SAP SuccessFactors – Talent acquisition, performance management, and workforce planning

Quality & Compliance

• SAP QM (Quality Management) – Inspection lots, quality control, supplier qualification
• SAP GRC (Governance, Risk & Compliance) – Access control, audit management, segregation of duties, regulatory compliance

Analytics & Reporting

• SAP BW/4HANA – operational reporting and data warehousing
• SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) – Dashboards, KPIs, and mission readiness reporting

Technology & Integration

• SAP S/4HANA – Core ERP platform (on-premise or private cloud for classified environments)
• SAP BTP (Business Technology Platform) – Integration, automation, and app development
• SAP PI/PO / Integration Suite – Middleware integration
• SAP Fiori – Role-based UX for field and operational users

Essential Requirements

• Proven experience (5+ years) delivering SAP solutions in highly regulated environments
• Deep functional expertise in at least three of the above SAP modules
• Understanding of procurement frameworks
• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills at senior/executive level
• SAP certification in one or more relevant modules (desirable)

Desirable Requirements

• Knowledge of ITIL, PRINCE2, or Agile delivery methodologies
• Experience with SAP RISE or private cloud deployment
• Background in logistics, engineering, or programme management

What We Offer

• Opportunity to work on high-impact programmes
• Professional development and SAP certification support
• [Pension / benefits / flexible working as applicable]

About Accenture
Accenture is a leading global professional services company that helps the world’s leading businesses, governments and other organizations build their digital core, optimize their operations, accelerate revenue growth and enhance citizen services—creating tangible value at speed and scale. We are a talent- and innovation-led company with approximately 791,000 people serving clients in more than 120 countries. Technology is at the core of change today, and we are one of the world’s leaders in helping drive that change, with strong ecosystem relationships. We combine our strength in technology and leadership in cloud, data and AI with unmatched industry experience, functional expertise and global delivery capability. Our broad range of services, solutions and assets across Strategy & Consulting, Technology, Operations, Industry X and Song, together with our culture of shared success and commitment to creating 360° value, enable us to help our clients reinvent and build trusted, lasting relationships. We measure our success by the 360° value we create for our clients, each other, our shareholders, partners and communities.

jobs.title: Security Delivery Consultant SOC L3 (DFIR) (Jadah, KSA)
jobs.description:
Job Qualifications:

We are looking for an experienced SOC L3 (DFIR) Engineer to serve as a senior escalation point within our Security Operations Center. In this role, you will lead complex incident response investigations, perform digital forensics, and drive SIEM engineering and tuning efforts to enhance detection capabilities. You will play a critical role in protecting our clients' environments and mentoring junior SOC analysts.

• Act as the primary escalation point for complex and high-severity security incidents escalated from L1 and L2 analysts
• Lead end-to-end incident response investigations including containment, eradication, and recovery

Owns the design and code quality of one or more components, actively educating and guiding junior engineers while beginning to take on true leadership responsibility - stepping in for the team lead/manager when they're unavailable, and starting to practice delegation across specific technical scopes or sub-groups within the team.

Contributes to elevating the overall Sysco engineering ecosystem through active participation in Communities of Practice, technical workshops, knowledge-sharing initiatives, and technical publications.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Delivery & Architecture

• Own design and code quality for one or more components; guide juniors on best practices, secure programming, data privacy, and AI-assisted code standards - raising concerns when AI output introduces risk.

• Apply concurrency/parallel programming concepts and multiple programming paradigms in line with product requirements; take accountability for prioritizing vulnerability fixes within owned components.

• Apply design patterns and reference architectures proficiently, educating juniors on the same; flag deviations from enterprise-defined patterns to seniors, and use incrementally built business-domain expertise to support team leadership's technical decision-making.

Delivery, Quality & Operations

• Independently monitor applications, resolve complex issues without supervision, and build dashboards/monitors on approved tooling, while educating juniors on the same.

• Contribute to cloud platform design work and educate juniors on DevOps concepts, tools, and cloud AI service usage in line with DevSecOps and security guidelines.

People & Stakeholder Management

• Step in for the team lead/manager when absent, guiding the team toward its goals and handling stakeholder correspondence professionally.

• Take ownership of specific technical scopes or sub-groups of junior engineers, practicing delegation rather than carrying every task personally.

• Adapt communication style and technical depth to different audiences when presenting results or running demonstrations.

• Encourage juniors to think creatively and experiment with new approaches and AI tools within company guidelines; socialize industry and AI trends and innovation ideas with the team and leads.

• Actively contribute to technical interviews and hiring decisions for the team, evaluating both technical depth and team fit to build a strong, well-rounded engineering team.

Requirements

Technical Skills

• Strong command of design patterns, reference architectures, and secure/data-privacy-aware coding practices, including in AI-assisted contexts.

• Practical experience with concurrency, parallel programming, and multiple programming paradigms.

• Working knowledge of cloud platform design and core DevOps/DevSecOps concepts.

• Ability to evaluate frameworks, tools, and AI-assisted development output for quality, security, and business fit.

Leadership & Soft Skills

• Demonstrated readiness to lead a team in a manager's absence, with sound judgment on delegation.

• Strong stakeholder communication, adaptable to technical and non-technical audiences.

• Proven mentorship ability, particularly in guiding juniors' technical growth and AI tool adoption.

• A curiosity-driven mindset that fosters innovation and experimentation within the team.

Experience & Education

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.

• 4+ years of professional software engineering experience, including demonstrated ownership of component-level design and code quality as a Senior Software Engineer.

jobs.description:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is looking for a Senior Solutions Architect to join our Commercial Sector Enterprise team in the UAE. You will work with some of the region's largest and most influential organisations in Financial Services, Retail, Travel & Hospitality, and Media. These are enterprises with complex technology estates, demanding regulatory and operational requirements, and big ambitions for what the cloud and AI can unlock next.

This is a role for a trusted technical advisor. You will earn a seat at the table with senior business and technology leaders and understand the business priorities behind their technology decisions. You will design architectures that help them scale, modernise, and innovate. That could mean migrating and modernising mission-critical workloads, building enterprise-grade data and analytics platforms, or moving generative AI and machine learning from proof of concept to production at scale. You will bring deep expertise across cloud infrastructure, modern application development, data and analytics, and AI/ML.

You will partner with customers to shape their cloud strategy around business outcomes: speeding up time-to-market, unlocking new revenue streams, improving operational efficiency and resilience, and building the digital foundation for long-term transformation. You will earn trust by showing technical credibility, working through complexity across large organisations, and delivering results that move the business forward.

You will be part of a collaborative, supportive team that values curiosity, ownership, and impact. We learn from each other, and build an environment where every voice is heard.

Key job responsibilities

Key job responsibilities

As a Senior Solutions Architect, you will own the technical relationship with enterprise customers end-to-end. This means:

- Engaging customers to understand their business drivers for cloud adoption, assess their existing on-premises or multi-cloud landscape, and architect a credible path to AWS

- Building the technical case for AWS: total cost of ownership analyses, migration strategies, and proof-of-value engagements that deliver value.

- Building hands-on: prototypes, proofs of concept, migration runbooks, landing zone blueprints, and production-ready reference architectures. You lead by doing, not just advising.

- Helping customers envision and build with generative AI and machine learning — often as the catalyst that makes AWS the platform of choice by demonstrating what's uniquely possible with AWS AI/ML services.

- Partnering closely with Account Managers and Business Development to shape the go-to-market strategy for accounts — you are the technical credibility that converts pipeline into adoption.

- Acting as the customer's technical advocate inside AWS — translating field insights from customers into clear, prioritized feedback that shapes the roadmap for AWS services and features.

- Creating and sharing technical content that scales your impact: workshops, immersion days, blog posts, code samples, reference architectures, and public talks at meetups, user groups, and conferences.

- You make the team stronger by mentoring fellow Solutions Architects — sharing what you know and helping others grow.

A day in the life

No two days look the same. You might spend the morning in a technical workshop with a financial services customer exploring whether to lift-and-shift their core banking platform or re-architect on AWS, then pivot to a hands-on proof of concept helping a retail customer build on Amazon Bedrock. In the afternoon you might build a landing zone design for a customer that just signed their Enterprise Agreement, draft a migration playbook for a hospitality company, or join a call with an AWS service team to advocate for a feature that would unblock a key deal. You balance depth with breadth, strategic thinking with hands-on execution, and the patience required to build trust with the urgency of a team that moves fast.

About the team

AWS Solutions Architects in MENAT are a tight-knit team of builders and technologists who are passionate about helping customers in one of the world's fastest-growing cloud markets. We work across diverse industries and cultures, which demands adaptability, curiosity, and genuine respect for our customers' contexts. We support each other through knowledge sharing, peer reviews, and a culture of continuous learning. We believe the best ideas come from diverse perspectives, and we actively foster an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.

- 10+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience

- 10+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience

- Experience architecting or deploying Cloud/Virtualization solutions in enterprise customers

- Experience architecting, migrating, transforming or modernizing customer requirements to the cloud

- Experience communicating across technical and non-technical audiences, including executive level stakeholders or clients

Preferred qualifications

- Experience working with end user or developer communities

- Experience architecting/operating solutions built on AWS

- - Experience designing landing zones, multi-account strategies, and governance frameworks for new adopters

- - Experience working with end-user or developer communities
