jobs.title: Data Center Infra Engineer  - 2027 Internship
jobs.summary: Ever wanted to help design and support the data centers that power the world's largest cloud? As a DC Infra Engineer Intern at Amazon Web Services (AWS), you will work alongside an experienced, cross-disciplinary
jobs.description:
Ever wanted to help design and support the data centers that power the world's largest cloud? As a DC Infra Engineer Intern at Amazon Web Services (AWS), you will work alongside an experienced, cross-disciplinary team to provide full life-cycle support to AWS data centers — from design inception through site improvement and maintenance. Your work will directly impact millions of customers worldwide.

Each day, you will interact with different teams responsible for all aspects of the data centers. You will help prioritize activities that support data center capacity, availability, and safety, focusing on the actions that are most impactful — and you will have the opportunity to work on projects both locally and globally. If this sounds exciting to you, come build the future with us!

This internship is designed as a potential pathway to full-time employment. Interns who demonstrate strong performance throughout their internship may be considered for a full-time engineering position, subject to available roles and business needs.

Who Should Apply

We welcome applications from:

- Students in the last year of their Bachelor's or Master's degree) in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Architecture, Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering, or a related technical discipline, who are looking for an internship that could lead to a full-time career.

Important — Site Location & Commuting: This role is based at a data center facility in a remote location with no public transportation access. A valid driving license and access to personal transportation are required to commute to the site daily. Please consider this before applying.

About the Role

As an intern, you will engage with an experienced cross-disciplinary staff to provide full life-cycle support to AWS data centers, from design through operation. With guidance from experienced engineers, you will build your subject matter expertise and serve as an engineering resource for your region, applying what you learn to real technical challenges.

You will be exposed to both independent work and team-based collaboration. Prioritization, organizational skills, effective communication, and the ability to react quickly are critical to being successful.

What You Will Do

- Perform design and equipment submittal reviews for new data centers in your region

- Troubleshoot issues, conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA), and create Corrective Action (CA) documentation for site and equipment failures

- Support operational issues with ad-hoc training, complex operating procedure reviews (including for critical equipment), and event support

- Collaborate with the internal data center design engineering team, server hardware team, and environmental health and safety team to promote standards that maintain consistency and reliability in services delivered

- Work on concurrent projects, sometimes across multiple geographical regions

Internship Structure

Amazon internships are full-time (40 hours per week) for 12 consecutive weeks, starting 2027. This position requires the intern to report to work on site daily. Intern schedules are typically day schedules, Sunday to Thursday.

Please note that full-time engineering roles may operate on a rotating shift pattern, which could include days, evenings, weekends, and public holidays, as well as on-call rotations. Candidates should be willing and able to commit to shift work upon transitioning to a full-time position.

Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed below, we encourage you to apply. If your career is just starting, has not followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, do not let that stop you from applying.

Your Career at Amazon — A Universe of Opportunity

At Amazon, your career is not a straight path. It is a journey you build as you go.

From your first day as an intern, you will own real work that matters. You will help design, troubleshoot, and support the infrastructure that keeps AWS running for millions of customers. Your mentors and teammates will champion your growth, helping you build skills you did not know existed — and you will see your work come to life at massive scale.

Impact. Your work shapes the infrastructure that millions of customers rely on every day. From cloud computing to artificial intelligence, the systems you help support power it all.

Action. You will move fast, experiment, and learn by doing. Your ideas do not get stuck in approval chains — they get tested, refined, and put into practice.

Curiosity. Every project teaches you something new. You will apply what you learned in the classroom to real challenges and explore different teams, technologies, and career paths within Amazon.

Mentorship and career growth. You will start with structured onboarding and get paired with experienced mentors. Beyond that, you will find continuous learning opportunities and the chance to work on different projects. Your journey here is yours to shape.

A day in the life

0

About the team

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. We are the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on.

You will join a diverse team of engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You will collaborate with people across AWS to deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers.

Basic qualifications
- In the last year of a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Architecture, Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering, or another equivalent technical discipline, graduating in 2027 – before the internship´s end date

- Knowledge of Power Systems, Fluid Dynamics, and/or Thermodynamics

- Professional English proficiency, both written and verbal

- Ability to work well with others in a team environment, with strong time management skills

Preferred qualifications
- Knowledge of Heating, Ventilation, and Air Conditioning (HVAC) systems

- Coursework in commercial or industrial power systems and/or mechanical systems

- Experience using a variety of web-based and other software tools for calculation and data processing

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

jobs.summary: Amazon Web Services (AWS) is looking for experienced and motivated technologists who possess a unique balance of technical depth and customer facing experience. We are seeking Solutions Architects that
jobs.description:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is looking for experienced and motivated technologists who possess a unique balance of technical depth and customer facing experience. We are seeking Solutions Architects that will have an opportunity to work with customers, account managers and several internal teams to craft highly scalable, flexible and resilient cloud architectures that address customer business problems and help accelerate the adoption of AWS. In collaboration with sales, you will drive AWS platform adoption across a broad set of customers. 



As a trusted customer advocate, the solutions architect will help organizations understand advanced cloud-based solutions, and how to migrate existing workloads to the cloud. You will have the opportunity to help shape and execute a strategy to build mind share and broad use of AWS within organizations ranging from new start-ups to large enterprise customers. The ability to link technology with measurable business value is critical to a solutions architect. You should also have a demonstrated ability to think strategically about business, products, and technical challenges.



For the Solutions Architect role, we are looking for a candidate who is comfortable at the intersection of technology and business. He or she will be broadly competent across many areas of technology and deep in a handful of areas. It's ok for them to be less deep in some places, but we need to feel confident that they have the fundamentals and the ability to learn complex new technologies quickly. 



On the business side, we are looking for excellent communication skills. The Solutions Architect will spend most of their day interacting with customers via email, phone, instant messaging, and in-person meetings. They will meet with developers, team leads, engineering directors, and CxOs. Given the large portion of customers who are self-served, interest in and ability to create one-to-many content such as reference architectures and blog posts is an important part of the role.



On the soft-skills side, we are looking for ability to moderate tone and technical depth based on audience and solid ability to pick up on non-verbal communication. Also ability to pick up on “un-said” drivers is important.



On the personal attributes side, we are looking for individuals who are passionate about technology and have the drive and capability to absorb and retain vast amounts of deep technical information continuously.





Job responsibilities

• As a key member of the business development and sales team, ensure success in building and migrating applications, software and services on the AWS platform

• Partner with the account management team, formulate and execute an account strategy.

• Educate customers of all sizes on the value proposition of AWS, and participate in deep architectural discussions to ensure solutions are designed for successful deployment in the cloud

• Conduct one-to-few and one-to-many training sessions to transfer knowledge to customers considering or already using AWS

• Capture and share best-practice knowledge within the AWS solutions architect community

• Author or otherwise contribute to AWS customer-facing publications such as whitepapers

• Build deep relationships with senior technical individuals within customers to enable them to be cloud advocates

• Act as a technical liaison between customers, service engineering teams and support

Basic qualifications
- 4+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience

- 2+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience

- 10+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience

Preferred qualifications
- Experience working within software development or Internet-related industries

- Experience migrating or transforming legacy customer solutions to the cloud

- Experience working with AWS technologies from a dev/ops perspective

If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. This customer-first approach is how we built the world’s most adopted cloud. Join us and help us grow.

We are hiring a Senior Solutions Architect to work with Enterprise and Strategic customers in western Saudi Arabia, based in Jeddah. Saudi Arabia is one of the fastest-growing cloud markets in the Middle East, fuelled by Vision 2030 and ambitious national digital transformation programmes across government, healthcare, aviation, retail, and financial services. This role is central to AWS’s growth strategy in the Kingdom — you will serve as the primary technical advisor for a portfolio of high-profile enterprise customers, helping them modernise legacy platforms, adopt AI and cloud-native architectures, and accelerate their digital agendas.

Solutions Architects engage with customers to understand their business drivers, assess application portfolios, and design reliable, cost-effective cloud-native architectures. As a Senior Solutions Architect, you will partner with Account Managers, Business Development representatives, Professional Services, Specialist SAs, and AWS Service Teams to create solutions that address complex business problems and accelerate the adoption of AWS services. You will also play a key role in competitive displacement engagements, helping customers migrate workloads to AWS.

You should enjoy thinking strategically about business, products, and technical challenges. We are looking for candidates who are comfortable at the intersection of technology and business. The Solutions Architect is a technical role — you must be broadly competent across many areas of technology (Generative AI, Agentic AI, cloud infrastructure, security, DevOps, databases, application development, data analytics) and deep in at least 2–3 of those areas. On the business side, the ability to connect technology with measurable business value is critical for our customers’ successful use of AWS. You will spend most of your day interacting with multiple customer stakeholders, including CxOs, VPs, Directors, Architects, Developers, and Engineers.

Key job responsibilities

• In partnership with Account Managers and Business Development, drive long-term customer success, satisfaction, and trust through the adoption of AWS services and well-architected solutions.

• Serve as the primary technical advisor for enterprise customers in the Jeddah and western Saudi Arabia region, building trusted relationships with senior stakeholders and influencing their long-term technology strategy.

• Educate customers on the value proposition of AWS and lead deep architectural discussions to ensure solutions are designed for successful deployment in the cloud, including competitive migration paths from other cloud providers to AWS.

• Conduct one-to-few and one-to-many enablement sessions to transfer knowledge to customers considering or already using AWS (e.g., Dev Days, Immersion Days, Workshops, and GameDays).

• Capture and share best-practice knowledge amongst the AWS Solutions Architect community; contribute to customer-facing publications such as white papers, blog posts, and reference architectures.

• Act as a technical liaison between customers, AWS Service Teams, and Support — gathering product feedback, driving feature requests, and mentoring fellow Solutions Architects in the region.

A day in the life

As a Senior Solutions Architect in Jeddah, your day revolves around customer impact. You might start the morning preparing an architecture proposal for an enterprise customer exploring a migration from on-premises or competing cloud platforms to AWS. Mid-morning, you join a deep-dive technical session with a customer’s engineering team, whiteboarding a microservices architecture for their digital platform and advising on the right mix of compute, AI/ML, and data services.

After lunch, you collaborate with your Account Manager and the wider account team on a strategy call — aligning on the technical win plan for a competitive opportunity and identifying the right Specialist SAs or ProServe resources to bring in. Later in the afternoon, you might lead a workshop or Immersion Day for a group of developers at a customer site, walking them through hands-on labs on Amazon Bedrock, GenAI application patterns, or container modernisation with EKS.

Between customer meetings, you capture feedback on product gaps, draft a blog post on a solution pattern you designed last week, or review an architecture created by a teammate. Your week also includes internal syncs with the broader KSA SA team, community knowledge-sharing sessions, and preparation for upcoming events. No two days are the same, but the constant is clear: you are the customer’s trusted technical partner, and your work directly drives their success on AWS

Basic qualifications
- 8+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience

- 3+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience

- 10+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience

- Knowledge of cloud architecture

Preferred qualifications
- 5+ years of infrastructure architecture, database architecture and networking experience

- Experience working with end user or developer communities

- Experience designing or advising on AI/ML workloads, including model training, inference, and deployment on cloud infrastructure

jobs.title: Senior Engineer - Cloud Services
jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Senior Engineer - Cloud Services

The Big Picture  

About Sysco LABS: 

Sysco LABS is the Global In-House Center of Sysco Corporation (NYSE: SYY), the world’s largest foodservice company. Sysco ranks 55th in the Fortune 500 list and is the global leader in the trillion-dollar foodservice industry. 

Sysco operates 333 distribution centers across 10 countries, with 75,000 colleagues serving approximately 670,000 customer locations, including restaurants, healthcare and educational facilities, lodging establishments, entertainment venues and more. For fiscal year 2026, which ended June 27, 2026, the company generated sales of more than $84 billion. 

Sysco LABS Sri Lanka delivers the technology that powers Sysco’s end-to-end operations. 

Sysco LABS’ enterprise technology is present in the end-to-end foodservice journey, enabling the sourcing of food products, merchandising, storage and warehouse operations, order placement and pricing algorithms, the delivery of food and supplies to Sysco’s global network and the in-restaurant dining experience of the end-customer. 

Role Overview

As a Senior Engineer of Sysco’s Global Public Cloud Engineering Team, you will own and support our multi-cloud, hybrid infrastructure and service transformation. You will assist the design and implementation of secure, scalable, and highly available cloud environments across AWS, GCP, and Azure, Fastly (CDN/WAF) and Cloud Governance Platforms focusing relentlessly on cloud-native patterns and the lowest total cost of ownership (TCO). Blending hands-on engineering execution with technical leadership, you will set enterprise standards for Infrastructure-as-Code, automated governance, edge security, and developer enablement.

Key Responsibilities

1. Architecture & Cloud Transformation

• Act as point of contact for multi-cloud, hybrid infrastructure services transformation, establishing architecture standards and golden patterns for provisioning and deployment.

• Support cloud-native solutions over legacy lift-and-shift patterns, aligning all designs with the six pillars of the Well-Architected Framework (Operational Excellence, Security, Reliability, Performance Efficiency, Cost Optimization, and Sustainability).

• Design and implement enterprise cloud architectures, develop cloud landing zones and platform capabilities, design hybrid-cloud and multi-cloud connectivity.

• Define and own end-to-end Solution Architecture (Infrastructure, applications, and data technologies) utilizing service-oriented architecture principles.

• Assist migration initiatives, including On-Premises-to-Cloud and Cloud-to-Cloud migrations with zero downtime architectures and robust Disaster Recovery (DR) validation.

• AI Infrastructure & Workload Support: Support robust, scalable, and secure underlying cloud infrastructure for AI/ML workloads (including GPU-optimized nodes, vector database connectivity, and secure model serving endpoints) across AWS, GCP, and Azure.

• AI-Assisted Engineering Productivity: Help the secure adoption of AI-driven developer tooling (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Amazon Q) within infrastructure teams, establishing safety guardrails for automated code and Infrastructure-as-Code generation.

• ITIL-Aligned Cloud Engineering/Operations: Bridge modern cloud engineering practices with IT Service Management (ITSM) frameworks (ITIL v4 or above), ensuring rapid deployment velocity is balanced with robust service quality, predictability, and risk control.

2. Governance, Security & Compliance

• Design and enforce enterprise Cloud Governance strategies, implementing automated guardrails and continuous compliance using Cloud Custodian and native cloud policies (e.g., AWS SCPs, Azure Policies).

• Support comprehensive Cloud Identity and Access Management (IAM), tenant isolation, federated authentication, and least-privilege security models.

• Partner with security teams to configure and manage enterprise edge security architectures, integrating Fastly CDN and NFWAF (Next-Gen WAF) to protect core applications from modern web threats.

• Ensure end-to-end security and regulatory compliance across all enterprise infrastructure, data pipelines, and application configurations.

• AI Governance & Policy-as-Code: Extend Cloud Custodian and native cloud governance engines to audit, monitor, and enforce compliance policies on cloud-hosted AI and generative AI services, preventing unauthorized shadow AI deployments.

• AI Security & Data Privacy: Partner with security teams to ensure secure data pipelines, strict API rate-limiting, and egress/ingress protection via Fastly CDN and NFWAF for enterprise AI applications. Implement FinOps guardrails specifically tailored for high-cost AI/ML resource consumption.

3. DevOps, Automation & CI/CD Excellence

• Standardize and govern Infrastructure-as-Code using Terraform and Terragrunt for modular, DRY multi-cloud deployments.

• Optimization and management of CI/CD pipelines, driving adoption toward GitHub and GitHub Actions while managing legacy Jenkins maintenance.

• Develop advanced automation scripts and custom orchestration tools using Python, Bash, and PowerShell.

• Ability to support configuration management frameworks and server baseline standards using Ansible, alongside containerized runtime workloads using Docker and Kubernetes.

4. Technical Leadership & Engineering Support

• Troubleshoot critical production issues, perform root cause analyses, and drive technical problem-solving across cross-functional engineering squads.

• Conducting rigorous code and Pull Request (PR) reviews for Terraform configurations and CI/CD pipelines.

• Build and maintain comprehensive internal knowledge bases, technical documentation, and reusable architecture decision records (ADRs).

• Articulate technical risks, cost-capacity ratios, and strategic roadmaps clearly to audiences ranging from operations engineers to executive stakeholders.

• Internal Platform Development – In-house cloud platform management solutions development - Develop self-service platform capabilities etc.

Candidate Profile & Qualifications

Education & Experience

• Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or equivalent.

• 4+ years of total progressive industry experience in IT infrastructure and software delivery.

• 2+ years of dedicated hands-on cloud engineering, platform design, or operational experience.

• Proven track record of hands-on experience across at least one major cloud vendor (AWS, Azure, and/or GCP). Experience in two cloud vendors would be an advantage.

Technical Competencies

• Thorough understanding or core cloud foundational services (networking/VPC peering, enterprise IAM, hybrid connectivity, compute, and container runtimes) across AWS, GCP, and Azure, with a proven ability to design and manage resilient, high-performance multi-cloud platforms.

• Expertise in Infrastructure-as-Code tooling (Terraform, Terragrunt) and modern CI/CD ecosystems (GitHub Actions, Jenkins).

• Strong working knowledge of configuration management and automation frameworks (Python, Bash, PowerShell, Ansible).

• Understanding of networking, CDN caching tiers, WAF configurations (i.e. Fastly CDN, NGWAF), and hybrid cloud connectivity.

• Experience in implementing/supporting cloud security controls, encryption (at rest and in transit), key management systems, vulnerability assessments, and SIEM integrations.

• AI Governance & Cloud Integration: Familiarity with supporting governance, security controls, and resource optimization for cloud-native AI/ML services.

• Responsible AI & Compliance: Understanding of data residency, privacy frameworks, and security baselines required when deploying AI models in enterprise multi-cloud environments.

• ITSM & ITIL Frameworks: Solid working knowledge of ITIL principles, particularly concerning change enablement, incident management, problem management, and Configuration Management Database (CMDB) tracking in multi-cloud architectures.

Certifications & Soft Skills

• Cloud Certifications: Active certification from at least one major cloud provider at the minimum of Associate/Engineer level.

• Infrastructure Automation Certifications: Having HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate (or higher Authoring and Operations Professional) is an added advantage.

• Service Management: Certification in ITIL v4 Foundation or above would be an added advantage.

• Communication & Influence: Exceptional written, verbal, and presentation abilities; adept at translating complex architectural trade-offs and risks into business terms for executive leadership.

Benefits:  

• Performance-based annual bonus  

• Performance rewards and recognition  

• Agile Benefits - special allowances for Health, Wellness & Academic purposes  

• Entertainment allowance  

• Team engagement allowance  

• Comprehensive Health & Life Insurance Cover - extendable to parents and in-laws  

• Hybrid work arrangement  

  

Sysco LABS is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Job Description
Asset-intensive industry is entering an AI-enabled, data-driven, increasingly autonomous era — and nowhere is the value more concentrated than in shutdowns, turnarounds, outages, maintenance campaigns, and major capital builds, where scope, readiness, cost, and safety decide success. This role sits at the centre of that shift.

As a Principal Product Manager for Enterprise Asset Management, you'll own products that maximise asset value, reliability, and uptime while reducing risk and total cost of ownership across the full asset lifecycle — from capital build through operation, maintenance, and turnaround. You bring deep insight into project-based work — shutdowns and turnarounds (STO), campaigns of work, and major capital projects — and you champion high AI agency, treating agentic AI as a core capability, not a feature.

You'll serve asset-intensive operators across IFS's key industries- Energy, Utilities & Resources, Manufacturing, Construction & Engineering, Communication, Aerospace & Defence, and Service Industries.

Strategy & Vision — Set a clear product vision and roadmap tied to measurable outcomes: asset availability, reliability, maintenance cost, and turnaround schedule and budget adherence. Build strong investment cases and drive growth across core and AI revenue streams, aligned with the Asset Lifecycle Management portfolio.

Customer Discovery — Lead discovery with maintenance, reliability, operations, turnaround/STO, and capital-planning leaders. Go deep on scope challenge and optimisation, readiness, resource mobilisation, scheduling, and cost/risk control. Prioritise ruthlessly on measurable value.

Commercial Impact & GTM — Define differentiation and value for asset-intensive buyers and event leaders. Support pricing, packaging, launches, and customer presentations. Own adoption as a core metric.

Essential

• Proven experience (6+ years) in Product Management within SaaS, platform, or enterprise software environments.
• Deep knowledge of shutdown, turnaround, major capital investment projects or similar activities in the context of EAM.
• Experienced and knowledgeable in the domain of Enterprise Asset Management, maintenance & reliability, or asset-intensive operations, with hands-on exposure to one or more of IFS's core industries (Aerospace & Defence, Energy/Utilities & Resources, Manufacturing, Construction & Engineering, Telecommunications, Service Industries).

Together, we are shaping the future.

ABOUT THE ROLE


Halcon is seeking an experienced Principal Engineer: Software (Embedded Software System Engineer) to lead the definition, architecture, and integration of high-performance real-time embedded software systems.
The role serves as the technical authority bridging system requirements, software architecture, hardware interfaces, and software development teams.The successful candidate will drive software system engineering activities, ensure compliance with system requirements, mentor engineers, and support the development of scalable and safety-critical embedded solutions for advanced defense and aerospace platforms.

RESPONSIBILITIES


• Translate high-level system requirements into detailed software requirements and maintain end-to-end requirements traceability.

• Define software architectures, interface control documents, and hardware/software integration strategies for real-time embedded systems.

• Act as the technical authority and liaison between software engineers, systems engineers, hardware engineers, and project stakeholders.

• Lead software system engineering activities, technical reviews, mentoring, and capability development of junior engineers

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS


• Bachelor's degree in Electronic Engineering, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.

• Minimum 15 years of experience in embedded software engineering, preferably within defense, military, aerospace, or aviation environments.

• Minimum 3 years of experience as a Software Architect, Software System Engineer, or Technical Lead.

• Strong knowledge of software system engineering, requirements management, traceability tools (e.g., Jama), and embedded hardware/software integration.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS


• Proven experience in certifying safety-critical software to DO-178C Level A or equivalent standards.

• Expertise in Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE), SCADE, safety-critical middleware, FPGA interfacing, and embedded communication protocols.

WHY CHOOSE EDGE


Launched in November 2019, the UAE's EDGE is one of the world's leading advanced technology groups, established to develop agile, bold and disruptive solutions for defence and beyond, and to be a catalyst for change and transformation. It is dedicated to bringing breakthrough innovations, products, and services to market with greater speed and efficiency, to position the UAE as a leading global hub for future industries, and to creating clear paths within the sector for the next generation of highly skilled talent to thrive.

jobs.title: Product Designer (cards / digital wallets)
jobs.description:
Role Summary

We are looking for a Product Designer to shape the user experience of botim, an AI-native fintech platform serving millions of users across payments, financial services, communications, and platform capabilities.

You will design complex, high-impact fintech experiences where trust, speed, and scalability matter. Working with Product, Engineering, Data, Risk, and Growth, you will own the design of your product area end to end, and help define not just how our products look and feel, but what we build and why.

Responsibilities

• Own product work end to end, from problem framing and concepting through launch and iteration. Stay involved through launch, not just handoff.

• Design user journeys for AI-driven fintech products including payments, wallets, onboarding, lending, and platform services.

• Turn regulatory and system complexity into intuitive workflows. Translate product strategy, user needs, data, and compliance requirements into clear flows and high-quality UI.

• Own the product copy for the flows you design. This includes the Arabic version, which you take through our content tooling and a native review step.

• Use AI as a core part of your workflow. Prototype, explore, and iterate with AI-assisted tools, and bring the results into Figma for systems and polish.

• Collaborate closely with engineers in agile teams, including rapid prototyping to validate ideas quickly.

• Contribute to and evolve botim's design system, establishing patterns that scale across products.

• Validate with research and experimentation. Use qualitative and quantitative signals to inform decisions and evaluate impact.

• Share work regularly in design reviews and contribute to a strong culture of feedback and iteration.

• Deliver production-ready work across mobile and web, with attention to states, edge cases, dark mode, localisation and RTL considered by default.

Arabic language skills are not required. Designers run the localisation process; they do not translate.

Requirements

• 3+ years of experience as a Product Designer working on digital consumer products.

• A portfolio showing end-to-end ownership, problem-solving, and measurable product impact. This is a mandatory requirement.

• Experience designing in regulated or highly complex environments, where compliance, risk, or legacy systems shape the product.

• Strong craft across interaction design, visual design, and prototyping in Figma.

• Working proficiency with AI design tools applied to real product work.

• Proven ability to collaborate with Product Managers, Engineers, Data, and Risk teams.

• Excellent written and verbal communication, able to articulate the reasoning behind design decisions.

• Comfort working in fast-paced, ambiguous environments with evolving requirements.

Preferred

• Experience designing for a fintech product, such as payments, wallets, lending, or banking.

• Experience with super-apps or platform products.

jobs.title: Data Center Engineering Operations - 2027 Internship , DCEO
jobs.summary: Want to be part of the team that keeps the world's largest cloud running? As an Engineering Operations Technician Intern at Amazon Web Services (AWS), you will get hands-on experience with the critical
jobs.description:
Want to be part of the team that keeps the world's largest cloud running? As an Engineering Operations Technician Intern at Amazon Web Services (AWS), you will get hands-on experience with the critical infrastructure behind Amazon's global data centers — and your work will directly impact millions of customers worldwide.

This internship is designed as a potential pathway to full-time employment. Interns who demonstrate strong performance throughout their internship may be considered for a full-time Engineering Operations Technician position, subject to available roles and business needs.

Who Should Apply

We welcome applications from:

- Students in the last year of their Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field who are looking for an internship that could lead to a full-time career.

It is a requirement to be graduated by the end of the internship.

Important — Site Location & Commuting: This role is based at a data center facility in a remote location with no public transportation access. A valid driving license and access to personal transportation are required to commute to the site daily. Please consider this before applying.

About the Role

As an intern, you will provide technical support within Amazon's owned and operated data centers. Your work will ensure that the data center's mechanical, electrical, and plumbing systems operate at 100% availability while maintaining first-class customer service to the teams and groups on site.

You will be exposed to both independent work and team-based collaboration. Prioritization, organizational skills, effective communication, and the ability to react quickly are critical to being successful.

What You Will Do

The Engineering Operations team is Amazon's front-line responders for hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting and operations. You will work with equipment that supports mission-critical servers and must maintain better than 99.999% uptime. This equipment includes, but is not limited to:

- Stand-by diesel generators and switchgear

- Uninterruptible Power Supplies (UPSs) and Power Distribution Units (PDUs)

- Air Handling Units (AHUs), chillers, and cooling towers

- Chemical treatment systems, pumps, motors, and Variable Frequency Drives (VFDs)

- Building automation systems

Your day-to-day duties include:

- Maintaining mechanical and electrical equipment

- Assisting with root cause analysis of equipment failures

- Troubleshooting facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLAs)

- Taking daily operational readings of all mechanical and electrical equipment

- Using internal Computerized Maintenance Management Systems (CMMS) to manage building workflows

- Interacting with third-party vendors and contractors working on site

Internship Structure

Amazon internships are full-time (40 hours per week) for 3 consecutive months, starting in summer 2027. This position requires the intern to report to work on site daily. Intern schedules are typically day schedules, Sunday through Thursday.

Please note that full-time Engineering Operations Technician roles operate on a rotating shift pattern, which may include days, nights, weekends, and public holidays. Candidates should be willing and able to commit to shift work upon transitioning to a full-time position.

Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed below, we encourage you to apply. If your career is just starting, has not followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, do not let that stop you from applying.

Your Career at Amazon — A Universe of Opportunity

At Amazon, your career is not a straight path. It is a journey you build as you go.

From your first day as an intern, you will own real work that matters. You will troubleshoot and maintain the systems that keep AWS running for millions of customers. Your mentors and teammates will champion your growth, helping you build skills you did not know existed — and you will see your work come to life at massive scale.

Impact. Your work shapes the infrastructure that millions of customers rely on every day. From cloud computing to artificial intelligence, the systems you maintain power it all.

Action. You will move fast, experiment, and learn by doing. Your ideas do not get stuck in approval chains — they get tested, refined, and put into practice.

Curiosity. Every project teaches you something new. You will apply what you learned in the classroom to real challenges and explore different teams, technologies, and career paths within Amazon.

Mentorship and career growth. You will start with structured onboarding and get paired with experienced mentors. Beyond that, you will find continuous learning opportunities and the chance to work on different projects. Your journey here is yours to shape.

About the team

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. We are the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on.

You will join a diverse team of engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You will collaborate with people across AWS to deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers.

Basic qualifications
- In pursuit of a Bachelor's degree in a relevant field such as Mechanical Engineering or Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field, graduating in 2027 - before the end of the internship.

- Professional English proficiency, both written and verbal

- Ability to work well with others in a team environment, with strong time management skills

Preferred qualifications
- Experience in program or project management

- Knowledge of mechanical systems (Heating, Ventilation, and Air Conditioning systems, controls)

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

• Experience leading technical discovery, architecture workshops, proof-of-concepts, performance validation, and executive-level technical presentations.
• Effective collaboration across teams, combined with excellent written and verbal communication.

If you're ready to take on this outstanding opportunity and help NVIDIA continue to lead the world in technology innovation, apply now!

SUMMARY / INTRODUCTION

Work with the Indemnities manager as a team in managing customer exit requests and identify possible ways of retention and apply the retention tools to minimize customer attrition and manage customer expectations and communications efficiently.

• Perform primary screening into customer's financial records from a credit and risk prospective and propose solutions while working with customers on obtaining guarantees and documents to support proposals that aim to continue the relationship.

• Team working skills.
• Ability to present customer's perspective and ability to perform primary initial screening into customer's financial records.
• Very good understanding of product policies, features and running campaigns.
• Knowledge in Banking Systems.
• Minimum of 2 year of experience in the same role.

jobs.title: Senior Embedded Software Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT EDGE


At EDGE bold ideas are engineered into technologies that protect, improve and save lives.

Headquartered in the United Arab Emirates, EDGE is a leading advanced technology group working at the forefront of defence and emerging technologies. Spanning more than 35 specialised companies and multiple centres of excellence, we are purpose-built to move fast. Free from heavy legacy processes, we give our people the autonomy, accountability, and agility to bring breakthrough technologies from concept to reality.

Based in Abu Dhabi, a globally connected hub at the crossroads of Europe, Asia, Africa, and the Middle East, EDGE is home to a truly multicultural community where bold ideas thrive, and the future is shaped.

Together, we are shaping the future.

ABOUT THE ROLE


Embedded Software Engineer

Role Overview:
Develop and maintain embedded software for aerospace and UAV systems, ensuring high performance, reliability, and compliance with safety standards.

RESPONSIBILITIES


• Design, develop, and test embedded software in C/C++.

• Develop software for real-time and safety-critical systems.

• Integrate software with hardware components, sensors, and actuators.

• Implement control algorithms and optimize code performance.

• Perform debugging, troubleshooting, and system testing.

• Maintain technical documentation and support certification activities.

• Collaborate with hardware, systems, and QA teams.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS


• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related field.

• 5–7+ years of embedded software development experience.

• Strong proficiency in C/C++ and embedded systems.

• Experience with RTOS (e.g., FreeRTOS, VxWorks, QNX).

• Knowledge of hardware-software integration and communication protocols (SPI, I2C, UART, CAN).

• Familiarity with aerospace/safety standards such as DO-178C and DO-254.

• Experience with Git and software debugging tools.

• Strong problem-solving and teamwork skills.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS


• Aerospace, defense, automotive, or other safety-critical industry experience.

• Relevant embedded systems or aerospace certifications.

WHY CHOOSE EDGE


Launched in November 2019, the UAE's EDGE is one of the world's leading advanced technology groups, established to develop agile, bold and disruptive solutions for defence and beyond, and to be a catalyst for change and transformation. It is dedicated to bringing breakthrough innovations, products, and services to market with greater speed and efficiency, to position the UAE as a leading global hub for future industries, and to creating clear paths within the sector for the next generation of highly skilled talent to thrive.

At EDGE, the real investment goes beyond compensation. Through our dedicated learning academy and digital learning platforms, employees have access to extensive opportunities to develop new skills, deepen their expertise, and advance their careers. Combined with the freedom to innovate, strong career support, and the opportunity to collaborate with world-class talent from across the globe, EDGE is a place where you can continue to grow, keep learning, and turn ambitious ideas into meaningful outcomes.

Working at EDGE also comes with a package that genuinely reflects how much we value our people. Salaries are highly competitive and tax-free and, depending on your role and seniority, benefits can include family visas, annual flight tickets, medical insurance for you and your dependents, and education allowances for your children.

CANDIDATE PRIVACY & EQUAL OPPORTUNITY STATEMENT


If you feel your skills, experience and potential are a strong match for a role, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement. We are genuinely interested in what you can bring to EDGE.

Any information you share as part of your EDGE candidate profile or job application will be handled in accordance with applicable data protection and privacy regulations.

EDGE is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and high-performing workforce. We believe every individual deserves to be treated with fairness, respect and dignity, and our employment decisions reflect that. We do not discriminate based on race, colour, nationality, ethnicity, religion, gender, marital status, age, disability, pregnancy or parental status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

As a global organisation, effective collaboration across international teams is central to how we work, so English proficiency is required for all roles unless otherwise stated in the job posting.

Please note that EDGE does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruitment agencies. Any resumes in the absence of a formally executed agreement in place will be deemed the property of EDGE, and no placement fees or compensation will be payable in respect of such submissions.

jobs.description:
ABOUT EDGE


At EDGE bold ideas are engineered into technologies that protect, improve and save lives.

Headquartered in the United Arab Emirates, EDGE is a leading advanced technology group working at the forefront of defence and emerging technologies. Spanning more than 35 specialised companies and multiple centres of excellence, we are purpose-built to move fast. ABOUT THE ROLE


We are seeking a highly skilled HPC Systems Administrator to manage, optimize, and support our high-performance computing environment used for Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) and Finite Element Analysis (FEA) workloads. This role is responsible for the full lifecycle of HPC operations — from infrastructure and scheduler management to user support, performance optimization, and long-term capacity planning.
The ideal candidate has strong Linux administration experience, deep knowledge of HPC schedulers, and hands-on familiarity with engineering simulation tools.

RESPONSIBILITIES


A. Infrastructure Management
• Maintain and administer compute nodes, login nodes, heterogeneous nodes, NAS storage servers, and high-speed interconnects (InfiniBand).
• Manage and maintain HPC-related databases, ensuring timely backups and audit compliance.
• Monitor hardware health including CPU temperatures, memory errors, and disk failures.
• Ensure high availability, reliability, and minimal downtime across the HPC environment.
B. Scheduler & Resource Management
• Configure and tune job schedulers (Slurm / PBS / LSF / Grid Engine).
• Implement and maintain fair-share scheduling, job priority rules, QoS limits, and preemption policies.
• Manage node reservations for large-scale CFD/FEA workloads.
• Provide best-practice recommendations for CPU/GPU architecture selection for engineering simulations.
• Prevent resource misuse, including node hogging, queue congestion, and starvation of small jobs.
C. User Access, Security & Compliance
• Manage user accounts, permissions, and storage quotas.
• Enforce secure SSH access, MFA, and other security controls.
• Ensure compliance with IT governance, data-security, and audit requirements.
• Apply OS patches, security updates, and vulnerability fixes.
D. Software Stack Management
• Install, update, and manage licenses for engineering solvers such as ANSYS, Siemens, NASTRAN, and others.
• Maintain version control and apply service pack updates as required.
• Manage environment modules (Lmod, Environment Modules).
• Optimize compilers, MPI libraries, math libraries, and GPU/graphics-intensive drivers for performance.
RESTRICTED
E. Performance Monitoring & Optimization
• Monitor node utilization, queue wait times, job failures, and overall cluster performance.
• Identify and resolve network congestion, I/O bottlenecks, and memory pressure issues.
• Conduct performance tuning and benchmarking for CFD/FEA workloads.
• Recommend improvements to enhance throughput and efficiency.
F. Troubleshooting & User Support
• Diagnose and resolve job crashes, memory leaks, solver errors, and environment issues.
• Assist users with HPC batch scripting and job optimization.
• Provide training sessions and best-practice guidance for HPC users.
• Maintain documentation, onboarding guides, and knowledge-base resources.
G. Storage & Data Lifecycle Management
• Enforce storage quotas, purge policies, and data-retention rules.
• Manage backup, archival systems, and RAID configurations.
• Ensure smooth operation of parallel file systems (Lustre, GPFS, BeeGFS).
• Support efficient data workflows for large CFD/FEA datasets.
H. Capacity Planning & Future Growth
• Plan for future expansion including increased core counts, GPU adoption, memory-heavy nodes, and faster interconnects.
• Evaluate new hardware technologies and benchmark workloads before procurement.
• Provide input into long-term HPC strategy and infrastructure roadmap.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS


• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Physics, or related field.
• 3–7 years of experience administering Linux-based HPC clusters.
• Strong knowledge of HPC schedulers (Slurm/PBS/LSF).
• Experience with MPI, OpenMP, and distributed computing.
• Familiarity with CFD/FEA solvers and engineering workflows.
• Proficiency in scripting (Bash, Python).
• Experience with high-speed networking and parallel file systems.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS


• Experience with GPU-accelerated workloads and CUDA-enabled solvers.
• Knowledge of container technologies (Singularity/Apptainer).
• Experience with monitoring tools (Grafana, Prometheus, XDMoD).
• Background supporting engineering or scientific computing environments.
• Understanding of performance profiling and benchmarking.

ABOUT EDGE


At EDGE bold ideas are engineered into technologies that protect, improve and save lives.

Headquartered in the United Arab Emirates, EDGE is a leading advanced technology group working at the forefront of defence and emerging technologies. Spanning more than 35 specialised companies and multiple centres of excellence, we are purpose-built to move fast. Free from heavy legacy processes, we give our people the autonomy, accountability, and agility to bring breakthrough technologies from concept to reality.

Based in Abu Dhabi, a globally connected hub at the crossroads of Europe, Asia, Africa, and the Middle East, EDGE is home to a truly multicultural community where bold ideas thrive, and the future is shaped.

Together, we are shaping the future.

ABOUT THE ROLE


As an ERP Process Engineer, you will work closely with production, engineering, supply chain, quality, and IT teams to analyze operational workflows, improve business processes, and support the implementation and enhancement of enterprise systems.

RESPONSIBILITIES


Business Process Analysis

Analyze and evaluate manufacturing processes, including production, planning, inventory management, engineering, and quality functions.
Conduct workshops and stakeholder interviews to gather business requirements.
Perform gap analysis between current and future-state processes and identify opportunities for improvement.
Solution Design & Implementation

Translate business requirements into ERP and PLM system solutions.
Configure and support ERP/PLM modules related to production, bill of materials (BOM), routing, product lifecycle management, and manufacturing
operations.
Support system implementations, upgrades, integrations, and continuous enhancements.
Ensure seamless integration between ERP, PLM, MES, and supply chain systems.

Product Lifecycle & Data Management

Support product lifecycle processes including design, development, engineering change management, and product release.
Maintain and optimize product structures, BOMs, and engineering data.
Develop and improve workflows supporting product development and change control activities.

Training & Change Management

Develop training materials, user guides, and process documentation.
Deliver end-user training and provide post-go-live support.
Promote best practices and drive user adoption of new technologies and processes.

Continuous Improvement & Support

Provide functional support and troubleshooting for ERP and PLM systems.
Monitor system performance and identify opportunities for optimization.
Lead initiatives focused on process efficiency, automation, and operational excellence.
Stakeholder & Project Management

Collaborate with cross-functional teams across manufacturing, engineering, supply chain, quality, and IT.
Support project planning, testing, deployment, and change management activities.
Communicate effectively with both technical teams and business stakeholders.

#Powertech

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS


Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Manufacturing, or a related discipline.
5–8+ years of experience in ERP and/or PLM consulting within a manufacturing environment.
Proven experience delivering ERP/PLM implementation or transformation projects.
Strong understanding of manufacturing processes, including MRP, production planning, BOM management, routing, and inventory control.
Experience with leading ERP platforms such as SAP, Oracle, or Microsoft Dynamics.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS


Knowledge of ERP, PLM, MES, and manufacturing system integrations is highly desirable.
SAP experience will be considered a strong advantage.

WHY CHOOSE EDGE


Launched in November 2019, the UAE's EDGE is one of the world's leading advanced technology groups, established to develop agile, bold and disruptive solutions for defence and beyond, and to be a catalyst for change and transformation. It is dedicated to bringing breakthrough innovations, products, and services to market with greater speed and efficiency, to position the UAE as a leading global hub for future industries, and to creating clear paths within the sector for the next generation of highly skilled talent to thrive.

At EDGE, the real investment goes beyond compensation. Through our dedicated learning academy and digital learning platforms, employees have access to extensive opportunities to develop new skills, deepen their expertise, and advance their careers. Combined with the freedom to innovate, strong career support, and the opportunity to collaborate with world-class talent from across the globe, EDGE is a place where you can continue to grow, keep learning, and turn ambitious ideas into meaningful outcomes.

Working at EDGE also comes with a package that genuinely reflects how much we value our people. Salaries are highly competitive and tax-free and, depending on your role and seniority, benefits can include family visas, annual flight tickets, medical insurance for you and your dependents, and education allowances for your children.

CANDIDATE PRIVACY & EQUAL OPPORTUNITY STATEMENT


If you feel your skills, experience and potential are a strong match for a role, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement. We are genuinely interested in what you can bring to EDGE.

Any information you share as part of your EDGE candidate profile or job application will be handled in accordance with applicable data protection and privacy regulations.

EDGE is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and high-performing workforce. We believe every individual deserves to be treated with fairness, respect and dignity, and our employment decisions reflect that. We do not discriminate based on race, colour, nationality, ethnicity, religion, gender, marital status, age, disability, pregnancy or parental status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

As a global organisation, effective collaboration across international teams is central to how we work, so English proficiency is required for all roles unless otherwise stated in the job posting.

Please note that EDGE does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruitment agencies. Any resumes in the absence of a formally executed agreement in place will be deemed the property of EDGE, and no placement fees or compensation will be payable in respect of such submissions.

jobs.title: Embedded Software Engineer II
jobs.description:
Internal Job Description


Embedded Software Engineer

We are looking for an Embedded Engineer with 5–7 years of experience in embedded software development, preferably within the aerospace or avionics domain. The role involves developing, integrating, testing, and maintaining safety-critical embedded software for aerospace systems.

Key Responsibilities

• Design, develop, and maintain embedded software for avionics, flight control, and aerospace systems. Implement and optimize real-time software ensuring minimal latency, high reliability, and deterministic performance. Collaborate with system engineers to translate control algorithms and system requirements into efficient embedded code.

• Integrate software with hardware systems and perform rigorous testing to validate functionality, performance, and compliance with safety standards. Develop software in alignment with industry standards such as DO-178C and DO-254. Optimize code for memory usage, power efficiency, and execution performance while adhering to best practices and coding standards.

• Maintain detailed documentation including design specifications, code, test plans, and results. Work cross-functionally with hardware, systems, and QA teams to ensure seamless integration. Troubleshoot and resolve defects, anomalies, and performance issues through structured debugging and analysis. Continuously stay updated with emerging technologies, tools, and industry best practices.

Qualifications & Experience

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field (Master’s/PhD preferred).

• Minimum 5-7 years of experience in embedded software development, preferably within aerospace or safety-critical industries.

• Strong hands-on expertise in C and C++ for embedded systems. Deep understanding of microcontroller architectures such as ARM and STM32, along with low-level hardware interfacing.

Operating Environment
Ability to work effectively under pressure in fast-paced, mission-critical environments. Demonstrated ownership mindset with the ability to drive solutions from concept through deployment.

Centric Global is a growing technology company with offices in Kenya, Dubai, and Sri Lanka, specializing in ICT, enterprise applications, and digital transformation solutions.

As an IFS partner, Centric Global delivers IFS ERP solutions and supports organizations across various industries with implementation, consulting, optimization, and technology services. The company also partners with global technology providers including Microsoft, AWS, SUSE, Kaspersky, and Red Hat.

With a focus on innovation, regional growth, and customer success, Centric Global brings together talented technology professionals to deliver scalable solutions and create meaningful impact for clients across the region.

Join Centric Global and be part of a growing team delivering technology solutions that help businesses operate smarter and grow sustainably.

Working within a delivery-focused consultancy, you will play a key role in ensuring successful project execution in line with IFS implementation methodologies, managing scope, timelines, budgets, risks, and quality while delivering measurable business value and customer satisfaction.

Lead and manage end-to-end IFS Cloud implementation projects from initiation through go-live and hypercare, ensuring successful delivery within agreed scope, timelines, budgets, and quality standards.

Develop and maintain comprehensive project plans, schedules, milestones and governance frameworks in alignment with IFS implementation methodologies and contractual commitments.

•
Manage project budgets, financial forecasts, resource costs and invoicing while maintaining commercial control and ensuring compliance with contractual commitments.

•
Plan, allocate, and coordinate project resources across workstreams, managing capacity, priorities and dependencies to meet project objectives and delivery commitments.

•
Prepare and deliver project status reports, financial updates and executive presentations, facilitate steering committee meetings and ensure timely escalation of critical issues and decisions.

•
Monitor project deliverables against agreed quality standards, business requirements and client expectations, ensuring successful solution delivery and realization of expected business benefits.

•
Motivate and support project teams, delegate responsibilities effectively, resolve conflicts and foster a collaborative, accountable, and results-driven delivery environment.

•
Manage project delivery across multiple geographies, time zones and cultural environments, ensuring effective coordination between clients, consultants, and other delivery stakeholders.

Qualifications
Required Skills & Experience:

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent qualification, preferably in Information Technology, Business Management, Project Management, or a related discipline.

•
Proven experience managing medium to large-scale ERP implementation and transformation programmes, including end-to-end IFS implementations, in a project management or delivery leadership capacity.

•
Strong understanding of the ERP implementation lifecycle, project governance and Agile, Waterfall, or Hybrid delivery methodologies.

Strong understanding of IFS Cloud, IFS software, and service offerings.

Strong stakeholder management and client-facing communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across complex delivery environments.

Proven ability to manage multiple stakeholders and priorities while maintaining scope, timelines, budgets, and delivery risks.

•
Previous consultancy or customer-facing ERP delivery experience is preferred.

Excellent command of English, both written and spoken.

Additional Information
We champion flexibility and hybrid work options to support varying lifestyles and personal needs. At the same time, we value the power of in-person collaboration to build community, spark innovation, and strengthen connections. Our approach ensures you can work in ways that suit you best while still engaging with colleagues to share ideas and grow together. #LI-Hybrid #LI-DNP

jobs.title: Data Center Technician - 2027 Internship
jobs.summary: At Amazon Web Services (AWS), we are working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people. Are you ready to embrace the challenge?
jobs.description:
At Amazon Web Services (AWS), we are working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people. Are you ready to embrace the challenge? Come build the future with us.

This is a unique opportunity to work in some of the most cutting-edge data centers in the world. Amazon data centers are large-scale, high-density facilities where you will help change the face of cloud technology in the region — and your work will directly impact millions of customers.

This internship is designed as a potential pathway to full-time employment. Interns who demonstrate strong performance throughout their internship may be considered for a full-time Data Center Technician position, subject to available roles and business needs.

Who Should Apply

We welcome applications from:

- Students in the last year of their Bachelor's degree in a relevant technical field such as Information Technology, Computer Hardware Repair, or similar. It is a requirement to be graduated by the end of the internship.

Important — Site Location & Commuting: This role is based at a data center facility in a remote location with no public transportation access. A valid driving license and access to personal transportation are required to commute to the site daily. Please consider this before applying.

As a Data Center Technician Intern, you will work as part of the Operations team, whose primary responsibility is the maintenance and upkeep of the data center infrastructure. This position involves hardware and network diagnostics followed by physical repair.

You will be exposed to both independent work and team-based collaboration. Prioritization, organizational skills, effective communication, and the ability to react quickly are critical to being successful.

What You Will Do

You will provide our internal teams with infrastructure-related support, resolving tickets related to hardware (motherboards, Random Access Memory, Central Processing Units, Graphics Processing Units, and more) and networking (link-down events, optics replacements, switch replacements, and more).

jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Data Scientist

The Big Picture

Sysco LABS is the Global In-House Center of Sysco Corporation (NYSE: SYY), the world’s largest foodservice company. Sysco ranks 56th in the Fortune 500 list and is the global leader in the trillion-dollar foodservice industry.

Sysco employs over 75,000 associates, has 337 smart distribution facilities worldwide and over 14,000 IoT-enabled trucks serving 730,000 customer locations. For fiscal year 2025 that ended June 29, 2025, the company generated sales of more than $81.4 billion.

Sysco LABS Sri Lanka delivers the technology that powers Sysco’s end-to-end operations.

Sysco LABS’ enterprise technology is present in the end-to-end foodservice journey, enabling the sourcing of food products, merchandising, storage and warehouse operations, order placement and pricing algorithms, the delivery of food and supplies to Sysco’s global network and the in-restaurant dining experience of the end-customer.

The Opportunity

We are currently on the lookout for Data Scientists to join our team.

Responsibilities:

• Extract, transform, and analyze large-scale structured and unstructured datasets using Python, SQL, and cloud-based technologies.
• Perform exploratory data analysis (EDA), data preprocessing, feature engineering, and model development to address business challenges.
• Develop, evaluate, optimize, and deploy machine learning models, including predictive, classification, and forecasting solutions.
• Build and maintain scalable data and machine learning pipelines for production environments.
• Develop AI-powered solutions using Generative AI technologies, including Large Language Models (LLMs), prompt engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), embeddings, and Agentic AI concepts.
• Monitor model performance, conduct model validation, and implement continuous improvement initiatives to ensure accuracy and reliability.
• Apply statistical analysis and experimentation techniques to identify insights and support data-driven decision-making.
• Translate analytical findings and model outputs into actionable business recommendations.
• Collaborate with Product Owners, Business Stakeholders, Data Engineers, and other cross functional teams to deliver impactful solutions.
• Document data science methodologies, model assumptions, and technical approaches to support knowledge sharing and governance.
• Follow software engineering best practices, including version control, testing, and code quality standards.

Requirements:

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field.
• Strong programming skills in Python and SQL.
• Hands-on experience with data science and machine learning libraries such as Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, XGBoost, TensorFlow/Keras, PyTorch, or similar.
• Solid understanding of Machine Learning algorithms, statistics, feature engineering, model evaluation, and experimentation methodologies.
• Experience working with time-series forecasting, predictive analytics, classification models, and imbalanced datasets.
• Familiarity with data processing frameworks such as Spark or PySpark.
• Understanding of MLOps concepts, CI/CD pipelines, Git, APIs, and model deployment practices.
• Experience working with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure.
• Knowledge of Generative AI concepts, including LLMs, RAG architectures, embeddings, prompt engineering, and AI agents.

Benefits

• Performance-based annual bonus

• Performance rewards and recognition

• Agile Benefits - special allowances for Health, Wellness & Academic purposes

• Paid birthday leave Team engagement allowance

• Comprehensive Health & Life Insurance Cover - extendable to parents and in-laws

• Hybrid work arrangement

Sysco LABS is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Software Architect (Payments)
jobs.description:
Software Architect (Payments)

Location: Abu Dhabi

ABOUT US

A leading UAE-based consumer technology company, building the digital infrastructure of everyday life with a focus on AI-powered fintech, communication, and digital services.

Guided by our philosophy, the Blueprint of Simplicity, we design technology around real human behavior, connecting people, enabling financial access, and making everyday experiences effortless.

Our flagship platform, botim, is the region’s most trusted fintech communication platform, combining secure VoIP with action-based AI and everyday money tools. Through botim money, we provide financial services that serve both individuals and SMEs, making payments, transfers, and credit simpler and more accessible. Today, the platform serves 150M+ users worldwide.

Our lending finance engine, Quantix, powers fast, regulated credit across the ecosystem, including innovative products such as CashNow for instant access.

From calls to credit, from daily services to big ambitions, we are rethinking how the region stays connected and financially included.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are at a critical juncture — building and scaling next-generation payment systems across merchant acquiring and core payment processing, powering real-time transaction flows at production scale. This is a high-impact, cross-platform role where you will own backend architecture, make authoritative technical decisions across multiple squads, and directly shape the technical direction of our payments platform.

You will serve as the technical architectural bridge between the Chief Architect and engineering execution — translating product intent into scalable, production-ready payment systems, guiding a pod of engineers through what good looks like, and setting the standard that every squad builds to. You will be the person teams come to when a decision needs to be made, a trade-off needs to be owned, or a design needs to be challenged. You know the payment ecosystem inside out — from how a transaction moves across card schemes, through switching layers, into clearing and settlement, to how regulatory and compliance constraints shape every design decision. Our platform is built on a Java microservices stack operating at the intersection of real-time transaction processing, card scheme integration, and regulated financial infrastructure — and this role sits at the centre of all of it.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Platform Architecture & Ownership

Architect and evolve systems spanning Merchant Management, POS, and eCommerce acceptance. You own the platform architecture across acquiring and adjacent payment services — not scoped to a single squad or vertical. Design for high throughput, low latency, and production-first reliability across auth, clearing, settlement, and reconciliation flows.

Technical Direction Across Squads

You will own Technical architectural direction and design decisions across multiple engineering squads simultaneously. You are the person who holds the full-system technical view when individual squads optimise locally. Lead and mentor a pod of engineers — owning design quality and delivery accountability.

Product & Business Alignment

Work directly with Product Owners to translate product intent and regulatory requirements into technically sound, scalable, and auditable system designs. You bridge the gap between what is being asked and what should be built — and you communicate that clearly in both directions.

Protocol, Integration & Hands-on Engineering

Define the integration architecture across card schemes, payment processor, and internal switching layers — setting the technical standards for payment integration including ISO 8583 message design, inter-service communication patterns using Dubbo or a comparable RPC framework, and how the acquiring service mesh connects and fails safely. Stay hands-on — contribute to critical Java microservice components, lead code and architecture reviews, and resolve complex production issues. At this level, you code because it makes your architecture better, not because no one else can.

API & Event-Driven Architecture

Design REST/JSON APIs with strong emphasis on idempotency, fault tolerance, and exactly-once semantics. Drive event-driven flows using RabbitMQ for transaction lifecycle events, downstream processing, and asynchronous workflows. Design Redis-backed patterns for distributed caching, idempotency key management, rate limiting, and real-time state. Design systems that are operable and diagnosable — not just functional.

AI-Augmented Engineering

We use Claude Code as our default AI coding assistant and expect this role to use it generously — for architecture reviews, code and test generation, runbook creation, log triage, and elimination of manual engineering toil. Automate aggressively: If a task is repetitive, it is a candidate for AI automation and you will lead it for the team.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

— 12 to 15 years of backend or platform engineering experience — with a material portion spent building, owning, and operating production card payment systems at a licensed Fintech, payment processor, acquirer, or financial institution. Experience must span architecture, delivery, and production ownership — not advisory proximity to payments.

— Expert-level Java and Spring Boot proficiency — microservices design, Application framework, transactional integrity, service decomposition, and production API development. You are expected to review code and jump to write one where required, not just approve designs. Testing literacy is assumed; the bar here is designing systems that are testable by default.

— Deep, production-proven command of ISO 8583 and payment messaging — Deep knowledge of full transaction lifecycle — authorisation, clearing and settlement — with enough protocol fluency to make authoritative architecture decisions on message design, switching topology, and host connectivity. Prior experience with jPOS or an equivalent switching framework is expected; what matters at this level is the judgment to define how these systems connect, fail, and recover at acquiring scale — not just operate them. Ability to reason clearly about synchronous vs. asynchronous processing trade-offs in high-volume acquiring environments.

— Demonstrated experience integrating with payment gateways and processors — REST and ISO-based integration, hosted payment pages, tokenisation, EMV 3DS 2.x authentication, and back-office reconciliation. Prior work with MPGS, Cybersource or leading gateway integration is a strong asset — particularly where you owned the integration and drove implementation.

— Experience working with RabbitMQ or Kafka message broker — designing reliable transactional event flows, exchange/queue topology, dead-letter queue strategies, and message acknowledgement patterns in a high-volume payment environment.

— Worked with Dubbo or a comparable RPC framework (gRPC) for synchronous inter-service communication — with the judgment to decide when RPC is the right pattern over async messaging, and how to design for failure isolation across service boundaries.

— Architect Leader — leads a pod of engineers by example, setting the standard through what you produce: solution design documents, Architecture Decision Records (ADRs), and integration specifications the team learns from. Equally comfortable running a design review with engineers and presenting architecture trade-offs to Product, Risk, and Compliance stakeholders.

CORE TECHNOLOGY STACK

Required: Java / Spring Boot · ISO 8583 · jPOS · MPGS / Cybersource / Payment gateway · RabbitMQ / Kafka · Redis · gRPC Framework · REST APIs · Microservices · GitLab / GitHub · MySQL / MongoDB / Elastic Search

Strong Asset: Azure / AWS · 3DS (EMV 3DS 2.x) · EMV · Tokenisation · Visa / Mastercard Scheme Integration · CI/CD · TOGAF
